entries.source: In battle, Chikorita waves its leaf around to keep the foe at bay. However, a sweet fragrance also wafts from the leaf, becalming the battling Pokémon and creating a cozy, friendly atmosphere all around.
entries.translation: 战斗时，菊草叶会挥动叶子，让对手无法靠近。然而，叶子也会飘出甜甜的香气，使战斗中的宝可梦平静下来，并让周围充满温馨友好的氛围。

entries.source: It uses the leaf on its head to determine the temperature and humidity. It loves to sunbathe.
entries.translation: 它会用头上的叶子判断温度和湿度。它喜欢晒太阳。

entries.source: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sun rays.
entries.translation: 头上的叶子会轻轻飘出甜甜的香气。它性情温顺，喜欢沐浴在阳光下。

entries.source: Its pleasantly aromatic leaf has the ability to check humidity and temperature.
entries.translation: 它那散发怡人香气的叶子能够检测湿度和温度。

entries.source: A sweet aroma gently wafts from the leaf on its head. It is docile and loves to soak up sunrays.
entries.translation: 头上的叶子会轻轻飘出甜甜的香气。它性情温顺，喜欢沐浴在阳光下。

entries.source: Bayleef’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each tubular leaf is a small shoot of a tree. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.
entries.translation: 月桂叶的颈部环绕着卷曲的叶子。每片筒状叶子里都有一根小小的树芽。这种树芽的香气会使人精神振奋。

entries.source: The buds that ring its neck give off a spicy aroma that perks people up.
entries.translation: 环绕在它颈部的花苞会散发辛辣的香气，使人精神振奋。

entries.source: A spicy aroma emanates from around its neck. The aroma acts as a stimulant to restore health.
entries.translation: 它的颈部周围会散发出辛辣的香气。这种香气具有刺激作用，能使人恢复活力。

entries.source: The scent of spices comes from around its neck. Somehow, sniffing it makes you want to fight.
entries.translation: 它的颈部周围会散发出香辛料的气味。不知为何，闻到后就会让人想要战斗。

entries.source: A BAYLEEF’s neck is ringed by curled-up leaves. Inside each leaf is a small tree shoot. The fragrance of this shoot makes people peppy.
entries.translation: 月桂叶的颈部环绕着卷曲的叶子。每片叶子里都有一根小小的树芽。这种树芽的香气会使人精神振奋。

entries.source: The fragrance of Meganium’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, this Pokémon gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.
entries.translation: 大竺葵花朵的香气能舒缓并平复情绪。战斗时，这只宝可梦会释放出更多镇静香气，以削弱对手的斗志。

entries.source: Meganium’s breath has the power to revive dead grass and plants. It can make them healthy again.
entries.translation: 大竺葵的气息拥有令枯萎的草木复苏的力量。它能让草木重获生机。

entries.source: The aroma that rises from its petals contains a substance that calms aggressive feelings.
entries.translation: 从花瓣散发出的香气中，含有能够平息攻击欲的成分。

entries.source: Its breath has the fantastic ability to revive dead plants and flowers.
entries.translation: 它的气息拥有令枯萎的草木和花朵复苏的神奇能力。

entries.source: The fragrance of a MEGANIUM’s flower soothes and calms emotions. In battle, it gives off more of its becalming scent to blunt the foe’s fighting spirit.
entries.translation: 大竺葵花朵的香气能舒缓并平复情绪。战斗时，它会释放出更多镇静香气，以削弱对手的斗志。

entries.source: Hails from the Johto region. Though usually curled into a ball due to its timid disposition, it harbors tremendous firepower.
entries.translation: 来自城都地区。它性情胆小，平时总是蜷成一团，但体内蕴藏着惊人的火力。

entries.source: Cyndaquil protects itself by flaring up the flames on its back. The flames are vigorous if the Pokémon is angry. However, if it is tired, the flames splutter fitfully with incomplete combustion.
entries.translation: 火球鼠会让背上的火焰猛烈燃烧，以此保护自己。宝可梦生气时，火焰会烧得十分旺盛。然而疲惫时，火焰会因燃烧不充分而断断续续地噗噗作响。

entries.source: It has a timid nature. If it is startled, the flames on its back burn more vigorously.
entries.translation: 它性情胆小。一旦受到惊吓，背上的火焰就会燃烧得更加旺盛。

entries.source: It is timid and always curls itself up in a ball. If attacked, it flares up its back for protection.
entries.translation: 它很胆小，总是把身体蜷成一团。受到攻击时，会让背部燃起火焰来保护自己。

entries.source: It usually stays hunched over. If it is angry or surprised, it shoots flames out of its back.
entries.translation: 它平时总是弓着身子。生气或受惊时，会从背上喷出火焰。

entries.source: This creature's fur is most mysterious—it is wholly impervious to the burning touch of flame. Should Quilava turn its back to you, take heed! Such a posture indicates a forthcoming attack.
entries.translation: 这种生物的体毛十分神奇，完全不会受到火焰灼烧。若火岩鼠转身背对着你，务必当心！这个姿势意味着它即将发动攻击。

entries.source: Quilava keeps its foes at bay with the intensity of its flames and gusts of superheated air. This Pokémon applies its outstanding nimbleness to dodge attacks even while scorching the foe with flames.
entries.translation: 火岩鼠以猛烈的火焰和灼热的气浪阻止敌人靠近。这只宝可梦身手格外敏捷，即使一边用火焰灼烧对手，也能灵巧地躲开攻击。

entries.source: Be careful if it turns its back during battle. It means that it will attack with the fire on its back.
entries.translation: 战斗中，如果它转身背对着对手，就要小心。这意味着它将用背上的火焰发动攻击。

entries.source: Before battle, it turns its back on its opponent to demonstrate how ferociously its fire blazes.
entries.translation: 战斗前，它会转身背对对手，展示自己的火焰燃烧得有多么猛烈。

entries.source: It intimidates foes with the heat of its flames. The fire burns more strongly when it readies to fight.
entries.translation: 它会用火焰的热量震慑敌人。准备战斗时，火焰会燃烧得更旺。

entries.source: Said to purify lost, forsaken souls with its flames and guide them to the afterlife. I believe its form has been influenced by the energy of the sacred mountain towering at Hisui's center.
entries.translation: 据说它会用火焰净化迷失而无所依归的灵魂，并引导它们前往来世。我认为，它的形态受到了高耸于洗翠中心的神山能量影响。

entries.source: Typhlosion obscures itself behind a shimmering heat haze that it creates using its intensely hot flames. This Pokémon creates blazing explosive blasts that burn everything to cinders.
entries.translation: 火暴兽会用炽热火焰制造摇曳的热浪，将自己隐藏其中。这只宝可梦能引发熊熊燃烧的大爆炸，把一切烧成灰烬。

entries.source: It has a secret, devastating move. It rubs its blazing fur together to cause huge explosions.
entries.translation: 它有一招不为人知且破坏力惊人的绝招。它会让燃烧的体毛相互摩擦，引发大爆炸。

entries.source: If its rage peaks, it becomes so hot that anything that touches it will instantly go up in flames.
entries.translation: 愤怒达到顶点时，它会变得无比灼热，任何碰到它的东西都会瞬间燃烧起来。

entries.source: It attacks using blasts of fire. It creates heat shimmers with intense fire to hide itself.
entries.translation: 它会用爆裂的火焰发动攻击。它以猛烈的火焰制造热浪，将自己隐藏起来。

entries.source: Despite the smallness of its body, Totodile’s jaws are very powerful. While the Pokémon may think it is just playfully nipping, its bite has enough power to cause serious injury.
entries.translation: 尽管身体娇小，小锯鳄的颚却非常有力。这只宝可梦或许只是想闹着玩而轻轻咬一口，但其咬合力足以造成重伤。

entries.source: Its powerful, well-developed jaws are capable of crushing anything. Even its Trainer must be careful.
entries.translation: 它发达而强有力的颚能够咬碎任何东西。就连它的训练家也必须小心。

entries.source: It is small but rough and tough. It won’t hesitate to take a bite out of anything that moves.
entries.translation: 它虽然娇小，却粗暴而强悍。只要是会动的东西，它都会毫不犹豫地咬上一口。

entries.source: It has the habit of biting anything with its developed jaws. Even its Trainer needs to be careful.
entries.translation: 它有用发达的颚咬住任何东西的习惯。就连它的训练家也必须小心。

entries.source: Its well-developed jaws are powerful and capable of crushing anything. Even its TRAINER must be careful.
entries.translation: 它发达的颚强而有力，能够咬碎任何东西。就连它的训练家也必须小心。

entries.source: Once Croconaw has clamped its jaws on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like barbed fishhooks, they become impossible to remove when they have sunk in.
entries.translation: 蓝鳄一旦用颚咬住对手，就绝不会松口。由于獠牙尖端像带倒刺的鱼钩一样向后弯曲，一旦刺入便无法拔出。

entries.source: Once it bites down, it won’t let go until it loses its fangs. New fangs quickly grow into place.
entries.translation: 它一旦咬住，就会一直到獠牙脱落才肯松口。新的獠牙很快便会长出来。

entries.source: If it loses a fang, a new one grows back in its place. There are always 48 fangs lining its mouth.
entries.translation: 如果掉了一颗獠牙，原处就会重新长出一颗。它的口中始终排列着四十八颗獠牙。

entries.source: It opens its huge jaws wide when attacking. If it loses any fangs while biting, they grow back in.
entries.translation: 它发动攻击时会张开巨大的颚。如果撕咬时掉了獠牙，很快就会重新长出来。

entries.source: Once its jaws clamp down on its foe, it will absolutely not let go. Because the tips of its fangs are forked back like fishhooks, they become irremovably embedded.
entries.translation: 它一旦用颚咬住对手，就绝不会松口。由于獠牙尖端像鱼钩一样向后弯曲，一旦刺入便无法拔出。

entries.source: Feraligatr intimidates its foes by opening its huge mouth. In battle, it will kick the ground hard with its thick and powerful hind legs to charge at the foe at an incredible speed.
entries.translation: 大力鳄会张开巨口震慑敌人。战斗时，它会用粗壮有力的后腿猛蹬地面，以惊人的速度冲向对手。

entries.source: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears its victim up.
entries.translation: 它用巨大而有力的颚咬住猎物后，会猛烈摇头，将猎物残忍地撕碎。

entries.source: It usually moves slowly, but it goes at blinding speed when it attacks and bites prey.
entries.translation: 它平时行动缓慢，但发动攻击并咬住猎物时，速度快得令人眼花。

entries.source: It is hard for it to support its weight out of water, so it sometimes gets down on all fours. But it moves fast.
entries.translation: 离开水后，它很难支撑自己的体重，因此有时会四肢着地。不过，它的行动很迅速。

entries.source: When it bites with its massive and powerful jaws, it shakes its head and savagely tears up its victim.
entries.translation: 它用巨大而有力的颚咬住猎物后，会猛烈摇头，将猎物残忍地撕碎。

entries.source: When Sentret sleeps, it does so while another stands guard. The sentry wakes the others at the first sign of danger. When this Pokémon becomes separated from its pack, it becomes incapable of sleep due to fear.
entries.translation: 尾立睡觉时，会由另一只负责站岗。哨兵一发现危险，就会叫醒其他同伴。这种宝可梦一旦与族群走散，便会因恐惧而无法入睡。

entries.source: It stands on its tail so it can see a long way. If it spots an enemy, it cries loudly to warn its kind.
entries.translation: 它会用尾巴撑起身体，以便眺望远方。发现敌人时，会大声叫喊，向同伴发出警告。

entries.source: When acting as a lookout, it warns others of danger by screeching and hitting the ground with its tail.
entries.translation: 担任哨兵时，它会发出尖叫并用尾巴拍打地面，提醒同伴有危险。

entries.source: It has a very nervous nature. It stands up high on its tail so it can scan wide areas.
entries.translation: 它的性情非常敏感。它会用尾巴高高撑起身体，以便观察广阔的区域。

entries.source: A very cautious Pokémon, it raises itself up using its tail to get a better view of its surroundings.
entries.translation: 它是非常谨慎的宝可梦，会用尾巴撑起身体，以便看清周围的情况。

entries.source: Furret has a very slim build. When under attack, it can slickly squirm through narrow spaces and get away. In spite of its short limbs, this Pokémon is very nimble and fleet.
entries.translation: 大尾立的身材非常纤细。受到攻击时，它能灵活地钻过狭窄缝隙逃走。尽管四肢短小，这只宝可梦却十分敏捷迅速。

entries.source: It makes a nest to suit its long and skinny body. The nest is impossible for other Pokémon to enter.
entries.translation: 它会建造适合自己细长身体的巢穴。其他宝可梦根本无法进入这个巢穴。

entries.source: The mother puts its offspring to sleep by curling up around them. It corners foes with speed.
entries.translation: 母亲会蜷起身体环抱幼崽，哄它们入睡。它会凭借速度将敌人逼入绝境。

entries.source: There is no telling where the tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick and likes to chase RATTATA.
entries.translation: 根本看不出它的尾巴从哪里开始。尽管腿很短，它的动作却很快，而且喜欢追逐小拉达。

entries.source: There is no telling where its tail begins. Despite its short legs, it is quick at hunting RATTATA.
entries.translation: 根本看不出它的尾巴从哪里开始。尽管腿很短，它捕猎小拉达时却十分迅速。

entries.source: This Pokémon drifts and floats with the wind. If it senses the approach of strong winds, Hoppip links its leaves with other Hoppip to prepare against being blown away.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦会随风飘浮。如果感到强风接近，毽子草便会和其他毽子草把叶子连在一起，以免被吹走。

entries.source: It drifts on winds. It is said that when Hoppip gather in fields and mountains, spring is on the way.
entries.translation: 它会随风飘荡。据说，当毽子草聚集在原野和山间时，春天就快到了。

entries.source: Its body is so light, it must grip the ground firmly with its feet to keep from being blown away.
entries.translation: 它的身体轻得不得了，必须用双脚牢牢抓住地面，才不会被风吹走。

entries.source: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. But they do enjoy gentle breezes.
entries.translation: 为了不被风吹走，它们会聚集成群。不过，它们很喜欢柔和的微风。

entries.source: To keep from being blown away by the wind, they gather in clusters. They do enjoy gentle breezes, though.
entries.translation: 为了不被风吹走，它们会聚集成群。不过，它们确实很喜欢柔和的微风。

entries.source: Skiploom’s flower blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees Fahrenheit. How much the flower opens depends on the temperature. For that reason, this Pokémon is sometimes used as a thermometer.
entries.translation: 气温升至华氏64度以上时，毽子花的花朵便会绽放。花朵张开的程度取决于气温。因此，这种宝可梦有时会被当作温度计。

entries.source: It spreads its petals to absorb sunlight. It also floats in the air to get closer to the sun.
entries.translation: 它会展开花瓣吸收阳光。它也会飘浮在空中，以便更接近太阳。

entries.source: The bloom on top of its head opens and closes as the temperature fluctuates up and down.
entries.translation: 它头顶的花朵会随着气温的升降而开合。

entries.source: It blooms when the weather warms. It floats in the sky to soak up as much sunlight as possible.
entries.translation: 天气转暖时，它便会开花。它飘浮在空中，尽可能多地沐浴阳光。

entries.source: It blossoms when the temperature rises above 64 degrees F. Because its flower’s blooming changes with the temperature, it is sometimes used as a thermometer.
entries.translation: 气温升至华氏64度以上时，它便会开花。由于花朵的绽放状态会随气温变化，它有时会被当作温度计。

entries.source: Jumpluff rides warm southern winds to cross the sea and fly to foreign lands. The Pokémon descends to the ground when it encounters cold air while it is floating.
entries.translation: 毽子棉乘着温暖的南风飞越大海，前往异国他乡。它飘浮时一旦遇到冷空气，便会降落到地面。

entries.source: Even in the fiercest wind, it can control its fluff to make its way to any place in the world it wants.
entries.translation: 即使身处最猛烈的风中，它也能操控绒毛，前往世界上任何想去的地方。

entries.source: Blown by seasonal winds, it circles the globe, scattering cotton spores as it goes.
entries.translation: 它随季风环游世界，沿途播撒棉孢子。

entries.source: Drifts on seasonal winds and spreads its cotton-like spores all over the world to make more offspring.
entries.translation: 它乘着季风飘荡，将棉花般的孢子散播到世界各地，以繁衍更多后代。

entries.source: Once it catches the wind, it deftly controls its cotton-puff spores-- it can even float around the world.
entries.translation: 一旦乘上风，它便会灵巧地操控棉絮般的孢子，甚至能飘浮着环游世界。

entries.source: Sunkern tries to move as little as it possibly can. It does so because it tries to conserve all the nutrients it has stored in its body for its evolution. It will not eat a thing, subsisting only on morning dew.
entries.translation: 向日种子会尽可能少地活动。它这样做，是为了把体内储存的全部营养留到进化时使用。它什么也不吃，只靠晨露维生。

entries.source: It lives by drinking only dewdrops from under the leaves of plants. It is said that it eats nothing else.
entries.translation: 它只饮用植物叶片下的露珠维生。据说除此之外，它什么也不吃。

entries.source: It may plummet from the sky. If attacked by a Spearow, it will violently shake its leaves.
entries.translation: 它可能会从空中骤然坠落。如果遭到烈雀袭击，它便会猛烈摇动叶片。

entries.source: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. Knowing it’s weak, it simply feeds until it evolves.
entries.translation: 它会在早晨突然从空中掉下来。它知道自己很弱，因此只顾着进食，直到进化为止。

entries.source: It suddenly falls out of the sky in the morning. A year after a cold summer, their population explodes.
entries.translation: 它会在早晨突然从空中掉下来。经历寒冷夏季后的第二年，它们的数量会激增。

entries.source: Sunflora converts solar energy into nutrition. It moves around actively in the daytime when it is warm. It stops moving as soon as the sun goes down for the night.
entries.translation: 向日花怪会把太阳能转化为营养。白天天气温暖时，它会活跃地四处活动。太阳下山进入夜晚后，它便立刻停止活动。

entries.source: It gets energy from warm sunlight and is known for its habit of moving in pursuit of it.
entries.translation: 它从温暖的阳光中获取能量，并以追逐阳光的习性而闻名。

entries.source: As the hot season approaches, the petals on this Pokémon’s face become more vivid and lively.
entries.translation: 随着炎热季节临近，这种宝可梦脸上的花瓣会变得更加鲜艳而富有生气。

entries.source: Since it converts sunlight into energy, it is always looking in the direction of the sun.
entries.translation: 由于它会把阳光转化为能量，因此总是朝着太阳的方向。

entries.source: In the daytime, it rushes about in a hectic manner, but it comes to a complete stop when the sun sets.
entries.translation: 白天，它会忙乱地四处奔走，但太阳落山后便会完全停止活动。

entries.source: Its frail wings are so thin that one can see clear through them. However, during flight these wings exhibit the power to churn air with force enough to launch a house skyward.
entries.translation: 它脆弱的翅膀薄得近乎透明。然而，飞行时，这双翅膀却能搅动空气，爆发出足以将房屋掀上天空的力量。

entries.source: Yanma is capable of seeing 360 degrees without having to move its eyes. It is a great flier that is adept at making sudden stops and turning midair. This Pokémon uses its flying ability to quickly chase down targeted prey.
entries.translation: 蜻蜻蜓不必转动眼睛便能看遍四面八方。它飞行本领高超，擅长在空中急停和转向。这种宝可梦会凭借飞行能力迅速追上锁定的猎物。

entries.source: If it flaps its wings really fast, it can generate shock waves that will shatter windows in the area.
entries.translation: 如果它飞快地扇动翅膀，就能产生震碎附近窗户的冲击波。

entries.source: Its eyes can see 360 degrees without moving its head. It won’t miss prey--even those behind it.
entries.translation: 它不必转头，双眼便能看遍四面八方。即使猎物在身后，它也不会错过。

entries.source: By flapping its wings at high speed, it can fly freely through the air. Even sudden stops are no problem.
entries.translation: 它通过高速扇动翅膀，自如地翱翔空中。就连急停也不成问题。

entries.source: It is hard to believe these strangely shaped Pokémon are truly living creatures. I've pointed out that the species' many forms resemble writing from other lands; no one will take me seriously.
entries.translation: 这些形状奇特的宝可梦竟真的是生物，实在令人难以置信。我曾指出，这一物种的众多形态与异国文字相似，却没有人把我的话当真。

entries.source: This Pokémon is shaped like ancient writing. It is a mystery as to which came first, the ancient writings or the various Unown. Research into this topic is ongoing but nothing is known.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦的形状宛如古代文字。究竟是古代文字还是各种未知图腾先出现，至今仍是个谜。对此课题的研究仍在继续，但目前一无所知。

entries.source: Shaped like ancient writing, it is a huge mystery whether language or Unown came first.
entries.translation: 它的形状宛如古代文字，究竟是语言还是未知图腾先出现，仍是个巨大的谜团。

entries.source: Its flat, thin body is always stuck on walls. Its shape appears to have some meaning.
entries.translation: 它扁平而单薄的身体总是贴在墙上。它的形状似乎具有某种含义。

entries.source: When alone, nothing happens. However, if there are two or more, an odd power is said to emerge.
entries.translation: 单独一个时，什么也不会发生。然而，据说只要有两个以上，便会涌现出奇异的力量。

entries.source: Girafarig’s rear head contains a tiny brain that is too small for thinking. However, the rear head doesn’t need to sleep, so it can keep watch over its surroundings 24 hours a day.
entries.translation: 麒麟奇后面的头里有一个很小的脑，因过于微小而无法思考。不过，后面的头不需要睡觉，因此能一天24小时监视周围。

entries.source: Girafarig’s rear head also has a brain, but it is small. The rear head attacks in response to smells and sounds. Approaching this Pokémon from behind can cause the rear head to suddenly lash out and bite.
entries.translation: 麒麟奇后面的头也有脑，但很小。后面的头会对气味和声音作出反应并发动攻击。从背后接近这种宝可梦，可能会使后面的头突然扑过来撕咬。

entries.source: Its tail has a small brain of its own. Beware! If you get close, it may react to your scent by biting.
entries.translation: 它的尾巴有一个自己的小脑。小心！如果靠近，它可能会对你的气味作出反应并咬过来。

entries.source: While it sleeps, the head on its tail keeps watch. The tail doesn’t need to sleep.
entries.translation: 它睡觉时，尾巴上的头会负责警戒。那条尾巴不需要睡觉。

entries.source: The head on its tail contains a small brain. It can instinctively fight even while facing backward.
entries.translation: 它尾巴上的头里有一个小脑。即使背对对手，它也能凭本能战斗。

entries.source: Its tail is tipped by a thick, horrible stinger. To bring down prey, it will first obscure their vision by covering their faces with its body, and then it will use the stinger to inject them with venom.
entries.translation: 它的尾端长着一根粗大而骇人的毒针。为了击倒猎物，它会先用身体盖住对方的脸，遮蔽其视线，再用毒针将毒液注入对方体内。

entries.source: Gligar glides through the air without a sound as if it were sliding. This Pokémon hangs on to the face of its foe using its clawed hind legs and the large pincers on its forelegs, then injects the prey with its poison barb.
entries.translation: 天蝎如同滑行一般，无声无息地在空中翱翔。这种宝可梦会用带爪的后脚和前脚上的巨大钳子紧紧攀住对手的脸，随后用毒刺将毒液注入猎物体内。

entries.source: It flies straight at its target’s face, then clamps down on the startled victim to inject poison.
entries.translation: 它会径直飞向目标的脸，随后紧紧夹住受惊的猎物并注入毒液。

entries.source: It usually clings to cliffs. When it spots its prey, it spreads its wings and glides down to attack.
entries.translation: 它平时会攀附在悬崖上。发现猎物后，便会展开翅膀滑翔而下发动攻击。

entries.source: It clamps on to its chosen prey then jabs the stinger on its tail into the prey while it’s stunned with surprise.
entries.translation: 它会紧紧夹住所选的猎物，趁对方惊愕之际，将尾巴上的毒针刺入其体内。

entries.source: It licks its paws because of the sweet honey that has soaked into them. It is cunning, stealing into the nests of Combee and taking for itself the honey that the Combee have amassed.
entries.translation: 它会舔舐爪子，因为爪子里浸满了甜甜的蜂蜜。它十分狡猾，会偷偷潜入三蜜蜂的巢穴，把三蜜蜂积攒的蜂蜜据为己有。

entries.source: This Pokémon likes to lick its palms that are sweetened by being soaked in honey. Teddiursa concocts its own honey by blending fruits and pollen collected by Beedrill.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦喜欢舔舐被蜂蜜浸甜的掌心。熊宝宝会把水果与大针蜂采集的花粉混合起来，调制自己的蜂蜜。

entries.source: Before food becomes scarce in wintertime, its habit is to hoard food in many hidden locations.
entries.translation: 在冬季食物变得匮乏之前，它习惯把食物储藏在许多隐蔽的地方。

entries.source: If it finds honey, its crescent mark glows. It always licks its paws because they’re soaked with honey.
entries.translation: 如果发现蜂蜜，它的新月形花纹就会发光。它总是舔舐爪子，因为爪子里浸满了蜂蜜。

entries.source: It lets honey soak into its paws so it can lick them all the time. Every set of paws tastes unique.
entries.translation: 它会让蜂蜜渗入爪子，以便随时舔舐。每只熊宝宝的爪子味道都各不相同。

entries.source: When the cold season arrives in Hisui, this Pokémon will wander fields and mountains alike in search of its favorite berries. Ursaring's hunger during this time makes it a ferocious danger.
entries.translation: 洗翠的寒冷季节来临时，这种宝可梦会在田野与山间四处游荡，寻找最喜爱的树果。此时饥肠辘辘的圈圈熊凶暴而危险。

entries.source: In the forests inhabited by Ursaring, it is said that there are many streams and towering trees where they gather food. This Pokémon walks through its forest gathering food every day.
entries.translation: 据说在圈圈熊栖息的森林里，有许多它们采集食物的溪流和参天大树。这种宝可梦每天都会在自己的森林里边走边采集食物。

entries.source: Although it has a large body, it is quite skilled at climbing trees. It eats and sleeps in the treetops.
entries.translation: 虽然体型庞大，却很擅长爬树。它会在树梢上进食和睡觉。

entries.source: With its ability to distinguish any aroma, it unfailingly finds all food buried deep underground.
entries.translation: 凭借分辨任何气味的能力，它总能找到深埋在地下的所有食物。

entries.source: In its territory, it leaves scratches on trees that bear delicious berries or fruits.
entries.translation: 在自己的领地里，它会在结有美味树果或水果的树上留下爪痕。

entries.source: Slugma does not have any blood in its body. Instead, intensely hot magma circulates throughout this Pokémon’s body, carrying essential nutrients and oxygen to its organs.
entries.translation: 熔岩虫体内没有任何血液。取而代之的是炽热的岩浆在这只宝可梦全身循环，将必需的营养和氧气输送到各个器官。

entries.source: Molten magma courses throughout Slugma’s circulatory system. If this Pokémon is chilled, the magma cools and hardens. Its body turns brittle and chunks fall off, reducing its size.
entries.translation: 熔化的岩浆在熔岩虫的循环系统中奔流。如果这只宝可梦受寒，岩浆就会冷却凝固。它的身体会变脆并成块脱落，体型也会因此缩小。

entries.source: Its body is made of magma. If it doesn’t keep moving, its body will cool and harden.
entries.translation: 它的身体由岩浆构成。如果不持续活动，身体就会冷却凝固。

entries.source: A common sight in volcanic areas, it slowly slithers around in a constant search for warm places.
entries.translation: 它在火山地带十分常见，会缓慢地爬来爬去，不断寻找温暖的地方。

entries.source: It never sleeps. It has to keep moving because if it stopped, its magma body would cool and harden.
entries.translation: 它从不睡觉。它必须不断活动，因为一旦停下来，岩浆构成的身体就会冷却凝固。

entries.source: Magcargo’s body temperature is approximately 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit. Water is vaporized on contact. If this Pokémon is caught in the rain, the raindrops instantly turn into steam, cloaking the area in a thick fog.
entries.translation: 熔岩蜗牛的体温约为华氏１８０００度。水一接触它就会汽化。如果这只宝可梦被雨淋到，雨滴会瞬间化为蒸汽，让周围笼罩在浓雾之中。

entries.source: Magcargo’s shell is actually its skin that hardened as a result of cooling. Its shell is very brittle and fragile—just touching it causes it to crumble apart. This Pokémon returns to its original size by dipping itself in magma.
entries.translation: 熔岩蜗牛的壳其实是它因冷却而硬化的皮肤。它的壳非常脆弱，光是触碰就会碎裂。这只宝可梦会把身体浸入岩浆，恢复原本的大小。

entries.source: Its body is as hot as lava and is always billowing. Flames will occasionally burst from its shell.
entries.translation: 它的身体像熔岩一样炽热，总是翻腾不止。火焰偶尔会从它的壳中喷出。

entries.source: Its brittle shell occasionally spouts intense flames that circulate throughout its body.
entries.translation: 它脆弱的壳偶尔会喷出在全身循环的猛烈火焰。

entries.source: Its body temperature is roughly 18,000 degrees F. Flames spout from gaps in its hardened shell.
entries.translation: 它的体温约为华氏１８０００度。火焰会从硬壳的缝隙中喷出。

entries.source: Phanpy uses its long nose to shower itself. When others gather around, they thoroughly douse each other with water. These Pokémon can be seen drying their soaking-wet bodies at the edge of water.
entries.translation: 小小象会用长鼻子给自己冲水。伙伴们聚在一起时，会互相泼水，把彼此淋个透湿。人们能看到这些宝可梦在水边晾干湿透的身体。

entries.source: For its nest, Phanpy digs a vertical pit in the ground at the edge of a river. It marks the area around its nest with its trunk to let the others know that the area has been claimed.
entries.translation: 小小象会在河边的地面上挖一个竖直的坑作为巢穴。它会用鼻子在巢穴周围留下标记，告诉其他伙伴这里已有归属。

entries.source: It is strong despite its compact size. It can easily pick up and carry an adult human on its back.
entries.translation: 尽管体型小巧，它却力气很大。它能轻松地把成年人驮在背上。

entries.source: As a sign of affection, it bumps with its snout. However, it is so strong, it may send you flying.
entries.translation: 它会用鼻子顶撞对方来表达亲昵。不过，由于力气太大，可能会把人撞飞。

entries.source: It swings its long snout around playfully, but because it is so strong, that can be dangerous.
entries.translation: 它会顽皮地甩动长鼻子，但由于力气太大，这可能会很危险。

entries.source: If Donphan were to tackle with its hard body, even a house could be destroyed. Using its massive strength, the Pokémon helps clear rock and mud slides that block mountain trails.
entries.translation: 如果顿甲用坚硬的身体冲撞，就连房屋也会被摧毁。这只宝可梦会凭借强大的力量，帮助清除堵塞山路的落石和泥流。

entries.source: Donphan’s favorite attack is curling its body into a ball, then charging at its foe while rolling at high speed. Once it starts rolling, this Pokémon can’t stop very easily.
entries.translation: 顿甲最喜欢的攻击方式是把身体蜷成一团，再高速滚动着冲向敌人。这只宝可梦一旦开始滚动，就很难轻易停下来。

entries.source: The longer and bigger its tusks, the higher its rank in its herd. The tusks take long to grow.
entries.translation: 象牙越长越大，它在族群中的地位就越高。它的象牙需要很长时间才能长成。

entries.source: It has sharp, hard tusks and a rugged hide. Its Tackle is strong enough to knock down a house.
entries.translation: 它长有尖锐坚硬的象牙和粗糙结实的皮肤。它的撞击威力足以撞倒一栋房屋。

entries.source: It attacks by curling up then rolling into its foe. It can blow apart a house in one hit.
entries.translation: 它会蜷起身体，滚向敌人发动攻击。它一击就能将房屋撞得粉碎。

entries.source: Its strangely shaped antlers have the power to bewitch those who see them. Medicine made by grinding up the black orbs from fallen antlers is an effective treatment for insomnia.
entries.translation: 它形状奇特的角拥有迷惑目睹者的力量。将脱落鹿角上的黑色圆珠磨碎制成的药，是治疗失眠的良药。

entries.source: Stantler’s magnificent antlers were traded at high prices as works of art. As a result, this Pokémon was hunted close to extinction by those who were after the priceless antlers.
entries.translation: 惊角鹿华美的角曾作为艺术品以高价交易。因此，这只宝可梦遭到觊觎无价鹿角之人的捕猎，一度濒临灭绝。

entries.source: The curved antlers subtly change the flow of air to create a strange space where reality is distorted.
entries.translation: 弯曲的角会巧妙地改变气流，创造出现实发生扭曲的奇异空间。

entries.source: Staring at its antlers creates an odd sensation as if one were being drawn into their centers.
entries.translation: 凝视它的角，会产生仿佛被吸入角中心的奇异感觉。

entries.source: Those who stare at its antlers will gradually lose control of their senses and be unable to stand.
entries.translation: 凝视它的角的人会逐渐失去对感官的控制，无法站立。

entries.source: Raikou embodies the speed of lightning. The roars of this Pokémon send shock waves shuddering through the air and shake the ground as if lightning bolts had come crashing down.
entries.translation: 雷公体现了闪电的速度。这只宝可梦的咆哮会让冲击波在空气中震荡，并使大地摇晃，仿佛有雷电劈落一般。

entries.source: This rough Pokémon stores energy inside its body, then sweeps across the land, shooting off electricity.
entries.translation: 这只性情粗暴的宝可梦会将能量储存在体内，然后一边释放电流，一边横扫大地。

entries.source: The rain clouds it carries let it fire thunderbolts at will. They say that it descended with lightning.
entries.translation: 它携带的雨云让它能随心所欲地放出雷电。据说它曾伴随闪电降临。

entries.source: It is said to have fallen with lightning. It can fire thunderbolts from the rain clouds on its back.
entries.translation: 据说它曾伴随闪电降临。它能从背上的雨云中放出雷电。

entries.source: A Pokémon that races across the land while barking a cry that sounds like crashing thunder.
entries.translation: 这只宝可梦会发出如同雷鸣般的吼声，在大地上奔驰。

entries.source: Entei embodies the passion of magma. This Pokémon is thought to have been born in the eruption of a volcano. It sends up massive bursts of fire that utterly consume all that they touch.
entries.translation: 炎帝体现了岩浆的炽烈。据说这只宝可梦诞生于火山喷发之中。它会喷起猛烈的巨大火焰，将触及的一切彻底吞噬。

entries.source: It is said that when it roars, a volcano erupts somewhere around the globe.
entries.translation: 据说每当它咆哮时，世界上的某处就会有火山喷发。

entries.source: A Pokémon that races across the land. It is said that one is born every time a new volcano appears.
entries.translation: 这只宝可梦会在大地上奔驰。据说每当有新的火山形成，就会诞生一只炎帝。

entries.source: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to contain its sheer power, it races headlong around the land.
entries.translation: 它一吼叫，火山就会喷发。由于无法抑制自己强大的力量，它会在大地上不顾一切地奔驰。

entries.source: Volcanoes erupt when it barks. Unable to restrain its extreme power, it races headlong around the land.
entries.translation: 它一吼叫，火山就会喷发。由于无法控制自己极其强大的力量，它会在大地上不顾一切地奔驰。

entries.source: Suicune embodies the compassion of a pure spring of water. It runs across the land with gracefulness. This Pokémon has the power to purify dirty water.
entries.translation: 水君体现了清澈泉水的仁慈。它优雅地奔行于大地之上。这只宝可梦拥有净化污水的力量。

entries.source: Said to be the embodiment of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
entries.translation: 据说它是北风的化身，能在瞬间净化污浊不清的水。

entries.source: It races around the world to purify fouled water. It dashes away with the north wind.
entries.translation: 它在世界各地奔驰，以净化受污染的水。它会随着北风疾驰而去。

entries.source: This Pokémon races across the land. It is said that north winds will somehow blow whenever it appears.
entries.translation: 这只宝可梦会在大地上奔驰。据说每当它现身时，不知为何总会刮起北风。

entries.source: Said to be the reincarnation of north winds, it can instantly purify filthy, murky water.
entries.translation: 据说它是北风的转世，能在瞬间净化污浊不清的水。

entries.source: Lugia’s wings pack devastating power—a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart regular houses. As a result, this Pokémon chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.
entries.translation: 洛奇亚的翅膀蕴藏着毁灭性的力量，只要轻轻扇动就能吹毁普通的房屋。因此，这只宝可梦选择隐居在不为人知的深海之中。

entries.source: It is said to be the guardian of the seas. It is rumored to have been seen on the night of a storm.
entries.translation: 据说它是海洋的守护神。传闻有人曾在暴风雨之夜见过它。

entries.source: It sleeps in a deep-sea trench. If it flaps its wings, it is said to cause a 40-day storm.
entries.translation: 它沉睡在深海海沟中。据说只要它扇动翅膀，就会引发持续４０天的暴风雨。

entries.source: It is said that it quietly spends its time deep at the bottom of the sea because its powers are too strong.
entries.translation: 据说因为力量过于强大，它会在深邃的海底静静度日。

entries.source: LUGIA is so powerful even a light fluttering of its wings can blow apart houses. As a result, it chooses to live out of sight deep under the sea.
entries.translation: 洛奇亚的力量极其强大，即使只是轻轻扇动翅膀，也能吹毁房屋。因此，它选择隐居在不为人知的深海之中。

entries.source: Ho-Oh’s feathers glow in seven colors depending on the angle at which they are struck by light. These feathers are said to bring happiness to the bearers. This Pokémon is said to live at the foot of a rainbow.
entries.translation: 凤王的羽毛会依照光线照射角度的不同，闪耀出七种颜色。据说这些羽毛能为持有者带来幸福。据说这只宝可梦生活在彩虹的脚下。

entries.source: It will reveal itself before a pure-hearted Trainer by shining its bright, rainbow-colored wings.
entries.translation: 它会展开明亮的虹色翅膀，现身在心灵纯洁的训练家面前。

entries.source: A legend says that its body glows in seven colors. A rainbow is said to form behind it when it flies.
entries.translation: 传说它的身体会闪耀七彩光芒。据说它飞翔时，身后会形成彩虹。

entries.source: Its feathers are in seven colors. It is said that anyone seeing it is promised eternal happiness.
entries.translation: 它的羽毛有七种颜色。据说见到它的人会获得永恒的幸福。

entries.source: Legends claim this Pokémon flies the world’s skies continuously on its magnificent, seven-colored wings.
entries.translation: 传说这种宝可梦会用华美的七彩翅膀，不停地翱翔于世界各地的天空。

entries.source: Treecko is cool, calm, and collected—it never panics under any situation. If a bigger foe were to glare at this Pokémon, it would glare right back without conceding an inch of ground.
entries.translation: 木守宫沉着冷静，无论遇到什么情况都不会慌张。即使体型更大的敌人瞪着它，它也会毫不退让地瞪回去。

entries.source: Treecko has small hooks on the bottom of its feet that enable it to scale vertical walls. This Pokémon attacks by slamming foes with its thick tail.
entries.translation: 木守宫脚底长有小钩，能让它攀上垂直的墙壁。这种宝可梦会用粗大的尾巴猛击敌人。

entries.source: Small hooks on the bottom of its feet catch on walls and ceilings. That is how it can hang from above.
entries.translation: 它脚底的小钩能钩住墙壁和天花板。它就是这样悬挂在高处的。

entries.source: It quickly scales even vertical walls. It senses humidity with its tail to predict the next day’s weather.
entries.translation: 即使是垂直的墙壁，它也能迅速攀爬。它会用尾巴感知湿度，预测第二天的天气。

entries.source: The soles of its feet are covered by countless tiny spikes, enabling it to walk on walls and ceilings.
entries.translation: 它的脚底布满无数细小的刺，因此能在墙壁和天花板上行走。

entries.source: This Pokémon adeptly flies from branch to branch in trees. In a forest, no Pokémon can ever hope to catch a fleeing Grovyle however fast they may be.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦能灵巧地在树枝间飞跃。在森林里，无论速度多快的宝可梦，都休想追上正在逃跑的森林蜥蜴。

entries.source: The leaves growing out of Grovyle’s body are convenient for camouflaging it from enemies in the forest. This Pokémon is a master at climbing trees in jungles.
entries.translation: 森林蜥蜴身上长出的叶子便于它在森林中伪装，躲避敌人。这种宝可梦是攀爬丛林树木的高手。

entries.source: It lives in dense jungles. While closing in on its prey, it leaps from branch to branch.
entries.translation: 它生活在茂密的丛林里。接近猎物时，它会在树枝间来回跳跃。

entries.source: Its strongly developed thigh muscles give it astounding agility and jumping performance.
entries.translation: 发达有力的大腿肌肉赋予了它惊人的敏捷性和跳跃能力。

entries.source: It leaps from tree branch to tree branch quite swiftly. It shows astounding agility.
entries.translation: 它能相当迅速地从一根树枝跃到另一根树枝。它展现出的敏捷性令人惊叹。

entries.source: Sceptile has seeds growing on its back. They are said to be bursting with nutrients that revitalize trees. This Pokémon raises the trees in a forest with loving care.
entries.translation: 蜥蜴王的背上长着种子。据说其中富含能让树木恢复活力的营养。它会悉心照料森林里的树木。

entries.source: The leaves growing on Sceptile’s body are very sharp edged. This Pokémon is very agile—it leaps all over the branches of trees and jumps on its foe from above or behind.
entries.translation: 蜥蜴王身上长出的叶片边缘十分锋利。这种宝可梦非常敏捷，会在树枝间四处跳跃，从上方或后方扑向敌人。

entries.source: It agilely leaps about the jungle and uses the sharp leaves on its arms to strike its prey.
entries.translation: 它在丛林中敏捷地来回跳跃，用手臂上锋利的叶片攻击猎物。

entries.source: The leaves that grow on its arms can slice down thick trees. It is without peer in jungle combat.
entries.translation: 长在它手臂上的叶片能够斩断粗壮的树木。在丛林战斗中，它所向无敌。

entries.source: The leaves on its forelegs are as sharp as swords. It agilely leaps about the branches of trees to strike.
entries.translation: 它前肢上的叶片像剑一样锋利。它会敏捷地穿梭于树枝之间发动攻击。

entries.source: Torchic has a place inside its body where it keeps its flame. Give it a hug—it will be glowing with warmth. This Pokémon is covered all over by a fluffy coat of down.
entries.translation: 火稚鸡体内有一个储存火焰的部位。抱住它时，会感到暖烘烘的。这种宝可梦全身覆盖着蓬松的绒毛。

entries.source: Torchic sticks with its Trainer, following behind with unsteady steps. This Pokémon breathes fire of over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit, including fireballs that leave the foe scorched black.
entries.translation: 火稚鸡会紧跟着训练家，迈着不稳的步子走在后面。这种宝可梦能吐出超过华氏１８００度的火焰，其中的火球会把敌人烧得焦黑。

entries.source: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit.
entries.translation: 它体内燃烧着火焰，所以抱起来非常温暖。它会发射华氏１８００度的火球。

entries.source: It has a flame sac inside its belly that perpetually burns. It feels warm if it is hugged.
entries.translation: 它腹部有一个永远燃烧着的火焰囊。抱住它时会觉得很温暖。

entries.source: A fire burns inside, so it feels very warm to hug. It launches fireballs of 1,800 degrees F.
entries.translation: 它体内燃烧着火焰，所以抱起来非常温暖。它会发射华氏１８００度的火球。

entries.source: Combusken battles with the intensely hot flames it spews from its beak and with outstandingly destructive kicks. This Pokémon’s cry is very loud and distracting.
entries.translation: 力壮鸡会用从喙中喷出的灼热火焰和破坏力惊人的踢击战斗。这种宝可梦的叫声十分响亮，会扰乱对手。

entries.source: Combusken toughens up its legs and thighs by running through fields and mountains. This Pokémon’s legs possess both speed and power, enabling it to dole out 10 kicks in one second.
entries.translation: 力壮鸡会奔跑于山野之间，锻炼腿部和大腿。这种宝可梦的双腿兼具速度与力量，能在１秒内连续踢出１０次。

entries.source: During a battle, the hot flame in its body increases. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.
entries.translation: 战斗时，它体内的火焰会燃烧得更加旺盛。它的踢击具有惊人的破坏力。

entries.source: Its kicking mastery lets it loose 10 kicks per second. It emits sharp cries to intimidate foes.
entries.translation: 它精通踢击，能在每秒内踢出１０次。它会发出尖锐的叫声威吓敌人。

entries.source: It boosts its concentration by emitting harsh cries. Its kicks have outstanding destructive power.
entries.translation: 它会发出刺耳的叫声来提高专注力。它的踢击具有惊人的破坏力。

entries.source: Blaziken has incredibly strong legs—it can easily clear a 30-story building in one leap. This Pokémon’s blazing punches leave its foes scorched and blackened.
entries.translation: 火焰鸡的腿力强得惊人，一跃就能轻松越过３０层高的大楼。这种宝可梦燃烧着火焰的拳头会把敌人烧得焦黑。

entries.source: In battle, Blaziken blows out intense flames from its wrists and attacks foes courageously. The stronger the foe, the more intensely this Pokémon’s wrists burn.
entries.translation: 战斗时，火焰鸡会从手腕喷出猛烈的火焰，勇敢地攻击敌人。敌人越强，这种宝可梦手腕上的火焰就燃烧得越猛烈。

entries.source: When facing a tough foe, it looses flames from its wrists. Its powerful legs let it jump clear over buildings.
entries.translation: 面对强敌时，它会从手腕释放火焰。强健的双腿让它能一跃越过高楼。

entries.source: It can clear a 30-story building in a leap. Its fiery punches scorch its foes.
entries.translation: 它一跃就能越过３０层高的大楼。它燃烧着火焰的拳头会灼烧敌人。

entries.source: Flames spout from its wrists, enveloping its knuckles. Its punches scorch its foes.
entries.translation: 火焰会从它的手腕喷出，包裹住拳头。它的拳击会灼烧敌人。

entries.source: In water, Mudkip breathes using the gills on its cheeks. If it is faced with a tight situation in battle, this Pokémon will unleash its amazing power—it can crush rocks bigger than itself.
entries.translation: 在水中，水跃鱼会用脸颊上的鳃呼吸。如果在战斗中陷入困境，这种宝可梦就会释放惊人的力量，连比自己还大的岩石也能粉碎。

entries.source: The fin on Mudkip’s head acts as highly sensitive radar. Using this fin to sense movements of water and air, this Pokémon can determine what is taking place around it without using its eyes.
entries.translation: 水跃鱼头上的鳍就像灵敏度极高的雷达。这种宝可梦会用鳍感知水流和气流，即使不用眼睛也能判断周围发生的事。

entries.source: To alert it, the fin on its head senses the flow of water. It has the strength to heft boulders.
entries.translation: 头上的鳍会感知水流，向它发出警示。它拥有举起巨石的力量。

entries.source: Its large tail fin propels it through water with powerful acceleration. It is strong in spite of its size.
entries.translation: 它巨大的尾鳍能产生强劲的加速力，推动它在水中前进。别看它体型小，力气却很大。

entries.source: Its power can crush boulders. It rests by covering itself with mud at the bottom of a river.
entries.translation: 它的力量足以粉碎巨石。休息时，它会在河底用泥巴盖住身体。

entries.source: Marshtomp is much faster at traveling through mud than it is at swimming. This Pokémon’s hindquarters exhibit obvious development, giving it the ability to walk on just its hind legs.
entries.translation: 沼跃鱼在泥中移动的速度远快于游泳。这种宝可梦的后半身明显发达，因此能只靠后腿行走。

entries.source: The surface of Marshtomp’s body is enveloped by a thin, sticky film that enables it to live on land. This Pokémon plays in mud on beaches when the ocean tide is low.
entries.translation: 沼跃鱼的身体表面覆盖着一层又薄又黏的膜，使它能够在陆地上生活。退潮时，这种宝可梦会在海滩的泥地里玩耍。

entries.source: Living on muddy ground that provides poor footing has made its legs sturdy.
entries.translation: 由于生活在难以站稳的泥地上，它的双腿变得十分强健。

entries.source: Its sturdy legs give it sure footing, even in mud. It burrows into dirt to sleep.
entries.translation: 强健的双腿让它即使身处泥地也能稳稳站立。它会钻进土里睡觉。

entries.source: It is at its best when on muddy ground with poor footing. It quickly overwhelms foes struggling in mud.
entries.translation: 在难以站稳的泥地上，它最能发挥实力。它会迅速压制在泥中挣扎的敌人。

entries.source: Swampert predicts storms by sensing subtle differences in the sounds of waves and tidal winds with its fins. If a storm is approaching, it piles up boulders to protect itself.
entries.translation: 巨沼怪会用鳍感知海浪声和潮风声的细微差异，以预测暴风雨。暴风雨将至时，它会堆起巨石保护自己。

entries.source: Swampert is very strong. It has enough power to easily drag a boulder weighing more than a ton. This Pokémon also has powerful vision that lets it see even in murky water.
entries.translation: 巨沼怪力大无穷。它的力量足以轻松拖动重达１吨以上的巨石。这种宝可梦的视力也很敏锐，即使在浑浊的水中也能看清。

entries.source: It can swim while towing a large ship. It bashes down foes with a swing of its thick arms.
entries.translation: 它能拖着大型船只游泳。它会挥动粗壮的手臂击倒敌人。

entries.source: Its arms are hard as rock. With one swing, it can break a boulder into pieces.
entries.translation: 它的手臂坚硬如岩石。只需一挥，就能把巨石击得粉碎。

entries.source: Its arms are rock-hard. With one swing, they can batter down its foe. It makes its nest on beautiful beaches.
entries.translation: 它的手臂坚硬如岩石。只需一挥，就能把敌人击倒。它会在美丽的海滩上筑巢。

entries.source: Poochyena is an omnivore—it will eat anything. A distinguishing feature is how large its fangs are compared to its body. This Pokémon tries to intimidate its foes by making the hair on its tail bristle out.
entries.translation: 土狼犬是杂食性宝可梦，什么都吃。与身体相比格外巨大的獠牙是它的显著特征。它会竖起尾巴上的毛，试图吓唬敌人。

entries.source: At first sight, Poochyena takes a bite at anything that moves. This Pokémon chases after prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it may turn tail if the prey strikes back.
entries.translation: 土狼犬一看到会动的东西就会扑上去咬。它会追赶猎物，直到对方精疲力竭。不过，如果猎物反击，它也可能掉头逃跑。

entries.source: It has a very tenacious nature. Its acute sense of smell lets it chase a chosen prey without ever losing track.
entries.translation: 它的性情非常执着。凭借敏锐的嗅觉，它能紧追选定的猎物，绝不会跟丢。

entries.source: A Pokémon with a persistent nature, it chases its chosen prey until the prey becomes exhausted.
entries.translation: 它是性情执着的宝可梦，会追赶选定的猎物，直到对方精疲力竭。

entries.source: It chases its prey until the victim becomes exhausted. However, it turns tail if the prey strikes back.
entries.translation: 它会追赶猎物，直到对方精疲力竭。不过，如果猎物反击，它就会掉头逃跑。

entries.source: Mightyena travel and act as a pack in the wild. The memory of its life in the wild compels the Pokémon to obey only those Trainers that it recognizes to possess superior skill.
entries.translation: 野生的大狼犬会成群结队地行动。野外生活的记忆驱使它只服从自己认可为本领高强的训练家。

entries.source: Mightyena gives obvious signals when it is preparing to attack. It starts to growl deeply and then flattens its body. This Pokémon will bite savagely with its sharply pointed fangs.
entries.translation: 大狼犬准备攻击时会发出明显的信号。它会先发出低沉的吼声，然后压低身体。它会用尖锐的獠牙凶猛地撕咬。

entries.source: It chases down prey in a pack of around ten. They defeat foes with perfectly coordinated teamwork.
entries.translation: 它们会组成约十只的群体追捕猎物。它们以配合无间的团队协作击败敌人。

entries.source: It will always obey the commands of a skilled Trainer. Its behavior arises from its living in packs in ancient times.
entries.translation: 它总会服从本领高强的训练家的命令。这种习性源于它在远古时代的群居生活。

entries.source: It chases down prey in a pack. It will never disobey the commands of a skilled Trainer.
entries.translation: 它会成群追捕猎物。它绝不会违抗本领高强的训练家的命令。

entries.source: Likes sap and is abundant in the wild. Why it evolves into various different forms is unknown. One cannot tell from a Wurmple's appearance which form it will take when it evolves.
entries.translation: 它喜欢树汁，在野外很常见。它为何会进化成各种不同的形态，至今仍是个谜。仅凭刺尾虫的外表，无法判断它会进化成哪种形态。

entries.source: Wurmple is targeted by Swellow as prey. This Pokémon will try to resist by pointing the spikes on its rear at the attacking predator. It will weaken the foe by leaking poison from the spikes.
entries.translation: 刺尾虫会被大王燕当作猎物。它会把尾部的尖刺朝向来袭的捕食者，试图进行抵抗。它会从尖刺中渗出毒液，削弱敌人。

entries.source: Using the spikes on its rear end, Wurmple peels the bark off trees and feeds on the sap that oozes out. This Pokémon’s feet are tipped with suction pads that allow it to cling to glass without slipping.
entries.translation: 刺尾虫会用尾部的尖刺剥开树皮，吸食渗出的树汁。它的足尖长有吸盘，即使攀附在玻璃上也不会滑落。

entries.source: It lives among the tall grass and in forests. It repels attacks by raising up the spikes on its rear.
entries.translation: 它生活在茂密的草丛和森林里。它会竖起尾部的尖刺来击退攻击。

entries.source: It loves to eat leaves. If it is attacked by a Starly, it will defend itself with its spiked rear.
entries.translation: 它很喜欢吃树叶。如果遭到姆克儿攻击，就会用带刺的尾部保护自己。

entries.source: Wraps itself in thin strings of silk while it stores energy for evolution. It can't extend its limbs and its movement is slow, but its eyes keep a sharp lookout—Silcoon is always on guard.
entries.translation: 它用细细的丝线包裹身体，同时储存进化所需的能量。它无法伸展四肢，行动也很迟缓，但双眼始终敏锐地观察四周——甲壳茧时刻保持着戒备。

entries.source: Silcoon was thought to endure hunger and not consume anything before its evolution. However, it is now thought that this Pokémon slakes its thirst by drinking rainwater that collects on its silk.
entries.translation: 过去人们认为，甲壳茧在进化前会忍受饥饿，什么也不吃。然而如今人们认为，这种宝可梦会饮用积在丝上的雨水来解渴。

entries.source: Silcoon tethers itself to a tree branch using silk to keep from falling. There, this Pokémon hangs quietly while it awaits evolution. It peers out of the silk cocoon through a small hole.
entries.translation: 甲壳茧用丝将自己固定在树枝上，以免掉落。它安静地悬挂在那里，等待进化。它会透过丝茧上的小孔向外窥视。

entries.source: It drinks dew that collects on its silk and waits for evolution. Its hard cocoon repels attacks.
entries.translation: 它饮用积在丝上的露水，等待进化。坚硬的茧能抵挡攻击。

entries.source: It wraps silk around the branches of a tree. It drinks rainwater on its silk while awaiting evolution.
entries.translation: 它把丝缠绕在树枝上。等待进化时，它会饮用积在丝上的雨水。

entries.source: A colorful and incredibly beautiful but also greedy Pokémon. In an effort to keep its favorite food all to itself, it will chase away Combee as they try to gather nectar.
entries.translation: 这是一种色彩斑斓、无比美丽，却也十分贪心的宝可梦。为了独占最喜欢的食物，它会赶走前来采蜜的三蜜蜂。

entries.source: Beautifly has a long mouth like a coiled needle, which is very convenient for collecting pollen from flowers. This Pokémon rides the spring winds as it flits around gathering pollen.
entries.translation: 狩猎凤蝶有着如盘绕细针般的长嘴，非常适合采集花朵的花粉。这种宝可梦乘着春风轻盈飞舞，四处采集花粉。

entries.source: Beautifly’s favorite food is the sweet pollen of flowers. If you want to see this Pokémon, just leave a potted flower by an open window. Beautifly is sure to come looking for pollen.
entries.translation: 狩猎凤蝶最喜欢吃花朵的甜美花粉。如果想见到这种宝可梦，只要在敞开的窗边放上一盆花。狩猎凤蝶一定会前来寻找花粉。

entries.source: It has an aggressive nature. It stabs prey with its long, narrow mouth to drain the prey’s fluids.
entries.translation: 它性情好斗。会用细长的嘴刺入猎物体内，吸取其体液。

entries.source: Vibrantly patterned wings are its prominent feature. It sucks sweet flower nectar with its long mouth.
entries.translation: 色彩鲜艳、花纹繁复的翅膀是它最显眼的特征。它会用长嘴吸食甜美的花蜜。

entries.source: The silk coating its body is thin but sufficiently strong. Cascoon's silk has a luster and texture superior to that of Silcoon's, and clothes made using Cascoon silk are regarded as top-notch.
entries.translation: 包裹它身体的丝虽薄，却足够坚韧。盾甲茧的丝在光泽和质感上都胜过甲壳茧的丝，用其制成的衣物被视为上品。

entries.source: If it is attacked, Cascoon remains motionless however badly it may be hurt. It does so because if it were to move, its body would be weak upon evolution. This Pokémon will also not forget the pain it endured.
entries.translation: 受到攻击时，无论伤得多重，盾甲茧都会一动不动。因为一旦动弹，进化后的身体就会变得虚弱。这种宝可梦也绝不会忘记自己承受过的痛苦。

entries.source: Cascoon makes its protective cocoon by wrapping its body entirely with a fine silk from its mouth. Once the silk goes around its body, it hardens. This Pokémon prepares for its evolution inside the cocoon.
entries.translation: 盾甲茧会从口中吐出细丝，将全身完全包裹起来，制成保护自己的茧。丝缠满身体后便会变硬。这种宝可梦会在茧中为进化做准备。

entries.source: It never forgets any attack it endured while in the cocoon. After evolution, it seeks payback.
entries.translation: 它绝不会忘记在茧中承受过的任何攻击。进化后，它会寻求报复。

entries.source: Its body, which is made of soft silk, hardens over time. When cracks appear, evolution is near.
entries.translation: 它由柔软丝线构成的身体会随时间逐渐变硬。当身体出现裂痕时，就意味着进化临近了。

entries.source: Tends to be drawn to bonfires on dark nights. Difficult to chase away from settlements because of the way it scatters highly toxic scales.
entries.translation: 在漆黑的夜晚，它容易被篝火吸引。由于会四处撒播剧毒的鳞粉，很难将它赶离聚居地。

entries.source: When Dustox flaps its wings, a fine dust is scattered all over. This dust is actually a powerful poison that will even make a pro wrestler sick. This Pokémon searches for food using its antennae like radar.
entries.translation: 毒粉蛾振动翅膀时，会将细微的粉尘撒得到处都是。这些粉尘其实是强力的毒素，就连职业摔角手也会因此感到不适。这种宝可梦会像使用雷达一样，用触角寻找食物。

entries.source: Dustox is instinctively drawn to light. Swarms of this Pokémon are attracted by the bright lights of cities, where they wreak havoc by stripping the leaves off roadside trees for food.
entries.translation: 毒粉蛾会本能地受到光亮吸引。成群的这种宝可梦会被城市的明亮灯光吸引，并将行道树的叶子一扫而空，造成严重破坏。

entries.source: It violently flutters its wings to scatter toxic dust when attacked. It becomes active after sunset.
entries.translation: 受到攻击时，它会猛烈振翅，撒播有毒的粉尘。日落后便会开始活动。

entries.source: A nocturnal Pokémon. Drawn by streetlights, they messily eat the leaves of trees lining boulevards.
entries.translation: 它是夜行性的宝可梦。受到路灯吸引后，它们会把林荫大道两旁树木的叶子啃得一片狼藉。

entries.source: Taillow is young—it has only just left its nest. As a result, it sometimes becomes lonesome and cries at night. This Pokémon feeds on Wurmple that live in forests.
entries.translation: 傲骨燕还很年幼，才刚刚离巢。因此，它有时会感到寂寞，在夜里啼叫。这种宝可梦以生活在森林里的刺尾虫为食。

entries.source: Taillow courageously stands its ground against foes, however strong they may be. This gutsy Pokémon will remain defiant even after a loss. On the other hand, it cries loudly if it becomes hungry.
entries.translation: 无论对手多么强大，傲骨燕都会勇敢地挺身对抗。这种勇猛的宝可梦即使落败，也依然毫不屈服。另一方面，它肚子饿时会大声啼叫。

entries.source: It dislikes cold seasons. They migrate to other lands in search of warmth, flying over 180 miles a day.
entries.translation: 它不喜欢寒冷的季节。为了寻找温暖的地方，它们会迁徙到其他地区，每天飞行超过180英里。

entries.source: It has a gutsy spirit that makes it bravely take on tough foes. It flies in search of warm climates.
entries.translation: 它性情勇猛，敢于挑战强敌。它会为了寻找温暖的气候而飞翔。

entries.source: When it gets cold, they migrate, flying over 180 miles a day. It hunts for tasty prey.
entries.translation: 天气变冷时，它们就会迁徙，每天飞行超过180英里。它会寻找美味的猎物。

entries.source: Swellow is very conscientious about the upkeep of its glossy wings. Once two Swellow are gathered, they diligently take care of cleaning each other’s wings.
entries.translation: 大王燕会非常用心地保养自己光亮的翅膀。两只大王燕聚在一起时，会勤快地替彼此清理翅膀。

entries.source: Swellow flies high above our heads, making graceful arcs in the sky. This Pokémon dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. The hapless prey is tightly grasped by Swellow’s clawed feet, preventing escape.
entries.translation: 大王燕会在我们头顶的高空中划出优美的弧线飞翔。这种宝可梦一发现猎物，就会以陡峭的角度俯冲而下。不幸的猎物会被大王燕带爪的双脚牢牢抓住，无法逃脱。

entries.source: It dives at a steep angle as soon as it spots its prey. It catches its prey with sharp claws.
entries.translation: 它一发现猎物，就会以陡峭的角度俯冲而下。它会用锋利的爪子抓住猎物。

entries.source: If its two tail feathers are standing at attention, it is proof of good health. It soars elegantly in the sky.
entries.translation: 如果两根尾羽挺拔竖立，就证明它很健康。它会优雅地翱翔于天空。

entries.source: It circles the sky in search of prey. When it spots one, it dives steeply to catch the prey.
entries.translation: 它会在空中盘旋寻找猎物。一旦发现猎物，便会急速俯冲将其捕获。

entries.source: If Shroomish senses danger, it shakes its body and scatters spores from the top of its head. This Pokémon’s spores are so toxic, they make trees and weeds wilt.
entries.translation: 蘑蘑菇察觉到危险时，会摇晃身体，从头顶撒出孢子。这种宝可梦的孢子毒性极强，甚至能使树木和杂草枯萎。

entries.source: Shroomish live in damp soil in the dark depths of forests. They are often found keeping still under fallen leaves. This Pokémon feeds on compost that is made up of fallen, rotted leaves.
entries.translation: 蘑蘑菇生活在森林幽暗深处的潮湿土壤中。人们常发现它们一动不动地待在落叶下面。这种宝可梦以腐烂落叶形成的腐殖质为食。

entries.source: It spouts poison spores from the top of its head. These spores cause pain all over if inhaled.
entries.translation: 它会从头顶喷出毒孢子。吸入这些孢子后，全身都会感到疼痛。

entries.source: It prefers damp places. By day it remains still in the forest shade. It releases toxic powder from its head.
entries.translation: 它喜欢潮湿的地方。白天会一动不动地待在森林的树荫下。它会从头部释放有毒粉末。

entries.source: If it senses danger, it scatters spores from the top of its head to protect itself.
entries.translation: 察觉到危险时，它会从头顶撒出孢子来保护自己。

entries.source: The seeds ringing Breloom’s tail are made of hardened toxic spores. It is horrible to eat the seeds. Just taking a bite of this Pokémon’s seed will cause your stomach to rumble.
entries.translation: 环绕在斗笠菇尾部的种子是由硬化的毒孢子形成的。这些种子非常难吃。只要咬一口这种宝可梦的种子，肚子就会咕咕作响。

entries.source: Breloom closes in on its foe with light and sprightly footwork, then throws punches with its stretchy arms. This Pokémon’s fighting technique puts boxers to shame.
entries.translation: 斗笠菇会以轻快灵活的步法逼近对手，再用能够伸长的手臂挥拳攻击。这种宝可梦的格斗技巧令拳击手也自愧不如。

entries.source: It scatters poisonous spores and throws powerful punches while its foe is hampered by inhaled spores.
entries.translation: 它会撒出毒孢子，趁对手因吸入孢子而行动受阻时挥出强力的拳头。

entries.source: Its short arms stretch when it throws punches. Its technique is equal to that of pro boxers.
entries.translation: 它短小的手臂会在挥拳时伸长。其技巧足以媲美职业拳击手。

entries.source: The seeds on its tail are made of toxic spores. It knocks out foes with quick, virtually invisible punches.
entries.translation: 它尾部的种子由毒孢子形成。它会用快到几乎看不见的拳头击倒对手。

entries.source: Slakoth’s heart beats just once a minute. Whatever happens, it is content to loaf around motionless. It is rare to see this Pokémon in motion.
entries.translation: 懒人獭的心脏每分钟只跳动一次。无论发生什么，它都心满意足地一动不动，懒散度日。很少能看到这种宝可梦活动的样子。

entries.source: Slakoth lolls around for over 20 hours every day. Because it moves so little, it does not need much food. This Pokémon’s sole daily meal consists of just three leaves.
entries.translation: 懒人獭每天都会懒散地躺上超过２０个小时。因为它很少活动，所以不需要多少食物。这种宝可梦每天唯一的一餐只有３片叶子。

entries.source: If it eats just three leaves in a day, it is satisfied. Other than that, it sleeps for 20 hours a day.
entries.translation: 它每天只要吃３片叶子就会感到满足。除此之外，它每天都会睡上２０个小时。

entries.source: The way Slakoth lolls around makes anyone who watches it feel like doing the same.
entries.translation: 懒人獭懒散躺卧的模样，会让每个看到它的人都想跟着躺下。

entries.source: It spends nearly all its time in a day sprawled out. Just seeing it makes one drowsy.
entries.translation: 它一天中几乎所有时间都摊着身子度过。光是看着它就会让人昏昏欲睡。

entries.source: Vigoroth is simply incapable of remaining still. Even when it tries to sleep, the blood in its veins grows agitated, compelling this Pokémon to run wild throughout the jungle before it can settle down.
entries.translation: 过动猿根本无法保持安静。即使想要睡觉，它血管里的血液也会躁动起来，迫使这种宝可梦先在丛林里四处狂奔一番，才能平静下来。

entries.source: Vigoroth is always itching and agitated to go on a wild rampage. It simply can’t tolerate sitting still for even a minute. This Pokémon’s stress level rises if it can’t be moving constantly.
entries.translation: 过动猿总是躁动不安，按捺不住想要大闹一番。它连一分钟都无法忍受静坐不动。如果不能一直活动，这种宝可梦的压力就会升高。

entries.source: Its stress level rises if it cannot keep moving constantly. Too much stress makes it feel sick.
entries.translation: 如果不能一直活动，它的压力就会升高。压力过大会让它感到不适。

entries.source: Its heartbeat is fast and its blood so agitated that it can’t sit still for one second.
entries.translation: 它心跳很快，血液也十分躁动，一秒钟都无法安静地坐着。

entries.source: Its heart beats at a tenfold tempo, so it cannot sit still for even a moment.
entries.translation: 它的心脏以十倍的速度跳动，所以连片刻都无法安静地坐着。

entries.source: Wherever Slaking live, rings of over a yard in diameter appear in grassy fields. They are made by the Pokémon as it eats all the grass within reach while lying prone on the ground.
entries.translation: 请假王生活的草地上，会出现直径超过一码的圆圈。那是这种宝可梦趴在地上吃光触手可及的草后留下的。

entries.source: Slaking spends all day lying down and lolling about. It eats grass growing within its reach. If it eats all the grass it can reach, this Pokémon reluctantly moves to another spot.
entries.translation: 请假王整天躺着无所事事。它会吃掉长在触手可及之处的草。如果吃光了够得着的草，这种宝可梦才会不情不愿地挪到别处。

entries.source: It is the world’s most slothful Pokémon. However, it can exert horrifying power by releasing pent-up energy all at once.
entries.translation: 它是世界上最懒惰的宝可梦。然而，它能将积蓄的能量一次释放出来，发挥出骇人的力量。

entries.source: The world’s laziest Pokémon. It moves to another spot when there’s no food left within its reach.
entries.translation: 它是世界上最懒惰的宝可梦。只有触手可及之处没有食物时，它才会挪到别处。

entries.source: This Pokémon lives lying on its side. It only rolls over and moves when there is no more grass to eat.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦侧躺着生活。只有没有草可吃时，它才会翻滚着移动。

entries.source: Skitty is known to chase around playfully after its own tail. In the wild, this Pokémon lives in holes in the trees of forests. It is very popular as a pet because of its adorable looks.
entries.translation: 向尾喵喜欢嬉戏般地追着自己的尾巴转。野生的这种宝可梦生活在森林的树洞里。它因外表可爱而非常受欢迎，常被当作宠物饲养。

entries.source: Skitty has the habit of becoming fascinated by moving objects and chasing them around. This Pokémon is known to chase after its own tail and become dizzy.
entries.translation: 向尾喵有个习惯，一看到会动的东西就会着迷地追逐。众所周知，这种宝可梦会追着自己的尾巴转，最后把自己弄得晕头转向。

entries.source: It shows its cute side by chasing its own tail until it gets dizzy.
entries.translation: 它会追着自己的尾巴转，直到头晕，以此展现可爱的一面。

entries.source: It can’t stop itself from chasing moving things, and it runs in a circle, chasing its own tail.
entries.translation: 它一看到会动的东西就忍不住追逐，还会追着自己的尾巴绕圈跑。

entries.source: It’s adorable when it chases its own tail. It’s difficult to earn its trust.
entries.translation: 它追着自己的尾巴转时十分可爱。要取得它的信任并不容易。

entries.source: Delcatty sleeps anywhere it wants without keeping a permanent nest. If other Pokémon approach it as it sleeps, this Pokémon will never fight—it will just move away somewhere else.
entries.translation: 优雅猫没有固定的巢穴，想睡在哪里就睡在哪里。如果其他宝可梦在它睡觉时靠近，它绝不会与之争斗，只会换个地方。

entries.source: Delcatty prefers to live an unfettered existence in which it can do as it pleases at its own pace. Because this Pokémon eats and sleeps whenever it decides, its daily routines are completely random.
entries.translation: 优雅猫喜欢自由自在地生活，按自己的步调随心所欲。由于这种宝可梦想吃就吃、想睡就睡，所以每天的生活毫无规律。

entries.source: It is highly popular among female Trainers for its sublime fur. It does not keep a nest.
entries.translation: 它因华美的毛发而深受女性训练家的喜爱。它没有固定的巢穴。

entries.source: It dislikes dirty places. It often searches for a comfortable place in which to groom itself.
entries.translation: 它讨厌脏乱的地方。它经常寻找舒适的场所梳理毛发。

entries.source: The reason it does not have a nest is that it simply searches for a clean, comfortable place then sleeps there.
entries.translation: 它之所以没有巢穴，是因为只要找到干净舒适的地方，就会直接睡在那里。

entries.source: Meditite heightens its inner energy through meditation. It survives on just one berry a day. Minimal eating is another aspect of this Pokémon’s training.
entries.translation: 玛沙那通过冥想提升体内的能量。它每天只靠一颗树果维生。尽量少吃也是这种宝可梦修行的一环。

entries.source: Meditite undertakes rigorous mental training deep in the mountains. However, whenever it meditates, this Pokémon always loses its concentration and focus. As a result, its training never ends.
entries.translation: 玛沙那在深山中进行严格的精神修行。然而，每当冥想时，这种宝可梦总会无法集中精神。结果，它的修行永远不会结束。

entries.source: It eats just one berry a day. By enduring hunger, its spirit is tempered and made sharper.
entries.translation: 它每天只吃一颗树果。通过忍耐饥饿，它的精神会得到磨炼，变得更加敏锐。

entries.source: It always trains deep in mountains. It levitates when it heightens its spiritual power through meditation.
entries.translation: 它总是在深山中修行。通过冥想提升精神力量时，它会飘浮起来。

entries.source: It meditates to heighten its inner energy and to float in the air. It eats one berry a day.
entries.translation: 它通过冥想提升体内的能量，并飘浮在空中。它每天吃一颗树果。

entries.source: Through the power of meditation, Medicham developed its sixth sense. It gained the ability to use psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon is known to meditate for a whole month without eating.
entries.translation: 恰雷姆凭借冥想的力量开发出了第六感。它因此获得了使用念力的能力。据说这种宝可梦能不吃不喝，连续冥想整整一个月。

entries.source: It is said that through meditation, Medicham heightens energy inside its body and sharpens its sixth sense. This Pokémon hides its presence by merging itself with fields and mountains.
entries.translation: 据说恰雷姆会通过冥想提升体内的能量，并使第六感更加敏锐。这种宝可梦会让自己融入田野和山峦之中，以隐藏自身的气息。

entries.source: Through yoga training, it gained the psychic power to predict its foe’s next move.
entries.translation: 它通过瑜伽修行，获得了预判对手下一步行动的超能力。

entries.source: It elegantly avoids attacks with dance-like steps, then launches a devastating blow in the same motion.
entries.translation: 它会用舞蹈般的步伐优雅地避开攻击，并顺势使出威力惊人的一击。

entries.source: It gains the ability to see the aura of its opponents by honing its mind through starvation.
entries.translation: 它通过忍受饥饿磨炼精神，从而获得看见对手气场的能力。

entries.source: When Plusle is cheering on its partner, it flashes with electric sparks from all over its body. If its partner loses, this Pokémon cries loudly.
entries.translation: 正电拍拍为伙伴加油时，全身会闪耀出电火花。如果伙伴输了，这只宝可梦就会放声大哭。

entries.source: Plusle always acts as a cheerleader for its partners. Whenever a teammate puts out a good effort in battle, this Pokémon shorts out its body to create the crackling noises of sparks to show its joy.
entries.translation: 正电拍拍总是为伙伴加油。每当队友在战斗中表现出色，这只宝可梦就会让身体短路，制造出电火花的噼啪声来表达喜悦。

entries.source: It absorbs electricity from telephone poles. It shorts out its body to create crackling noises.
entries.translation: 它会从电线杆吸收电力。它会让身体短路，制造出噼啪声。

entries.source: It cheers on friends with pom-poms made of sparks. It drains power from telephone poles.
entries.translation: 它会用电火花做成的绒球为伙伴加油。它会吸取电线杆里的电力。

entries.source: It cheers on partners while scattering sparks from its body. It climbs telephone poles to absorb electricity.
entries.translation: 它会一边从身体散发电火花，一边为伙伴加油。它会爬上电线杆吸收电力。

entries.source: Minun loves to cheer on its partner in battle. It gives off sparks from its body while it is doing so. If its partner is in trouble, this Pokémon gives off increasing amounts of sparks.
entries.translation: 負电拍拍喜欢在战斗中为伙伴加油。加油时，它会从身体释放电火花。如果伙伴陷入困境，这只宝可梦释放的电火花就会越来越多。

entries.source: Minun is more concerned about cheering on its partners than its own safety. It shorts out the electricity in its body to create brilliant showers of sparks to cheer on its teammates.
entries.translation: 比起自己的安危，負电拍拍更在意为伙伴加油。它会让体内的电流短路，制造出绚丽的火花雨来为队友助威。

entries.source: It cheers on friends. If its friends are losing, its body lets off more and more sparks.
entries.translation: 它会为伙伴加油。如果伙伴落于下风，它的身体就会释放出越来越多的电火花。

entries.source: Exposure to electricity from Minun and Plusle promotes blood circulation and relaxes muscles.
entries.translation: 接受負电拍拍和正电拍拍释放的电流刺激，能促进血液循环并放松肌肉。

entries.source: Its dislike of water makes it take shelter under the eaves of houses in rain. It uses pom-poms made of sparks for cheering.
entries.translation: 由于讨厌水，下雨时它会躲到屋檐下避雨。它会用电火花做成的绒球加油助威。

entries.source: Volbeat’s tail glows like a lightbulb. With other Volbeat, it uses its tail to draw geometric shapes in the night sky. This Pokémon loves the sweet aroma given off by Illumise.
entries.translation: 电萤虫的尾巴会像灯泡一样发光。它会和其他电萤虫一起用尾巴在夜空中画出几何图形。这只宝可梦很喜欢甜甜萤散发出的甜美香气。

entries.source: With the arrival of night, Volbeat emits light from its tail. It communicates with others by adjusting the intensity and flashing of its light. This Pokémon is attracted by the sweet aroma of Illumise.
entries.translation: 夜幕降临后，电萤虫的尾巴会发出亮光。它会通过调节光的强弱和闪烁方式与同伴交流。这只宝可梦会被甜甜萤的甜美香气吸引。

entries.source: It lives around clean ponds. At night, its rear lights up. It converses with others by flashing its light.
entries.translation: 它生活在清澈的池塘附近。到了夜晚，它的尾部就会发光。它会通过闪烁光芒与同伴交谈。

entries.source: It communicates with others by lighting up its rear at night. It loves Illumise’s sweet aroma.
entries.translation: 它会在夜里让尾部发光，与同伴交流。它很喜欢甜甜萤的甜美香气。

entries.source: It emits light from its tail to communicate. It loves the sweet aroma given off by ILLUMISE.
entries.translation: 它会从尾巴发出亮光来进行交流。它很喜欢甜甜萤散发出的甜美香气。

entries.source: Illumise leads a flight of illuminated Volbeat to draw signs in the night sky. This Pokémon is said to earn greater respect from its peers by composing more complex designs in the sky.
entries.translation: 甜甜萤带领一群发光的电萤虫，在夜空中描绘图案。据说，这种宝可梦在空中绘制的图案越复杂，就越能赢得同伴的尊敬。

entries.source: Illumise attracts a swarm of Volbeat using a sweet fragrance. Once the Volbeat have gathered, this Pokémon leads the lit-up swarm in drawing geometric designs on the canvas of the night sky.
entries.translation: 甜甜萤用甜美的香气吸引成群的电萤虫。电萤虫聚集后，它便带领这群闪闪发光的宝可梦，以夜空为画布绘制几何图案。

entries.source: With its sweet aroma, it guides Volbeat to draw signs with light in the night sky.
entries.translation: 它用甜美的香气引导电萤虫，在夜空中用光描绘图案。

entries.source: Its fragrance attracts a swarm of Volbeat, so they draw over 200 patterns in the night sky.
entries.translation: 它的香气会吸引成群的电萤虫，让它们在夜空中描绘出超过２００种图案。

entries.source: It guides VOLBEAT to draw signs in night skies. There are scientists that study the patterns it creates.
entries.translation: 它会引导电萤虫在夜空中描绘图案。有些科学家专门研究它创作的图案。

entries.source: Most of Gulpin’s body is made up of its stomach—its heart and brain are very small in comparison. This Pokémon’s stomach contains special enzymes that dissolve anything.
entries.translation: 溶食兽身体的大部分都是胃，相比之下，心脏和大脑都非常小。这种宝可梦的胃里含有能溶解任何东西的特殊酶。

entries.source: Virtually all of Gulpin’s body is its stomach. As a result, it can swallow something its own size. This Pokémon’s stomach contains a special fluid that digests anything.
entries.translation: 溶食兽的身体几乎全是胃。因此，它能吞下和自己一样大的东西。这种宝可梦的胃里含有能消化任何东西的特殊液体。

entries.source: There is nothing its stomach can’t digest. While it is digesting, vile, overpowering gases are expelled.
entries.translation: 没有任何东西是它的胃消化不了的。在消化时，它会排出恶臭而呛人的气体。

entries.source: It has a small heart and brain. Its stomach comprises most of its body, with enzymes to dissolve anything.
entries.translation: 它的心脏和大脑都很小。胃占据了身体的大部分，其中含有能溶解任何东西的酶。

entries.source: Almost all its body is its stomach. Its harsh digestive juices quickly dissolve anything it swallows.
entries.translation: 它的身体几乎全是胃。强烈的消化液能迅速溶解它吞下的任何东西。

entries.source: Swalot has no teeth, so what it eats, it swallows whole, no matter what. Its cavernous mouth yawns widely. An automobile tire could easily fit inside this Pokémon’s mouth.
entries.translation: 吞食兽没有牙齿，所以无论吃什么都会整个吞下。它那洞穴般的大嘴能张得很大。就连汽车轮胎也能轻易塞进这种宝可梦的嘴里。

entries.source: When Swalot spots prey, it spurts out a hideously toxic fluid from its pores and sprays the target. Once the prey has weakened, this Pokémon gulps it down whole with its cavernous mouth.
entries.translation: 吞食兽发现猎物后，会从毛孔喷出剧毒液体袭击目标。猎物变弱后，这种宝可梦便会用洞穴般的大嘴将其整个吞下。

entries.source: It gulps anything that fits in its mouth. Its special enzymes can dissolve anything.
entries.translation: 只要能塞进嘴里，它什么都会一口吞下。它体内的特殊酶能溶解任何东西。

entries.source: It swallows anything whole. It sweats toxic fluids from its follicles to douse foes.
entries.translation: 它会把任何东西整个吞下。它会从毛囊渗出毒液，淋向敌人。

entries.source: It can swallow a tire whole in one gulp. It secretes a horribly toxic fluid from the pores on its body.
entries.translation: 它能一口吞下一整个轮胎。它会从身体的毛孔分泌出剧毒液体。

entries.source: Numel stores magma of almost 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit within its body. If it gets wet, the magma cools and hardens. In that event, the Pokémon’s body grows heavy and its movements become sluggish.
entries.translation: 呆火驼体内储存着温度接近华氏2200度的岩浆。如果身体被淋湿，岩浆就会冷却并凝固。这样一来，呆火驼的身体会变得沉重，行动也会变得迟缓。

entries.source: Numel is extremely dull witted—it doesn’t notice being hit. However, it can’t stand hunger for even a second. This Pokémon’s body is a seething cauldron of boiling magma.
entries.translation: 呆火驼极其迟钝，就连被打中也察觉不到。然而，它连一秒钟的饥饿都无法忍受。这种宝可梦的身体就像一口翻腾着沸腾岩浆的大锅。

entries.source: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees Fahrenheit. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.
entries.translation: 它体内的岩浆温度高达华氏2200度。使用火属性招式时，它的驼峰会变小。

entries.source: Its humped back stores intensely hot magma. In rain, the magma cools, slowing its movement.
entries.translation: 它隆起的背部储存着炽热的岩浆。下雨时，岩浆会冷却，使它的行动变得迟缓。

entries.source: The magma in its body reaches 2,200 degrees F. Its hump gets smaller when it uses Fire-type moves.
entries.translation: 它体内的岩浆温度高达华氏2200度。使用火属性招式时，它的驼峰会变小。

entries.source: The humps on Camerupt’s back are formed by a transformation of its bones. They sometimes blast out molten magma. This Pokémon apparently erupts often when it is enraged.
entries.translation: 喷火驼背上的驼峰是由骨骼变形而成的。驼峰有时会喷出熔融的岩浆。据说这种宝可梦发怒时经常会喷发。

entries.source: Camerupt has a volcano inside its body. Magma of 18,000 degrees Fahrenheit courses through its body. Occasionally, the humps on this Pokémon’s back erupt, spewing the superheated magma.
entries.translation: 喷火驼体内有一座火山。温度高达华氏18000度的岩浆在它体内奔流。它背上的驼峰偶尔会喷发，喷出这些超高温岩浆。

entries.source: If angered, the humps on its back erupt in a shower of molten lava. It lives in the craters of volcanoes.
entries.translation: 一旦发怒，它背上的驼峰就会喷发，熔岩如雨般倾泻而下。它生活在火山口中。

entries.source: The volcanoes on its back have a major eruption every 10 years--or whenever it becomes really angry.
entries.translation: 它背上的火山每10年会大喷发一次，或者在它极度愤怒时喷发。

entries.source: It has volcanoes on its back. If magma builds up in its body, it shudders, then erupts violently.
entries.translation: 它背上有火山。如果岩浆在体内积聚，它就会先浑身颤抖，随后猛烈喷发。

entries.source: Spoink keeps a pearl on top of its head. The pearl functions to amplify this Pokémon’s psychokinetic powers. It is therefore on a constant search for a bigger pearl.
entries.translation: 跳跳猪头顶上放着一颗珍珠。这颗珍珠能增强它的念力。因此，它一直在寻找更大的珍珠。

entries.source: Spoink bounces around on its tail. The shock of its bouncing makes its heart pump. As a result, this Pokémon cannot afford to stop bouncing—if it stops, its heart will stop.
entries.translation: 跳跳猪用尾巴四处弹跳。弹跳产生的冲击会让它的心脏跳动。因此，这种宝可梦不能停止弹跳，一旦停下，心脏也会停止跳动。

entries.source: It bounces around on its tail to keep its heart pumping. It carries a pearl from Clamperl on its head.
entries.translation: 它用尾巴四处弹跳，让心脏持续跳动。它头上带着一颗来自珍珠贝的珍珠。

entries.source: It bounces constantly, using its tail like a spring. The shock of bouncing keeps its heart beating.
entries.translation: 它把尾巴当作弹簧，不停地弹跳。弹跳产生的冲击让它的心脏持续跳动。

entries.source: Using its tail like a spring, it keeps its heart beating by bouncing constantly. If it stops, it dies.
entries.translation: 它把尾巴当作弹簧，不停弹跳以维持心脏跳动。一旦停下，它就会死去。

entries.source: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to wield its fantastic powers. When it is doing so, it dances bizarrely. This Pokémon’s black pearls are valuable as works of art.
entries.translation: 噗噗猪会用身上的黑珍珠施展神奇的力量。施展力量时，它会跳起怪异的舞蹈。这种宝可梦的黑珍珠作为艺术品十分珍贵。

entries.source: Grumpig uses the black pearls on its body to amplify its psychic power waves for gaining total control over its foe. When this Pokémon uses its special power, its snorting breath grows labored.
entries.translation: 噗噗猪会用身上的黑珍珠增强精神力量的波动，从而完全控制对手。这种宝可梦使用特殊力量时，鼻息会变得沉重。

entries.source: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.
entries.translation: 它会用黑珍珠增强精神力量。它会跳起奇特的舞蹈来控制对手。

entries.source: It uses black pearls to amplify its psychic power. It does a strange dance to control foes’ minds.
entries.translation: 它会用黑珍珠增强精神力量。它会跳起怪异的舞蹈来控制对手的心智。

entries.source: It uses black pearls to amplify its psycho-power. It does an odd dance to gain control over foes.
entries.translation: 它会用黑珍珠增强精神力量。它会跳起奇特的舞蹈来控制对手。

entries.source: The more arid and harsh the environment, the more pretty and fragrant a flower Cacnea grows. This Pokémon battles by wildly swinging its thorny arms.
entries.translation: 环境越干旱、越严酷，刺球仙人掌开出的花就越美丽、越芬芳。这种宝可梦会疯狂挥舞长满尖刺的手臂来战斗。

entries.source: Cacnea lives in arid locations such as deserts. It releases a strong aroma from its flower to attract prey. When prey comes near, this Pokémon shoots sharp thorns from its body to bring the victim down.
entries.translation: 刺球仙人掌生活在沙漠等干旱地区。它会从花朵中释放浓郁的香气来吸引猎物。猎物一靠近，这种宝可梦就会从身体射出锐利的尖刺，将其击倒。

entries.source: It prefers harsh environments such as deserts. It can survive for 30 days on water stored in its body.
entries.translation: 它喜欢沙漠等环境严酷的地方。只靠储存在体内的水，它就能存活30天。

entries.source: It lives in arid locations. Its yellow flowers bloom once a year.
entries.translation: 它生活在干旱地区。它的黄色花朵每年盛开一次。

entries.source: By storing water in its body, this desert dweller can survive for 30 days without water.
entries.translation: 这种沙漠居民会把水储存在体内，即使30天不喝水也能存活。

entries.source: If a traveler is going through a desert in the thick of night, Cacturne will follow in a ragtag group. The Pokémon are biding their time, waiting for the traveler to tire and become incapable of moving.
entries.translation: 如果有旅人在深夜穿越沙漠，梦歌仙人掌就会三五成群地跟在后面。它们会耐心等待旅人疲惫不堪、无法动弹的时机。

entries.source: During the daytime, Cacturne remains unmoving so that it does not lose any moisture to the harsh desert sun. This Pokémon becomes active at night when the temperature drops.
entries.translation: 白天，梦歌仙人掌会一动不动，以免水分被沙漠中毒辣的阳光蒸发。这种宝可梦会在气温下降的夜晚开始活动。

entries.source: Packs of them follow travelers through the desert until the travelers can no longer move.
entries.translation: 它们会成群地跟随穿越沙漠的旅人，直到旅人再也无法动弹。

entries.source: It becomes active at night, seeking prey that is exhausted from the day’s desert heat.
entries.translation: 它会在夜间开始活动，寻找因白天沙漠的酷热而筋疲力尽的猎物。

entries.source: It lives in deserts. It becomes active at night when it hunts for prey exhausted from the desert’s heat.
entries.translation: 它生活在沙漠中。它会在夜间开始活动，捕猎因沙漠酷热而筋疲力尽的猎物。

entries.source: Zangoose usually stays on all fours, but when angered, it gets up on its hind legs and extends its claws. This Pokémon shares a bitter rivalry with Seviper that dates back over generations.
entries.translation: 猫鼬斩通常四脚着地，但一旦发怒，就会用后脚站立并伸出利爪。它与饭匙蛇之间有着延续了数代的激烈宿怨。

entries.source: Memories of battling its archrival Seviper are etched into every cell of Zangoose’s body. This Pokémon adroitly dodges attacks with incredible agility.
entries.translation: 与宿敌饭匙蛇战斗的记忆铭刻在猫鼬斩全身的每一个细胞里。它凭借惊人的敏捷身手，巧妙地躲避攻击。

entries.source: Its fur would all stand on end if it smelled a Seviper nearby. Its sharp claws tear up its foes.
entries.translation: 只要闻到附近有饭匙蛇的气味，它就会全身毛发倒竖。它会用锋利的爪子撕裂敌人。

entries.source: It’s Seviper’s archrival. To threaten those it encounters, it fans out the claws on its front paws.
entries.translation: 它是饭匙蛇的宿敌。为了威吓遇到的对手，它会将前脚的爪子呈扇形张开。

entries.source: It has feuded with Seviper for many generations. Its sharp claws are its biggest weapons.
entries.translation: 它与饭匙蛇的争斗延续了许多世代。锋利的爪子是它最强大的武器。

entries.source: Seviper’s swordlike tail serves two purposes—it slashes foes and douses them with secreted poison. This Pokémon will not give up its long-running blood feud with Zangoose.
entries.translation: 饭匙蛇如剑一般的尾巴有两种用途——劈斩敌人，以及将分泌出的毒液泼向对方。它绝不会结束与猫鼬斩之间旷日持久的血海深仇。

entries.source: Seviper shares a generations-long feud with Zangoose. The scars on its body are evidence of vicious battles. This Pokémon attacks using its sword-edged tail.
entries.translation: 饭匙蛇与猫鼬斩之间的争斗已延续了数代。它身上的伤痕就是经历过惨烈战斗的证明。它会用剑刃般的尾巴发动攻击。

entries.source: Constant polishing makes the edge of the blade on its tail extremely sharp. It’s Zangoose’s archrival.
entries.translation: 它不断打磨尾部的刀刃，使其刃口变得极其锋利。它是猫鼬斩的宿敌。

entries.source: In battle, it uses its bladed tail to counter any Zangoose. It secretes a deadly venom in its tail.
entries.translation: 战斗时，它会用带有刀刃的尾巴迎击任何猫鼬斩。它的尾巴会分泌致命的毒液。

entries.source: For many generations, it has feuded with Zangoose. It whets its bladed tail on rocks for battle.
entries.translation: 它与猫鼬斩的争斗延续了许多世代。为了战斗，它会在岩石上磨利带有刀刃的尾巴。

entries.source: Can emit waves of air powerful enough to knock out prey taller than itself. I hypothesize that it amplifies the faint sound of wind within its body.
entries.translation: 它能发出威力强大的空气波，足以击昏比自己更高大的猎物。我推测，它会将体内微弱的风声放大。

entries.source: In high winds, Chimecho cries as it hangs from a tree branch or the eaves of a building using a suction cup on its head. This Pokémon plucks berries with its long tail and eats them.
entries.translation: 刮强风时，风铃铃会用头部的吸盘悬挂在树枝或屋檐下鸣叫。它会用长长的尾巴摘取树果来吃。

entries.source: Chimecho makes its cries echo inside its hollow body. When this Pokémon becomes enraged, its cries result in ultrasonic waves that have the power to knock foes flying.
entries.translation: 风铃铃会让叫声在中空的体内回响。它一旦发怒，叫声就会化为足以将敌人震飞的超声波。

entries.source: Emitting ultrasonic cries, it floats on winds to travel great distances.
entries.translation: 它一边发出超声波般的叫声，一边乘风飘浮，前往遥远的地方。

entries.source: It uses the sucker on its head to hang from a tree or from eaves. It can produce seven different tones.
entries.translation: 它会用头部的吸盘悬挂在树上或屋檐下。它能发出七种不同的音色。

entries.source: Latias is highly intelligent and capable of understanding human speech. It is covered with a glass-like down. The Pokémon enfolds its body with its down and refracts light to alter its appearance.
entries.translation: 拉帝亚斯智力极高，能够理解人类的语言。它全身覆盖着玻璃般的绒毛。这种宝可梦会用绒毛包裹身体，并通过折射光线来改变自己的外貌。

entries.source: Latias is highly sensitive to the emotions of people. If it senses any hostility, this Pokémon ruffles the feathers all over its body and cries shrilly to intimidate the foe.
entries.translation: 拉帝亚斯对人类的情绪非常敏感。如果感受到敌意，这种宝可梦就会竖起全身的羽毛，并发出尖锐的叫声威吓敌人。

entries.source: It can telepathically communicate with people. It changes its appearance using its down that refracts light.
entries.translation: 它能通过心灵感应与人类交流。它会利用能够折射光线的绒毛改变自己的外貌。

entries.source: It communicates using telepathy. Its body is covered in down that refracts light to make it invisible.
entries.translation: 它通过心灵感应进行交流。它全身覆盖着能够折射光线、使其隐形的绒毛。

entries.source: Its body is covered with a down that can refract light in such a way that it becomes invisible.
entries.translation: 它全身覆盖着能以特殊方式折射光线、使其隐形的绒毛。

entries.source: Latios will only open its heart to a Trainer with a compassionate spirit. This Pokémon can fly faster than a jet plane by folding its forelegs to minimize air resistance.
entries.translation: 拉帝欧斯只会对心地慈悲的训练家敞开心扉。这种宝可梦会收拢前肢来尽量减小空气阻力，飞行速度甚至超过喷气式飞机。

entries.source: Latios has the ability to make others see an image of what it has seen or imagines in its head. This Pokémon is intelligent and understands human speech.
entries.translation: 拉帝欧斯能让其他人看见它曾经见过或在脑海中想象出的景象。这种宝可梦智力极高，能够理解人类的语言。

entries.source: It understands human speech and is highly intelligent. It is a tender Pokémon that dislikes fighting.
entries.translation: 它能理解人类的语言，而且智力极高。它是性情温和、讨厌争斗的宝可梦。

entries.source: A highly intelligent Pokémon. By folding back its wings in flight, it can overtake jet planes.
entries.translation: 智力极高的宝可梦。飞行时将翅膀向后收拢，便能超过喷气式飞机。

entries.source: It has a docile temperament and dislikes fighting. Tucking in its forelegs, it can fly faster than a jet plane.
entries.translation: 它性情温顺，讨厌争斗。收拢前肢后，它的飞行速度甚至能超过喷气式飞机。

entries.source: Kyogre is said to be the personification of the sea itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Groudon, as each sought to gain the power of nature.
entries.translation: 据说盖欧卡是海洋本身的化身。传说它曾与固拉多多次交战，双方都试图获得自然之力。

entries.source: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can summon storms that cause the sea levels to rise.
entries.translation: 通过原始回归并借助大自然的全部力量，它会恢复真正的姿态。它能唤来令海平面上升的暴风雨。

entries.source: It is said to have widened the seas by causing downpours. It had been asleep in a marine trench.
entries.translation: 据说它曾降下倾盆大雨，扩张了海洋。它一直沉睡在海沟之中。

entries.source: A mythical Pokémon said to have swelled the seas with rain and tidal waves. It battled with Groudon.
entries.translation: 据说这种传说中的宝可梦曾以降雨和海啸扩张海洋。它曾与固拉多交战。

entries.source: This POKéMON is said to have expanded the sea by bringing heavy rains. It has the power to control water.
entries.translation: 据说这种宝可梦曾降下暴雨，扩张了海洋。它拥有操纵水的力量。

entries.source: Through Primal Reversion and with nature’s full power, it will take back its true form. It can cause magma to erupt and expand the landmass of the world.
entries.translation: 通过原始回归并借助大自然的全部力量，它会恢复真正的姿态。它能令岩浆喷发，扩张世界上的陆地。

entries.source: Groudon is said to be the personification of the land itself. Legends tell of its many clashes against Kyogre, as each sought to gain the power of nature.
entries.translation: 据说固拉多是大地本身的化身。传说它曾与盖欧卡多次交战，双方都企图获得大自然的力量。

entries.source: This legendary Pokémon is said to represent the land. It went to sleep after dueling Kyogre.
