entries.translation: 据说这只传说的宝可梦代表着大地。它与盖欧卡决斗后陷入了沉睡。

entries.source: Said to have expanded the lands by evaporating water with raging heat. It battled titanically with Kyogre.
entries.translation: 据说它曾以炽烈的高温蒸发水分，从而扩张陆地。它与盖欧卡展开了一场惊天动地的大战。

entries.source: It had been asleep in underground magma ever since it fiercely fought Kyogre long ago.
entries.translation: 自很久以前与盖欧卡激战后，它便一直沉睡在地下的岩浆中。

entries.source: It flies forever through the ozone layer, consuming meteoroids for sustenance. The many meteoroids in its body provide the energy it needs to Mega Evolve.
entries.translation: 它永远翱翔于臭氧层中，以陨石为食。体内的大量陨石为它提供了超级进化所需的能量。

entries.source: Rayquaza is said to have lived for hundreds of millions of years. Legends remain of how it put to rest the clash between Kyogre and Groudon.
entries.translation: 据说烈空坐已经生存了数亿年。传说它曾平息盖欧卡与固拉多之间的争斗。

entries.source: It flies in the ozone layer, way up high in the sky. Until recently, no one had ever seen it.
entries.translation: 它在高远天空中的臭氧层里飞翔。直到不久前，都从未有人见过它。

entries.source: It lives in the ozone layer far above the clouds and cannot be seen from the ground.
entries.translation: 它栖息在远高于云层的臭氧层中，从地面上无法看见。

entries.source: It has lived for hundreds of millions of years in the ozone layer. Its flying form looks like a meteor.
entries.translation: 它已经在臭氧层中生存了数亿年。飞翔时的身姿看起来就像流星。

entries.source: Deoxys emerged from a virus that came from space. It is highly intelligent and wields psychokinetic powers. This Pokémon shoots lasers from the crystalline organ on its chest.
entries.translation: 代欧奇希斯由来自宇宙的病毒演变而来。它智力极高，并拥有念动力。会从胸前的水晶状器官发射激光。

entries.source: The DNA of a space virus underwent a sudden mutation upon exposure to a laser beam and resulted in Deoxys. The crystalline organ on this Pokémon’s chest appears to be its brain.
entries.translation: 宇宙病毒的ＤＮＡ受到激光照射后突然发生变异，最终变成了代欧奇希斯。这只宝可梦胸前的水晶状器官似乎就是它的大脑。

entries.source: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.
entries.translation: 宇宙病毒的ＤＮＡ发生变异，变成了宝可梦。它会出现在能够看见极光的地方。

entries.source: An alien virus that fell to earth on a meteor underwent a DNA mutation to become this Pokémon.
entries.translation: 随陨石坠落到地球的外星病毒，其ＤＮＡ发生变异后变成了这只宝可梦。

entries.source: When it changes form, an aurora appears. It absorbs attacks by altering its cellular structure.
entries.translation: 它改变形态时，天空中会出现极光。它通过改变细胞结构来吸收攻击。

entries.source: This Pokémon becomes more energetic the more sunlight there is. The part resembling a shell is similar to silt and is slightly damp and warm to the touch.
entries.translation: 阳光越充足，这只宝可梦就越有活力。像甲壳的部分性质与淤泥相似，摸起来略微湿润而温暖。

entries.source: It undertakes photosynthesis with its body, making oxygen. The leaf on its head wilts if it is thirsty.
entries.translation: 它用身体进行光合作用，制造氧气。如果感到口渴，头上的叶子就会枯萎。

entries.source: Photosynthesis occurs across its body under the sun. The shell on its back is actually hardened soil.
entries.translation: 阳光照耀时，它的全身都会进行光合作用。背上的甲壳其实是硬化的泥土。

entries.source: The shell on its back is made of soil. On a very healthy Turtwig, the shell should feel moist.
entries.translation: 它背上的甲壳由泥土构成。非常健康的草苗龟，甲壳摸起来应该是湿润的。

entries.source: Made from soil, the shell on its back hardens when it drinks water. It lives along lakes.
entries.translation: 它背上的甲壳由泥土构成，喝水后就会变硬。它生活在湖畔。

entries.source: Appears where there is clean spring water. The fruit that grows on the shrubs on its shell is sweet, nutritious, and truly delicious.
entries.translation: 它会出现在有清澈泉水的地方。甲壳灌木上结出的果实香甜可口，营养丰富，着实美味。

entries.source: It knows where pure water wells up. It carries fellow Pokémon there on its back.
entries.translation: 它知道清泉涌出的地点。会让其他宝可梦坐在背上，将它们带到那里。

entries.source: It lives along water in forests. In the daytime, it leaves the forest to sunbathe its treed shell.
entries.translation: 它生活在森林的水边。白天会走出森林，让长着树木的甲壳晒太阳。

entries.source: The shell is hardened soil. Some Pokémon come to peck the berries growing on the trees on its back.
entries.translation: 它的甲壳是硬化的泥土。有些宝可梦会来啄食它背上树木结出的果实。

entries.source: A GROTLE that lives in the forest is said to have its own secret springwater.
entries.translation: 据说，生活在森林里的树林龟都拥有一处属于自己的秘密泉眼。

entries.source: This remarkable, large-bodied Pokémon would serve beautifully as borrowed scenery for a garden, and its strength is peerless. Torterra roams the wilderness in search of clean water.
entries.translation: 这种体型庞大、气度不凡的宝可梦，用作庭园借景也十分美观，力量更是无与伦比。土台龟会为寻找清水而漫游荒野。

entries.source: Small Pokémon occasionally gather on its unmoving back to begin building their nests.
entries.translation: 小型宝可梦偶尔会聚集在它一动不动的背上，开始筑巢。

entries.source: Ancient people imagined that beneath the ground, a gigantic Torterra dwelled.
entries.translation: 古人想象，在大地之下栖息着一只巨大的土台龟。

entries.source: Some Pokémon are born on a Torterra’s back and spend their entire life there.
entries.translation: 有些宝可梦出生在土台龟的背上，并在那里度过一生。

entries.source: Groups of this Pokémon migrating in search of water have been mistaken for “moving forests.”
entries.translation: 成群的土台龟为寻找水源而迁徙时，曾被误认为是“移动的森林”。

entries.source: Full of vigor and always in high spirits. It was once known by the name ”Lantern-Tail” and feared as some kind of apparition.
entries.translation: 它活力十足，总是精神饱满。过去曾被称为“灯笼尾”，并被人们当作某种鬼怪而畏惧。

entries.source: The gas made in its belly burns from its rear end. The fire burns weakly when it feels sick.
entries.translation: 它腹中产生的气体会从臀部燃烧。生病时，火焰会变得微弱。

entries.source: Its fiery rear end is fueled by gas made in its belly. Even rain can’t extinguish the fire.
entries.translation: 它燃烧的臀部以腹中产生的气体为燃料。即使下雨，火焰也不会熄灭。

entries.source: It is very agile. Before going to sleep, it extinguishes the flame on its tail to prevent fires.
entries.translation: 它身手十分敏捷。睡觉前会熄灭尾巴上的火焰，以免引发火灾。

entries.source: It agilely scales sheer cliffs to live atop craggy mountains. Its fire is put out when it sleeps.
entries.translation: 它会敏捷地攀上陡峭的悬崖，栖息在崎岖的山顶。睡觉时，它的火焰会熄灭。

entries.source: The deeper the blue on its face, the more powerful it will grow to become. It leaps about every which way and lands powerful blows against its opponents with the flame on its tail.
entries.translation: 脸上的蓝色越深，成长后就会越强大。它四处跳跃，并用尾部的火焰向对手发出强力攻击。

entries.source: It uses ceilings and walls to launch aerial attacks. Its fiery tail is but one weapon.
entries.translation: 它借助天花板和墙壁发动空中攻击。燃烧的尾巴不过是它的武器之一。

entries.source: It skillfully controls the intensity of the fire on its tail to keep its foes at an ideal distance.
entries.translation: 它能巧妙控制尾部火焰的强弱，让敌人保持在理想的距离。

entries.source: A bigger fire on its tail and a brighter blue pattern on its face means its rank in its pack is higher.
entries.translation: 尾部的火焰越大，脸上的蓝色花纹越鲜明，它在群体中的地位就越高。

entries.source: To intimidate attackers, it stretches the fire on its tail to make itself appear bigger.
entries.translation: 为了威吓袭击者，它会拉长尾部的火焰，让自己显得更加高大。

entries.source: A tall, hardy Pokémon with a dazzling appearance. It shrouds itself in flame and battles as if engaged in dance—truly a sight to behold.
entries.translation: 这是一种身材高大、体魄强健且外表耀眼的宝可梦。它浑身笼罩着火焰，如舞蹈般战斗，实在令人叹为观止。

entries.source: It tosses its enemies around with agility. It uses all its limbs to fight in its own unique style.
entries.translation: 它以敏捷的动作将敌人甩来甩去。它会运用四肢，以独特的风格战斗。

entries.source: Its crown of fire is indicative of its fiery nature. It is beaten by none in terms of quickness.
entries.translation: 头顶的火焰彰显着它火一般的性情。论速度，没有谁能胜过它。

entries.source: It uses unique fighting moves with fire on its hands and feet. It will take on any opponent.
entries.translation: 它会让手脚燃起火焰，施展独特的格斗招式。无论面对怎样的对手，它都会迎战。

entries.source: It uses a special kind of martial arts involving all its limbs. Its fire never goes out.
entries.translation: 它会施展一种运用四肢的特殊武术。它的火焰永不熄灭。

entries.source: Prefers cold climes and appears along coasts. It's an adorable little thing—as cute as any child—but it's also prideful, unwilling to accept handouts from people.
entries.translation: 它喜欢寒冷的气候，会出现在海岸一带。它娇小可爱，宛如孩童，却也十分骄傲，不愿接受人们的施舍。

entries.source: Because it is very proud, it hates accepting food from people. Its thick down guards it from cold.
entries.translation: 由于自尊心很强，它讨厌接受人们给予的食物。厚实的绒毛能保护它免受寒冷侵袭。

entries.source: It doesn’t like to be taken care of. It’s difficult to bond with since it won’t listen to its Trainer.
entries.translation: 它不喜欢被人照顾。由于不肯听训练家的话，很难与它建立感情。

entries.source: A poor walker, it often falls down. However, its strong pride makes it puff up its chest without a care.
entries.translation: 它不擅长走路，经常摔倒。然而，强烈的自尊心让它毫不在意，依然挺起胸膛。

entries.source: It lives along shores in northern countries. A skilled swimmer, it dives for over 10 minutes to hunt.
entries.translation: 它生活在北方国家的海岸一带。它擅长游泳，捕猎时能潜水超过１０分钟。

entries.source: It swims gracefully through the frigid sea and sings with a voice like the roaring tide. It has powerful, sturdy wings and dignity to match.
entries.translation: 它优雅地游过冰冷的海洋，并以如怒潮般的声音歌唱。它拥有强健有力的翅膀，也有与之相称的威严。

entries.source: It lives a solitary life. Its wings deliver wicked blows that can snap even the thickest of trees.
entries.translation: 它过着独居生活。它的翅膀能发出猛烈一击，就连最粗壮的树木也能折断。

entries.source: It lives alone, away from others. Apparently, every one of them believes it is the most important.
entries.translation: 它远离同类，独自生活。似乎每一只都认为自己最重要。

entries.source: Because every Prinplup considers itself to be the most important, they can never form a group.
entries.translation: 由于每只波皇子都认为自己最重要，所以它们永远无法组成群体。

entries.source: Its wings deliver wicked blows that snap even the thickest of trees. It searches for prey in icy seas.
entries.translation: 它的翅膀能使出猛烈一击，就连最粗壮的树木也会被折断。它会在冰冷的海中寻找猎物。

entries.source: Since ancient times, it has been revered by the people of Hisui, who call it the Master of the Waves. Its wings are a match for even master-crafted blades.
entries.translation: 自古以来，它便受到洗翠人们的尊崇，被称为波涛之主。它的翅膀甚至能与名匠锻造的利刃匹敌。

entries.source: The three horns that extend from its beak attest to its power. The leader has the biggest horns.
entries.translation: 从鸟喙延伸出的三只角彰显着它的力量。首领的角最大。

entries.source: It swims as fast as a jet boat. The edges of its wings are sharp and can slice apart drifting ice.
entries.translation: 它游泳的速度和喷射快艇一样快。翅膀边缘十分锋利，能切开浮冰。

entries.source: If anyone were to hurt its pride, it would slash them with wings that can cleave through an ice floe.
entries.translation: 若有谁伤害了它的自尊，它就会用足以劈开浮冰的翅膀将对方斩裂。

entries.source: It avoids unnecessary disputes, but it will decimate anything that threatens its pride.
entries.translation: 它会避免不必要的争斗，但凡有事物威胁到它的自尊，它便会将其彻底摧毁。

entries.source: They live in the fields and mountains, gathering in large flocks. Their cries are quite obnoxious. Though small, their wings are strong—a strike from them leaves pain that persists for a week.
entries.translation: 它们生活在田野和山间，会聚成庞大的群体。它们的叫声相当吵闹。虽然身体很小，但翅膀十分有力，被其击中后，疼痛会持续一周。

entries.source: They flock around mountains and fields, chasing after bug Pokémon. Their singing is noisy and annoying.
entries.translation: 它们成群结队地在山野间追逐虫宝可梦。它们的鸣叫声嘈杂又烦人。

entries.source: They flock in great numbers. Though small, they flap their wings with great power.
entries.translation: 它们会聚成庞大的群体。虽然身体很小，却能强有力地拍动翅膀。

entries.source: Because they are weak individually, they form groups. However, they bicker if the group grows too big.
entries.translation: 因为单独行动时很弱，所以它们会组成群体。但群体一旦过于庞大，它们就会争吵起来。

entries.source: Usually with a large flock, it is barely noticeable when alone. Its cries are very strident.
entries.translation: 它通常混在庞大的群体中，独自一只时毫不起眼。它的叫声非常尖锐。

entries.source: They form remarkably large flocks and are constantly fighting amongst themselves. I suspect that those with magnificent plumes on their heads are the strong ones.
entries.translation: 它们会组成规模惊人的庞大群体，并不断发生内斗。我猜头顶羽冠华丽的个体实力较强。

entries.source: It lives in forests and fields. Squabbles over territory occur when flocks collide.
entries.translation: 它生活在森林和田野中。不同群体相遇时，会因争夺地盘而发生冲突。

entries.source: They maintain huge flocks, although fierce scuffles break out between various flocks.
entries.translation: 它们会维持庞大的群体，但不同群体之间常会爆发激烈冲突。

entries.source: Recognizing their own weakness, they always live in a group. When alone, a Staravia cries noisily.
entries.translation: 它们深知自身弱小，因此总是群居。落单时，姆克鸟会吵闹地鸣叫。

entries.source: It flies around forests and fields in search of bug Pokémon. It stays within a huge flock.
entries.translation: 它会在森林和田野间飞翔，寻找虫宝可梦。它总是待在庞大的群体中。

entries.source: It has left the flock, having gained strength enough to survive on its own. The astounding force with which Staraptor flies through the air allows it to carry away large, burly targets.
entries.translation: 它已拥有足以独自生存的力量，因此离开了群体。姆克鹰以惊人的力量在空中飞行，甚至能将体型壮硕的目标抓走。

entries.source: When Staravia evolve into Staraptor, they leave the flock to live alone. They have sturdy wings.
entries.translation: 姆克鸟进化成姆克鹰后，会离开群体独自生活。它们拥有强健的翅膀。

entries.source: The muscles in its wings and legs are strong. It can easily fly while gripping a small Pokémon.
entries.translation: 它翅膀和腿部的肌肉十分强健。即使抓着一只小型宝可梦，也能轻松飞行。

entries.source: It never stops attacking even if it is injured. It fusses over the shape of its comb.
entries.translation: 即使受伤，它也不会停止攻击。它十分在意头冠的形状。

entries.source: It has a savage nature. It will courageously challenge foes that are much larger.
entries.translation: 它性情凶猛。即使面对体型大得多的敌人，也会勇敢地发起挑战。

entries.source: Bidoof has an unsophisticated face and is rarely flustered by anything. There have been incidents involving Bidoof sauntering into villages and gnawing on the houses without a single care.
entries.translation: 大牙狸长着一张憨厚的脸，几乎不会因任何事而慌张。曾发生过大牙狸悠然走进村庄，毫不在意地啃咬房屋的事件。

entries.source: It constantly gnaws on logs and rocks to whittle down its front teeth. It nests alongside water.
entries.translation: 它会不断啃咬木头和岩石，把门牙磨短。它在水边筑巢。

entries.source: With nerves of steel, nothing can perturb it. It is more agile and active than it appears.
entries.translation: 它有着钢铁般的胆量，任何事都无法令其动摇。它比看上去更加敏捷好动。

entries.source: A comparison revealed that Bidoof’s front teeth grow at the same rate as Rattata’s.
entries.translation: 经过比较发现，大牙狸门牙的生长速度与小拉达相同。

entries.source: It lives in groups by the water. It chews up boulders and trees around its nest with its incisors.
entries.translation: 它成群生活在水边。它会用门牙啃碎巢穴周围的巨石和树木。

entries.source: Bibarel fur repels water and is also a fantastic material for heat retention. These Pokémon create dams on rivers to live in.
entries.translation: 大尾狸的毛皮不仅能防水，保温效果也十分出色。这些宝可梦会在河流上筑坝栖居。

entries.source: It makes its nest by damming streams with bark and mud. It is known as an industrious worker.
entries.translation: 它会用树皮和泥土堵住溪流，在那里筑巢。它以勤劳能干而闻名。

entries.source: It busily makes its nest with stacks of branches and roots it has cut up with its sharp incisors.
entries.translation: 它会用锋利的门牙切断树枝和树根，再将它们层层堆叠，忙碌地筑起巢穴。

entries.source: A river dammed by Bibarel will never overflow its banks, which is appreciated by people nearby.
entries.translation: 被大尾狸筑坝拦住的河流绝不会漫出河岸，因此附近的人们十分感激它。

entries.source: While its movements out of water are sluggish, it can swim as fast as any FEEBAS.
entries.translation: 它在水外行动迟缓，但游泳速度不逊于任何丑丑鱼。

entries.source: When the trees take on new hues, more of these Pokémon appear. The tone they create by striking their antennae together resembles that of the marimba, an instrument of foreign lands.
entries.translation: 当树木染上新的色彩时，这种宝可梦便会增多。它用触角相互敲击发出的音色，仿佛来自异国的乐器木琴。

entries.source: When its antennae hit each other, it sounds like the music of a xylophone.
entries.translation: 触角相互碰撞时，会发出如同木琴演奏般的声音。

entries.source: It chats with others using the sounds of its colliding antennae. These sounds are fall hallmarks.
entries.translation: 它会用触角碰撞的声音与同伴交谈。这些声音是秋日的标志。

entries.source: Its legs are short. Whenever it stumbles, its stiff antennae clack with a xylophone-like sound.
entries.translation: 它的腿很短。每当绊倒时，坚硬的触角便会相撞，发出如木琴般的清脆声响。

entries.source: It shakes its head back to front, causing its antennae to hit each other and sound like a xylophone.
entries.translation: 它会前后摇头，让触角相互碰撞，发出如同木琴般的声音。

entries.source: It uses its cutlass-like arms to produce sound, the melody of which varies from individual to individual. It is a worthwhile endeavor to seek out one's favorite tunes.
entries.translation: 它用弯刀般的手臂发出声音，其旋律因个体而异。寻找自己钟爱的曲调是一件值得去做的事。

entries.source: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.
entries.translation: 它会用旋律表达自己的情绪。科学家正在研究这些旋律的规律。

entries.source: It crosses its knifelike arms in front of its chest when it cries. It can compose melodies ad lib.
entries.translation: 鸣叫时，它会将刀刃般的手臂交叉在胸前。它能即兴谱写旋律。

entries.source: There is a village that hosts a contest based on the amazingly variable cries of this Pokémon.
entries.translation: 有个村庄会以这种宝可梦变化多端得惊人的叫声为主题举办比赛。

entries.source: By allowing its cry to resonate in the hollow of its belly, it produces a captivating sound.
entries.translation: 它让叫声在腹部的空腔中回响，从而发出迷人的声音。

entries.source: If its cloak is even slightly damaged, Burmy will immediately repair it with whatever is close at hand. The Pokémon within the cloak is scrawny and vulnerable to the cold.
entries.translation: 只要蓑衣稍有破损，结草儿就会立刻用手边的材料修补。藏在蓑衣里的宝可梦身体瘦弱，而且怕冷。

entries.source: If its cloak is broken in battle, it quickly remakes the cloak with materials nearby.
entries.translation: 如果蓑衣在战斗中破损，它会迅速用附近的材料重新做一件。

entries.source: To shelter itself from cold, wintry winds, it covers itself with a cloak made of twigs and leaves.
entries.translation: 为了抵御寒冷的冬风，它会用树枝和叶子制成的蓑衣裹住身体。

entries.source: Even if it is born where there are no cocooning materials, it somehow always ends up with a cloak.
entries.translation: 即使出生在没有材料可制作蓑衣的地方，它最后也总能以某种方式披上蓑衣。

entries.source: It covers itself with a cloak to shelter from the cold. When it’s hot, its cloak is thinner.
entries.translation: 它会用蓑衣裹住身体来抵御寒冷。天气炎热时，它的蓑衣会变薄。

entries.source: When Burmy evolved, its cloak became a part of this Pokémon’s body. The cloak is never shed.
entries.translation: 结草儿进化后，蓑衣便成为这种宝可梦身体的一部分。它永远不会脱下蓑衣。

entries.source: Its appearance changes depending on where it evolved. The materials on hand become a part of its body.
entries.translation: 它的外形会随进化地点而改变。手边的材料会成为它身体的一部分。

entries.source: When evolving, its body takes in surrounding materials. As a result, there are many body variations.
entries.translation: 进化时，它的身体会吸收周围的材料。因此，它的身体有许多不同的形态。

entries.source: It is said that a WORMADAM that evolves on a cold day will have a thicker cloak.
entries.translation: 据说，在寒冷日子里进化的结草贵妇会拥有更厚的蓑衣。

entries.source: Scatters steel-colored scales as it flaps its wings. Despite being observed feeding primarily on the nectar of flowers, Mothim is not often seen around flower gardens.
entries.translation: 扇动翅膀时会撒出钢铁色的鳞粉。虽然观察发现绅士蛾主要以花蜜为食，但在花园周围却不常见到它。

entries.source: It flutters around at night and steals honey from the Combee hive.
entries.translation: 它会在夜间四处飞舞，偷走三蜜蜂巢里的蜜。

entries.source: It loves the honey of flowers and steals honey collected by Combee.
entries.translation: 它很喜欢花蜜，会偷走三蜜蜂采集的蜜。

entries.source: While it loves floral honey, it won’t gather any itself. Instead, it plots to steal some from Combee.
entries.translation: 虽然很喜欢花蜜，但它不会亲自采集，而是盘算着从三蜜蜂那里偷一些。

entries.source: It does not keep a nest. It flies over fields and mountains in constant search of floral honey.
entries.translation: 它没有固定的巢穴。为了寻找花蜜，它会不停地飞越田野和山峦。

entries.source: A species related to the Pikachu line. Though Pachirisu is a calm Pokémon, it still presents a danger should one touch its electrified tail or cheeks.
entries.translation: 它是与皮卡丘一族近缘的种类。帕奇利兹虽然性情温和，但若触碰其带电的尾巴或脸颊，仍会有危险。

entries.source: A pair may be seen rubbing their cheek pouches together in an effort to share stored electricity.
entries.translation: 有时能看到两只帕奇利兹互相摩擦颊囊，试图分享储存的电。

entries.source: It makes fur balls that crackle with static electricity. It stores them with berries in tree holes.
entries.translation: 它会制作噼啪作响、带有静电的毛球，并将其与树果一起储存在树洞里。

entries.source: It’s one of the kinds of Pokémon with electric cheek pouches. It shoots charges from its tail.
entries.translation: 它是拥有电气颊囊的宝可梦之一。会从尾巴释放电流。

entries.source: It makes electricity with pouches in its cheeks and shoots charges from its tail. It lives atop trees.
entries.translation: 它用脸颊上的囊制造电，并从尾巴释放电流。生活在树上。

entries.source: It moves freely in the water by spinning its forked tail for propulsion. The resemblance to the screw of a steamboat is coincidental.
entries.translation: 它会转动分叉的尾巴产生推进力，在水中自由游动。尾巴看起来像蒸汽船的螺旋桨纯属巧合。

entries.source: It inflates the flotation sac around its neck and pokes its head out of the water to see what is going on.
entries.translation: 它会鼓起颈部的浮囊，把头探出水面观察周围的情况。

entries.source: It swims by rotating its two tails like a screw. When it dives, its flotation sac collapses.
entries.translation: 它会像螺旋桨一样转动两条尾巴来游泳。潜水时，浮囊会瘪下去。

entries.source: It spins its two tails like a screw to propel itself through water. The tails also slice clinging seaweed.
entries.translation: 它会像螺旋桨一样转动两条尾巴，推动自己在水中前进。尾巴还能割断缠在身上的海草。

entries.source: It inflates its flotation sac, keeping its face above water in order to watch for prey movement.
entries.translation: 它会鼓起浮囊，让脸保持在水面之上，以观察猎物的动向。

entries.source: Has a long, rather splendid flotation sac, which prevents Floatzel from drowning even in stormy seas. One might glimpse this species around fishing hamlets from time to time.
entries.translation: 它拥有长而气派的浮囊，即使在波涛汹涌的海上也不会溺水。人们偶尔能在渔村附近瞥见浮潜鼬的身影。

entries.source: Its flotation sac developed as a result of pursuing aquatic prey. It can double as a rubber raft.
entries.translation: 它的浮囊是在追捕水中猎物的过程中发育而成的。还能当作橡皮筏使用。

entries.source: It floats using its well-developed flotation sac. It assists in the rescues of drowning people.
entries.translation: 它用发达的浮囊漂浮在水面上。它会协助救援溺水的人。

entries.source: It is a common sight around fishing ports. It is known to rescue people and carry off prey.
entries.translation: 在渔港附近经常能见到它。据说它既会救人，也会叼走猎物。

entries.source: With its flotation sac inflated, it can carry people on its back. It deflates the sac before it dives.
entries.translation: 浮囊膨胀时，它可以背着人游动。潜水前，它会将浮囊里的气放掉。

entries.source: Bewitches humans with its helical tail and piercing gaze. Its hidden claws are quite sharp as well, making this Pokémon an exceedingly tricky opponent if antagonized.
entries.translation: 它会用螺旋状的尾巴和锐利的目光迷惑人类。藏起来的爪子也相当锋利，一旦被激怒，就会成为极其棘手的对手。

entries.source: When it’s happy, Glameow demonstrates beautiful movements of its tail, like a dancing ribbon.
entries.translation: 开心时，魅力喵的尾巴会像舞动的丝带一样，展现出优美的动作。

entries.source: It claws if displeased and purrs when affectionate. Its fickleness is very popular among some.
entries.translation: 不高兴时会用爪子抓人，亲昵时则会发出呼噜声。它反复无常的性情很受一部分人喜爱。

entries.source: It hides its spiteful tendency of hooking its claws into the nose of its Trainer if it isn’t fed.
entries.translation: 如果没有被喂食，它就会用爪子勾住训练家的鼻子，却把这种恶毒的性情隐藏起来。

entries.source: With its sharp glare, it puts foes in a mild hypnotic state. It is a very fickle Pokémon.
entries.translation: 它会用锐利的目光让对手陷入轻微的催眠状态。是种非常反复无常的宝可梦。

entries.source: Though impudent and difficult to tame, Purugly enjoys great popularity due to its fur, the beauty of which surpasses even velveteen.
entries.translation: 东施喵虽然傲慢又难以驯服，却因一身比棉绒还要美丽的毛皮而广受欢迎。

entries.source: To make itself appear intimidatingly beefy, it tightly cinches its waist with its twin tails.
entries.translation: 它会用两条尾巴紧紧束住腰部，让自己显得魁梧而吓人。

entries.source: It would claim another Pokémon’s nest as its own if it finds a nest sufficiently comfortable.
entries.translation: 只要发现足够舒适的巢穴，它就会将其他宝可梦的巢穴据为己有。

entries.source: It binds its body with its tails to make itself look bigger. If it locks eyes, it will glare ceaselessly.
entries.translation: 它会用尾巴缠住身体，让自己看起来更加庞大。一旦与它四目相对，它就会不停地瞪视。

entries.source: It is a brazen brute that barges its way into another Pokémon’s nest and claims it as its own.
entries.translation: 它是种蛮横无耻的家伙，会强行闯入其他宝可梦的巢穴并据为己有。

entries.source: This Pokémon gave me an excruciating headache when it seemingly cried out without making a sound. Perhaps there are some sounds that the human ear is simply incapable of hearing.
entries.translation: 这只宝可梦看似无声地叫喊时，让我头痛欲裂。或许确实存在人耳根本无法听见的声音。

entries.source: There is an orb inside its mouth. When it hops, the orb bounces all over and makes a ringing sound.
entries.translation: 它的嘴里有一颗珠子。跳跃时，珠子会四处弹跳，发出铃铃声。

entries.source: Each time it hops, it makes a ringing sound. It deafens foes by emitting high-frequency cries.
entries.translation: 每次跳跃时，它都会发出铃铃声。它会发出高频叫声，震聋对手。

entries.source: It emits high-frequency cries that people can’t hear. Once it starts, it can cry for an awfully long time.
entries.translation: 它会发出人类听不见的高频叫声。一旦开始，就能叫上非常久。

entries.source: It emits cries by agitating an orb at the back of its throat. It moves with flouncing hops.
entries.translation: 它通过振动喉咙深处的圆球发出叫声。它会轻盈地蹦跳着移动。

entries.source: A versatile performer skilled in the imitation of human speech. It is said that older, more experienced Chatot can even understand the meaning of the words they mimic.
entries.translation: 它是擅长模仿人类语言的多才多艺的表演者。据说年长且经验丰富的聒噪鸟甚至能理解自己所模仿词语的含义。

entries.source: It can learn and speak human words. If they gather, they all learn the same saying.
entries.translation: 它能学会并说出人类的语言。如果聚集在一起，它们都会学会同一句话。

entries.source: It mimics the cries of other Pokémon to trick them into thinking it’s one of them. This way they won’t attack it.
entries.translation: 它会模仿其他宝可梦的叫声，让对方误以为它是同类。这样一来，对方就不会攻击它。

entries.source: Its tongue is just like a human’s. As a result, it can cleverly mimic human speech.
entries.translation: 它的舌头和人类的一模一样。因此，它能惟妙惟肖地模仿人类的语言。

entries.source: It keeps rhythm by flicking its tail feathers like a metronome. It imitates human speech.
entries.translation: 它像节拍器一样摆动尾羽来打拍子。它会模仿人类的语言。

entries.source: Though this is a plant Pokémon, it has a gluttonous and unruly temperament. Carnivine attacks its prey with its cavernous maw wide open.
entries.translation: 它虽是植物宝可梦，性情却贪吃又粗野。尖牙笼会张开深不见底的大嘴攻击猎物。

entries.source: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling drool and gulps them down.
entries.translation: 它会把自己缠在湿地的树木上。用气味香甜的口水吸引猎物，再将其一口吞下。

entries.source: It attracts prey with its sweet-smelling saliva, then chomps down. It takes a whole day to eat prey.
entries.translation: 它用气味香甜的唾液吸引猎物，然后一口咬住。吃完猎物需要整整一天。

entries.source: Using its tentacles to lash itself to trees, it lies in wait for prey, luring it close with sweet-smelling drool.
entries.translation: 它用触手把自己缠在树上守候猎物，并以气味香甜的口水诱使猎物靠近。

entries.source: It binds itself to trees in marshes. It attracts prey with its sweet- smelling drool and gulps them down.
entries.translation: 它会把自己缠在湿地的树木上。用气味香甜的口水吸引猎物，再将其一口吞下。

entries.source: Extremely violent. When hunting, it wastes none of its energy, aiming only for prey's most vulnerable spots. Any who manage to tame this Pokémon must be of incredible bravery.
entries.translation: 性情极其凶暴。狩猎时，它不会浪费丝毫力气，只瞄准猎物最脆弱的部位。能驯服这种宝可梦的人一定勇气非凡。

entries.source: This six-legged Pokémon is easily capable of transporting an adult in flight. The wings on its tail help it stay balanced.
entries.translation: 这种六条腿的宝可梦能轻松载着成年人飞行。尾部的翅膀有助于它保持平衡。

entries.source: It prefers to battle by biting apart foes’ heads instantly while flying by at high speed.
entries.translation: 它喜欢在高速掠过敌人身旁时，瞬间将对方的头咬碎来战斗。

entries.source: Its jaw power is incredible. It is adept at biting apart foes while flying by at high speed.
entries.translation: 它的颚力惊人。它擅长在高速掠过敌人身旁时将对方咬碎。

entries.source: The beat of its wings is so powerful that it accidentally dislodges full-grown trees when it takes off in flight.
entries.translation: 它振翅的力量极其强大，以至于起飞时会无意间将长成的大树震得脱离地面。

entries.source: It glides soundlessly on pitch-black wings and sinks sharp fangs into the throat of its prey. It takes on a look of satisfaction once it has entirely drained its prey of blood.
entries.translation: 它用漆黑的翅膀悄无声息地滑翔，并将尖锐的獠牙刺入猎物的喉咙。吸干猎物的血液后，它便会露出心满意足的神情。

entries.source: Its flight is soundless. It uses its lengthy tail to carry off its prey... Then its elongated fangs do the rest.
entries.translation: 它飞行时悄无声息。它会用长长的尾巴掳走猎物……随后再用细长的尖牙解决对方。

entries.source: It observes prey while hanging inverted from branches. When the chance presents itself, it swoops!
entries.translation: 它会倒挂在树枝上观察猎物。一旦时机来临，它便会猛扑而下！

entries.source: It dances silently through the sky. When it approaches prey, it can land a critical hit in an instant.
entries.translation: 它在空中悄无声息地翩然飞舞。接近猎物后，它能在一瞬间击中要害。

entries.source: If it succeeds in catching even a faint breeze properly, it can circle the globe without flapping once.
entries.translation: 只要能顺利乘上一丝微风，它不扇一下翅膀也能环游世界。

entries.source: A Pokémon feared but also respected for stealing away the memories of evildoers. I have found records that suggest Uxie holds dominion over knowledge.
entries.translation: 由克希会夺走恶人的记忆，因此既令人畏惧，又受人敬重。我发现了一些记载，其中显示由克希掌管着知识。

entries.source: It is said that its emergence gave humans the intelligence to improve their quality of life.
entries.translation: 据说它的出现赋予了人类改善生活品质所需的智慧。

entries.source: Known as “The Being of Knowledge.” It is said that it can wipe out the memory of those who see its eyes.
entries.translation: 它被称为“知识之神”。据说看到它眼睛的人会被它抹去记忆。

entries.source: When Uxie flew, people gained the ability to solve problems. It was the birth of knowledge.
entries.translation: 由克希飞翔之时，人们获得了解决问题的能力。知识由此诞生。

entries.source: According to some sources, this Pokémon provided people with the intelligence necessary to solve various problems.
entries.translation: 据某些资料记载，这种宝可梦赋予了人们解决各种问题所需的智慧。

entries.source: Known as the Being of Emotion. In legend, this Pokémon was feared, as any who showed disrespect would have their emotions thrown into disarray.
entries.translation: 它被称为感情之神。传说这种宝可梦令人畏惧，因为任何对它不敬的人都会陷入感情紊乱。

entries.source: It sleeps at the bottom of a lake. Its spirit is said to leave its body to fly on the lake’s surface.
entries.translation: 它沉睡在湖底。据说它的灵魂会离开身体，在湖面上飞翔。

entries.source: Known as “The Being of Emotion.” It taught humans the nobility of sorrow, pain, and joy.
entries.translation: 它被称为“感情之神”。它让人类懂得了悲伤、痛苦与喜悦的珍贵。

entries.source: When Mesprit flew, people learned the joy and sadness of living. It was the birth of emotions.
entries.translation: 艾姆利多飞翔之时，人们懂得了生命中的喜悦与悲伤。感情由此诞生。

entries.source: This Pokémon is said to have endowed the human heart with emotions, such as sorrow and joy.
entries.translation: 据说这种宝可梦赋予了人心悲伤与喜悦等感情。

entries.source: The dreaded Being of Willpower. Legends tell of this Pokémon manipulating the will of its adversaries and turning them into puppets of its own.
entries.translation: 它是令人畏惧的意志之神。传说这种宝可梦会操纵对手的意志，把对方变成自己的傀儡。

entries.source: It is thought that Uxie, Mesprit, and Azelf all came from the same egg.
entries.translation: 据认为，由克希、艾姆利多和亚克诺姆全都来自同一颗蛋。

entries.source: Known as “The Being of Willpower.” It sleeps at the bottom of a lake to keep the world in balance.
entries.translation: 它被称为“意志之神”。它沉睡在湖底，以维持世界的平衡。

entries.source: When Azelf flew, people gained the determination to do things. It was the birth of willpower.
entries.translation: 亚克诺姆飞翔时，人们获得了付诸行动的决心。意志力由此诞生。

entries.source: This Pokémon is said to have endowed humans with the determination needed to face any of life’s difficulties.
entries.translation: 据说这种宝可梦赋予了人类面对人生中任何困难所需的决心。

entries.source: This Pokémon is revered as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Dialga was what caused the vast river of time to begin flowing in our world.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦在洗翠传说中被奉为神明。帝牙卢卡的诞生使浩瀚的时间长河开始在我们的世界中流淌。

entries.source: It has the power to control time. It appears in Sinnoh-region myths as an ancient deity.
entries.translation: 它拥有操纵时间的力量。在神奥地区的神话中，它以远古神明的形象出现。

entries.source: A Pokémon spoken of in legend. It is said that time began moving when Dialga was born.
entries.translation: 传说中提及的宝可梦。据说帝牙卢卡诞生之时，时间便开始流动。

entries.source: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that time flows when Dialga’s heart beats.
entries.translation: 神奥的传说宝可梦。据说每当帝牙卢卡的心脏跳动，时间便会流淌。

entries.source: This Pokémon completely controls the flow of time. It uses its power to travel at will through the past and future.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦能完全掌控时间的流动。它运用自己的力量，在过去与未来之间随心穿梭。

entries.source: This Pokémon is feared as a deity in Hisuian legend. The birth of Palkia was what caused the walls of our world to disappear, creating a sky that spans for infinity.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦在洗翠传说中被当作神明敬畏。帕路奇亚的诞生使我们世界的壁垒消失，创造出无限延伸的天空。

entries.source: It has the ability to distort space. It is described as a deity in Sinnoh-region mythology.
entries.translation: 它拥有扭曲空间的能力。在神奥地区的神话中，它被描述为神明。

entries.source: It is said to live in a gap in the spatial dimension parallel to ours. It appears in mythology.
entries.translation: 据说它栖息在与我们的世界平行的空间维度夹缝中。它的身影出现在神话里。

entries.source: A legendary Pokémon of Sinnoh. It is said that space becomes more stable with Palkia’s every breath.
entries.translation: 神奥的传说宝可梦。据说帕路奇亚每呼吸一次，空间就会变得更加稳定。

entries.source: Its total control over the boundaries of space enable it to transport itself to faraway places or even other dimensions.
entries.translation: 它能完全掌控空间的边界，因此可以将自己转移到遥远的地方，甚至其他维度。

entries.source: Stories tell of this Pokémon being birthed from the boiling magma within Mount Coronet. Its molten-steel body holds many mysteries.
entries.translation: 传说这种宝可梦诞生于天冠山内沸腾的岩浆之中。它那熔融钢铁般的身体蕴藏着许多谜团。

entries.source: Boiling blood, like magma, circulates through its body. It makes its dwelling place in volcanic caves.
entries.translation: 如岩浆般滚烫的血液在它体内循环。它栖息在火山洞穴中。

entries.source: It dwells in volcanic caves. It digs in with its cross-shaped feet to crawl on ceilings and walls.
entries.translation: 它栖息在火山洞穴中。它用十字形的脚牢牢嵌入表面，在洞顶和岩壁上爬行。

entries.source: Its body is made of rugged steel. However, it is partially melted in spots because of its own heat.
entries.translation: 它的身体由坚硬粗糙的钢铁构成。然而，由于自身的高温，部分部位已经熔化。

entries.source: There is one Hisuian verse that tells of a powerful light creating a deep shadow. I imagine that this deep shadow is Giratina.
entries.translation: 有一首洗翠诗篇讲述了强烈的光芒造就深沉阴影的故事。我想，这道深沉的阴影就是骑拉帝纳。

entries.source: It was banished for its violence. It silently gazed upon the old world from the Distortion World.
entries.translation: 它因暴戾而遭到放逐。它从毁坏的世界默默注视着旧世界。

entries.source: This Pokémon is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours, where common knowledge is distorted and strange.
entries.translation: 据说这种宝可梦生活在我们世界的背面，那里的一切常识都扭曲而怪异。

entries.source: A Pokémon that is said to live in a world on the reverse side of ours. It appears in an ancient cemetery.
entries.translation: 据说这种宝可梦生活在我们世界的背面。它会出现在古老的墓地中。

entries.source: Cresselia is reminiscent of the crescent moon. It leaves a brilliant line of light in its wake as it flies across the night sky. I daresay it resembles the heavenly maiden who created the Milky Way.
entries.translation: 克雷色利亚令人联想到新月。它飞越夜空时，身后会留下一道璀璨的光痕。依我看，它就像创造了银河的天女。

entries.source: Those who sleep holding Cresselia’s feather are assured of joyful dreams. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
entries.translation: 据说，怀抱克雷色利亚的羽毛入睡，就一定能做美梦。它被认为是新月的化身。

entries.source: Shiny particles are released from its wings like a veil. It is said to represent the crescent moon.
entries.translation: 闪亮的粒子如薄纱般从它的翅膀上散落。它被认为是新月的化身。

entries.source: On nights around the quarter moon, the aurora from its tail extends and undulates beautifully.
entries.translation: 在弦月前后的夜晚，它尾部散发的极光会延展开来，优美地飘荡。

entries.source: Can be seen floating offshore during seasons when the seas are warm. Its azure body blends in with the ocean waters—logic suggests this is a defense mechanism against natural predators.
entries.translation: 海水温暖的季节里，可以看到它漂浮在近海。它蔚蓝的身体与海水融为一体——依常理推测，这是抵御天敌的防御机制。

entries.source: It drifts in warm seas. It always returns to where it was born, no matter how far it may have drifted.
entries.translation: 它漂流在温暖的海域中。无论漂到多远的地方，它总会回到出生之地。

entries.source: When the water warms, they inflate the flotation sac on their heads and drift languidly on the sea in packs.
entries.translation: 海水变暖后，它们会鼓起头部的浮囊，成群结队地悠然漂浮在海面上。

entries.source: A Pokémon that lives in warm seas. It inflates the flotation sac on its head to drift and search for food.
entries.translation: 生活在温暖海域的宝可梦。它会鼓起头部的浮囊，四处漂流寻找食物。

entries.source: Rumored to migrate across the oceans and visit Hisui's coastal waters only rarely. Although Manaphy resembles Phione, it is also quite different. The relation between the two is unclear.
entries.translation: 传说它会横渡大洋迁徙，极少来到洗翠的沿海水域。玛纳霏虽然与霏欧纳相似，却也有许多不同之处。两者之间的关系尚不明确。

entries.source: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.
entries.translation: 它生来便拥有一种奇妙的力量，能与任何种类的宝可梦心意相通。

entries.source: It is born with a wondrous power that lets it bond with any kind of Pokémon.
entries.translation: 它天生拥有一种奇妙的力量，能与任何种类的宝可梦心意相通。

entries.source: Water makes up 80% of its body. This Pokémon is easily affected by its environment.
entries.translation: 它身体的百分之八十由水构成。这种宝可梦很容易受到周围环境的影响。

entries.source: Born on a cold seafloor, it will swim great distances to return to its birthplace.
entries.translation: 它出生在寒冷的海底，会长途游泳回到自己的出生地。

entries.source: On a moonless night, a strange incident occurred in which every one of a village's inhabitants suffered nightmares. The villagers attested that Darkrai appeared before them in these nightmares.
entries.translation: 在一个无月之夜，村里发生了一桩怪事，所有村民都做了噩梦。村民们证实，达克莱伊曾出现在这些噩梦中。

entries.source: It can lull people to sleep and make them dream. It is active during nights of the new moon.
entries.translation: 它能使人入睡并做梦。它会在新月之夜活动。

entries.source: It chases people and Pokémon from its territory by causing them to experience deep, nightmarish slumbers.
entries.translation: 它会让人和宝可梦陷入噩梦般的沉睡，以此将他们赶出自己的领地。

entries.source: To protect itself, it afflicts those around it with nightmares. However, it means no harm.
entries.translation: 为了保护自己，它会使周围的人陷入噩梦。不过，它并无恶意。

entries.source: Folklore has it that on moonless nights, this Pokémon will make people see horrific nightmares.
entries.translation: 民间传说称，这只宝可梦会在无月之夜让人做可怕的噩梦。

entries.source: When the turning of seasons brings the cruel winter to its end and the joyous people give thanks to the heavens, Shaymin appears and covers the withered land with flowers.
entries.translation: 季节更替使严冬结束，当欢欣的人们向上天表达感谢时，谢米便会现身，让枯萎的大地开满鲜花。

entries.source: The blooming of Gracidea flowers confers the power of flight upon it. Feelings of gratitude are the message it delivers.
entries.translation: 葛拉西蒂亚花绽放时，会赋予它飞行的力量。它所传递的讯息是感激之情。

entries.source: It can dissolve toxins in the air to instantly transform ruined land into a lush field of flowers.
entries.translation: 它能分解空气中的毒素，瞬间将荒芜之地变成繁花似锦的原野。

entries.source: The flowers all over its body burst into bloom if it is lovingly hugged and senses gratitude.
entries.translation: 如果被人充满爱意地拥抱并感受到感激之情，它全身的花朵就会一齐绽放。

entries.source: It lives in flower patches and avoids detection by curling up to look like a flowering plant.
entries.translation: 它栖息在花丛中，会蜷起身体伪装成开花的植物，以免被发现。

entries.source: It is the heavenly fount from which pours the light that shines across Hisui. Its luminance guides and protects all Pokémon. Hisuian mythology states that Arceus is the creator of all things.
entries.translation: 它是天上的光之源泉，照耀洗翠的光芒由此倾泻而出。它的光辉指引并守护着所有宝可梦。洗翠神话称，阿尔宙斯是万物的创造者。

entries.source: It is told in mythology that this Pokémon was born before the universe even existed.
entries.translation: 神话中传说，这只宝可梦早在宇宙存在之前便已诞生。

entries.source: According to the legends of Sinnoh, this Pokémon emerged from an egg and shaped all there is in this world.
entries.translation: 据神奥传说，这只宝可梦从蛋中现身，并创造了世间万物。

entries.source: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing then shaped the world.
entries.translation: 据说它从一无所有之处的一颗蛋中现身，随后创造了世界。

entries.source: It is said to have emerged from an egg in a place where there was nothing, then shaped the world.
entries.translation: 据说它从一无所有之处的一颗蛋中现身，随后创造了世界。

entries.source: When it shares the infinite energy it creates, that being’s entire body will be overflowing with power.
entries.translation: 当它分享自己创造的无限能量时，接受能量者的全身都会充满力量。

entries.source: This Pokémon brings victory. It is said that Trainers with Victini always win, regardless of the type of encounter.
entries.translation: 这只宝可梦会带来胜利。据说，无论面对何种较量，带着比克提尼的训练家总能获胜。

entries.source: It creates an unlimited supply of energy inside its body, which it shares with those who touch it.
entries.translation: 它能在体内制造出取之不尽的能量，并将其分享给接触到自己的对象。

entries.source: They photosynthesize by bathing their tails in sunlight. When they are not feeling well, their tails droop.
entries.translation: 它们让尾巴沐浴阳光，通过光合作用制造能量。身体不舒服时，尾巴就会垂下来。

entries.source: Being exposed to sunlight makes its movements swifter. It uses vines more adeptly than its hands.
entries.translation: 沐浴阳光后，它的动作会变得更加敏捷。它操纵藤蔓比使用双手更加熟练。

entries.source: It is very intelligent and calm. Being exposed to lots of sunlight makes its movements swifter.
entries.translation: 它非常聪明且冷静。沐浴大量阳光后，它的动作会变得更加敏捷。

entries.source: When it gets dirty, its leaves can’t be used in photosynthesis, so it always keeps itself clean.
entries.translation: 叶子一旦弄脏，就无法进行光合作用，因此它总会保持身体清洁。

entries.source: It moves along the ground as if sliding. Its swift movements befuddle its foes, and it then attacks with a vine whip.
entries.translation: 它像滑行一样贴着地面移动。它以敏捷的动作迷惑对手，然后用藤鞭发动攻击。

entries.source: They avoid attacks by sinking into the shadows of thick foliage. They retaliate with masterful whipping techniques.
entries.translation: 它们藏身于茂密枝叶的阴影中躲避攻击，并以高超的鞭击技巧反击。

entries.source: It can stop its opponents’ movements with just a glare. It takes in solar energy and boosts it internally.
entries.translation: 它只需瞪上一眼，就能让对手无法动弹。它会吸收太阳能，并在体内将其增强。

entries.source: It only gives its all against strong opponents who are not fazed by the glare from Serperior’s noble eyes.
entries.translation: 只有面对不畏惧君主蛇高贵眼神的强大对手时，它才会全力以赴。

entries.source: They raise their heads to intimidate opponents but only give it their all when fighting a powerful opponent.
entries.translation: 它们会昂起头来威吓对手，但只有与强大的对手战斗时才会全力以赴。

entries.source: It loves to eat roasted berries, but sometimes it gets too excited and burns them to a crisp.
entries.translation: 它很喜欢吃烤过的树果，但有时会兴奋过头，把树果烧成焦炭。

entries.source: It can deftly dodge its foe’s attacks while shooting fireballs from its nose. It roasts berries before it eats them.
entries.translation: 它能一边从鼻子喷出火球，一边灵巧地躲避对手的攻击。它会先把树果烤熟再吃。

entries.source: It blows fire through its nose. When it catches a cold, the fire becomes pitch-black smoke instead.
entries.translation: 它会从鼻子喷火。感冒时，喷出的火会变成漆黑的烟。

entries.source: When its internal fire flares up, its movements grow sharper and faster. When in trouble, it emits smoke.
entries.translation: 体内的火焰燃烧得越旺，它的动作就越凌厉迅速。遇到麻烦时，它会喷出烟雾。

entries.source: The more it eats, the more fuel it has to make the fire in its stomach stronger. This fills it with even more power.
entries.translation: 吃得越多，用来增强腹中火焰的燃料就越充足。这会让它充满更强大的力量。

entries.source: Whatever it eats becomes fuel for the flame in its stomach. When it is angered, the intensity of the flame increases.
entries.translation: 无论吃下什么，都会成为腹中火焰的燃料。发怒时，火焰会燃烧得更加猛烈。

entries.source: It has mastered fast and powerful fighting moves. It grows a beard of fire.
entries.translation: 它精通迅猛而有力的格斗招式。它长着火焰形成的胡须。

entries.source: It can throw a fire punch by setting its fists on fire with its fiery chin. It cares deeply about its friends.
entries.translation: 它会用火焰下巴点燃拳头，使出火焰拳。它非常重视伙伴。

entries.source: A flaring beard of fire is proof that it is fired up. It is adept at using many different moves.
entries.translation: 熊熊燃烧的火焰胡须是它斗志昂扬的证明。它擅长使用多种不同的招式。

entries.source: This Pokémon from the Unova region uses the shell on its belly as a weapon to cut down its foes. Thus, I've conferred upon this shell the name ”scalchop”.
entries.translation: 这种来自合众地区的宝可梦会把腹部的贝壳当作武器，斩倒敌人。因此，我将这种贝壳命名为“扇贝贝”。

entries.source: It fights using the scalchop on its stomach. In response to an attack, it retaliates immediately by slashing.
entries.translation: 它会用腹部的扇贝贝战斗。受到攻击时，会立刻挥砍反击。

entries.source: The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle—it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
entries.translation: 腹部的扇贝贝不只用于战斗，也能用来敲开坚硬的树果。

entries.source: The scalchop on its stomach isn’t just used for battle--it can be used to break open hard berries as well.
entries.translation: 腹部的扇贝贝不只用于战斗，也能用来敲开坚硬的树果。

entries.source: The scalchop on its stomach is made from the same elements as claws. It detaches the scalchop for use as a blade.
entries.translation: 腹部的扇贝贝由与爪子相同的成分构成。它会取下扇贝贝，当作刀刃使用。

entries.source: Its exquisite double-scalchop technique is likely the result of daily training, and it can send even masters of the blade fleeing in defeat.
entries.translation: 它精妙的双扇贝贝技法想必是每日修行的成果，甚至能让刀法大师败逃。

entries.source: As a result of strict training, each Dewott learns different forms for using the scalchops.
entries.translation: 经过严格的修行，每只双刃丸都会学会不同的扇贝贝使用方式。

entries.source: Strict training is how it learns its flowing double-scalchop technique.
entries.translation: 它通过严格的修行，学会行云流水般的双扇贝贝技法。

entries.source: Scalchop techniques differ from one Dewott to another. It never neglects maintaining its scalchops.
entries.translation: 每只双刃丸的扇贝贝技法都各不相同。它从不疏于保养自己的扇贝贝。

entries.source: Hard of heart and deft of blade, this rare form of Samurott is a product of the Pokémon's evolution in the region of Hisui. Its turbulent blows crash into foes like ceaseless pounding waves.
entries.translation: 这种罕见的大剑鬼心性冷酷且刀法娴熟，是宝可梦在洗翠地区进化而成的形态。它狂暴的攻击如连绵不绝的怒涛般冲击敌人。

entries.source: One swing of the sword incorporated in its armor can fell an opponent. A simple glare from one of them quiets everybody.
entries.translation: 只需挥动铠甲上的剑，便能击倒对手。它只要瞪上一眼，就能让所有人安静下来。

entries.source: In the time it takes a foe to blink, it can draw and sheathe the seamitars attached to its front legs.
entries.translation: 就在敌人眨眼的瞬间，它便能拔出并收回前腿上的足刃。

entries.source: Part of the armor on its anterior legs becomes a giant sword. Its cry alone is enough to intimidate most enemies.
entries.translation: 它前腿的一部分铠甲会化作巨剑。单凭叫声就足以震慑大多数敌人。

entries.source: Extremely cautious, one of them will always be on the lookout, but it won’t notice a foe coming from behind.
entries.translation: 它们极为谨慎，总会有一只负责放哨，但察觉不到从背后逼近的敌人。

entries.source: Using food stored in cheek pouches, they can keep watch for days. They use their tails to communicate with others.
entries.translation: 它们靠颊囊中储存的食物，可以连续放哨好几天。它们会用尾巴与同伴交流。

entries.source: Extremely cautious, they take shifts to maintain a constant watch of their nest. They feel insecure without a lookout.
entries.translation: 它们极其谨慎，会轮流放哨，时刻监视巢穴周围。没有负责放哨的同伴就会感到不安。

entries.source: When they see an enemy, their tails stand high, and they spit the seeds of berries stored in their cheek pouches.
entries.translation: 看到敌人时，它们会高高竖起尾巴，并吐出储存在颊囊里的树果种子。

entries.source: Using luminescent matter, it makes its eyes and body glow and stuns attacking opponents.
entries.translation: 它会利用发光物质让眼睛和身体发光，使发动攻击的对手无法动弹。

entries.source: They make the patterns on their bodies shine in order to threaten predators. Keen eyesight lets them see in the dark.
entries.translation: 它们会让身上的花纹发光，以此威吓捕食者。敏锐的视力让它们能在黑暗中看清东西。

entries.source: It’s good at finding berries and gathers them from all over. It’s kind enough to share them with friends.
entries.translation: 它很擅长寻找树果，会从各处收集树果。它心地善良，愿意把树果分给朋友。

entries.source: It shares the leaf on its head with weary-looking Pokémon. These leaves are known to relieve stress.
entries.translation: 它会把头上的叶子分给看起来疲惫的宝可梦。据说这种叶子能缓解压力。

entries.source: This Pokémon dwells deep in the forest. Eating a leaf from its head whisks weariness away as if by magic.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦栖息在森林深处。吃下它头上的叶子，疲劳便会像魔法般一扫而空。

entries.source: Ill tempered, it fights by swinging its barbed tail around wildly. The leaf growing on its head is very bitter.
entries.translation: 它脾气暴躁，会疯狂挥舞带刺的尾巴进行战斗。长在头上的叶子非常苦。

entries.source: It attacks enemies with strikes of its thorn-covered tail. This Pokémon is wild tempered.
entries.translation: 它会用布满尖刺的尾巴抽打敌人。这种宝可梦性情粗野。

entries.source: It strikes its enemies with a thorn-covered tail. The leaf on its head is bitter.
entries.translation: 它会用布满尖刺的尾巴抽打敌人。头上的叶子味道很苦。

entries.source: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600 degrees Fahrenheit.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦生活在火山的洞穴里。它头顶毛丛中的火焰温度可达华氏600度。

entries.source: Very intelligent, it roasts berries before eating them. It likes to help people.
entries.translation: 它非常聪明，会先烤熟树果再吃。它喜欢帮助人类。

entries.source: This Pokémon lives in caves in volcanoes. The fire within the tuft on its head can reach 600° F.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦生活在火山的洞穴里。它头顶毛丛中的火焰温度可达华氏600度。

entries.source: When it is angered, the temperature of its head tuft reaches 600° F. It uses its tuft to roast berries.
entries.translation: 生气时，它头顶毛丛的温度会达到华氏600度。它会用头顶的毛丛烤树果。

entries.source: When it gets excited, embers rise from its head and tail and it gets hot. For some reason, it loves sweets.
entries.translation: 兴奋时，它的头部和尾巴会冒出火星，身体也会变热。不知为何，它非常喜欢甜食。

entries.source: A flame burns inside its body. It scatters embers from its head and tail to sear its opponents.
entries.translation: 它的体内燃烧着火焰。它会从头部和尾巴撒出火星，灼烧对手。

entries.source: It loves sweets because they become energy for the fire burning inside its body.
entries.translation: 它喜欢甜食，因为甜食能化为在它体内燃烧的火焰所需的能量。

entries.source: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. Plants that receive its water grow large.
entries.translation: 储存在它头顶毛丛里的水富含营养。被它浇过水的植物会茁壮成长。

entries.source: The water stored inside the tuft on its head is full of nutrients. It waters plants with it using its tail.
entries.translation: 它头上毛丛中储存的水富含营养。它会用尾巴将这些水浇给植物。

entries.source: It does not thrive in dry environments. It keeps itself damp by shooting water stored in its head tuft from its tail.
entries.translation: 它不适应干燥的环境。它会把头上毛丛中储存的水从尾巴喷出，让身体保持湿润。

entries.source: It prefers places with clean water. When its tuft runs low, it replenishes it by siphoning up water with its tail.
entries.translation: 它喜欢水质清澈的地方。当头上毛丛中的水量不足时，它会用尾巴吸水补充。

entries.source: The high-pressure water expelled from its tail is so powerful, it can destroy a concrete wall.
entries.translation: 从它尾巴喷出的高压水威力强大，甚至能摧毁混凝土墙。

entries.source: The tuft on its head holds water. When the level runs low, it replenishes the tuft by siphoning up water with its tail.
entries.translation: 它头上的毛丛中储存着水。当水量不足时，它会用尾巴吸水，为毛丛补充水分。

entries.source: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use the frequency and rhythm of these flashes to communicate.
entries.translation: 它释放电流时，鬃毛会发光。它们会利用闪光的频率和节奏交流。

entries.source: When thunderclouds cover the sky, it will appear. It can catch lightning with its mane and store the electricity.
entries.translation: 雷云布满天空时，它就会出现。它能用鬃毛承接雷电，并将电力储存起来。

entries.source: Its mane shines when it discharges electricity. They use their flashing manes to communicate with one another.
entries.translation: 它释放电流时，鬃毛会发光。它们会通过闪烁的鬃毛彼此交流。

entries.source: They have lightning-like movements. When Zebstrika run at full speed, the sound of thunder reverberates.
entries.translation: 它们的动作如闪电般迅捷。雷电斑马全速奔跑时，雷鸣般的声音会四处回荡。

entries.source: When this ill-tempered Pokémon runs wild, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
entries.translation: 这种脾气暴躁的宝可梦一旦横冲直撞，就会从鬃毛向四面八方放出雷电。

entries.source: This ill-tempered Pokémon is dangerous because when it’s angry, it shoots lightning from its mane in all directions.
entries.translation: 这种脾气暴躁的宝可梦十分危险，因为它一生气，就会从鬃毛向四面八方放出雷电。

entries.source: Since this Pokémon makes its own clothes out of leaves, it is a popular mascot for fashion designers.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦会用树叶为自己制作衣服，因此是很受时装设计师欢迎的吉祥物。

entries.source: This Pokémon makes clothes for itself. It chews up leaves and sews them with sticky thread extruded from its mouth.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦会为自己制作衣服。它嚼碎树叶，再用嘴里吐出的黏丝将其缝合。

entries.source: Leavanny dress it in clothes they made for it when it hatched. It hides its head in its hood while it is sleeping.
entries.translation: 它孵化时，保姆虫会给它穿上亲手制作的衣服。睡觉时，它会把头藏进兜帽里。

entries.source: It protects itself from the cold by wrapping up in leaves. It stays on the move, eating leaves in forests.
entries.translation: 它会用树叶裹住身体来抵御寒冷。它一边在森林中不断移动，一边吃着树叶。

entries.source: Forests where Swadloon live have superb foliage because the nutrients they make from fallen leaves nourish the plant life.
entries.translation: 宝包茧栖息的森林枝叶格外繁茂，因为它们从落叶中制造出的养分滋养了植物。

entries.source: Preferring dark, damp places, it spends the entire day eating fallen leaves that lie around it.
entries.translation: 它喜欢阴暗潮湿的地方，整天都在吃散落于周围的落叶。

entries.source: It keeps its eggs warm with heat from fermenting leaves. It also uses leaves to make warm wrappings for Sewaddle.
entries.translation: 它用发酵树叶产生的热量为蛋保温。它还会用树叶为虫宝包制作温暖的包被。

entries.source: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves by using the sticky silk secreted from its mouth.
entries.translation: 发现幼小的宝可梦后，它会用嘴里分泌的黏性丝线，将树叶编织成衣服给对方穿。

entries.source: Upon finding a small Pokémon, it weaves clothing for it from leaves, using the cutters on its arms and sticky silk.
entries.translation: 发现幼小的宝可梦后，它会用手臂上的刀刃和黏性丝线，将树叶编织成衣服给对方穿。

entries.source: They are better at swimming than flying, and they happily eat their favorite food, peat moss, as they dive underwater.
entries.translation: 它们比起飞行更擅长游泳，会一边潜入水中，一边开心地吃最喜欢的食物泥炭藓。

entries.source: When attacked, it uses its feathers to splash water, escaping under cover of the spray.
entries.translation: 受到攻击时，它会用羽毛溅起水花，并借着水雾的掩护逃走。

entries.source: These bird Pokémon are excellent divers. They swim around in the water eating their favorite food--peat moss.
entries.translation: 这些鸟宝可梦非常擅长潜水。它们会在水中游来游去，吃着最喜欢的食物泥炭藓。

entries.source: Swanna start to dance at dusk. The one dancing in the middle is the leader of the flock.
entries.translation: 舞天鹅会在黄昏时开始起舞。在中央起舞的那一只是群体的首领。

entries.source: Despite their elegant appearance, they can flap their wings strongly and fly for thousands of miles.
entries.translation: 虽然外表优雅，但它们能强劲地扇动翅膀，飞行数千里。

entries.source: It administers sharp, powerful pecks with its bill. It whips its long neck to deliver forceful repeated strikes.
entries.translation: 它会用鸟喙使出迅猛有力的啄击。它挥动长长的脖子，连续发动强力攻击。

entries.source: The turning of the seasons changes the color and scent of this Pokémon’s fur. People use it to mark the seasons.
entries.translation: 随着季节更迭，这只宝可梦的毛色和气味也会改变。人们会以此判断季节。

entries.source: Their coloring changes according to the seasons and can be slightly affected by the temperature and humidity as well.
entries.translation: 它们的体色会随季节变化，也会略微受到温度和湿度的影响。

entries.source: The color and scent of their fur changes to match the mountain grass. When they sense hostility, they hide in the grass.
entries.translation: 它们的毛色和气味会变得与山中的草木一致。察觉到敌意时，它们便会藏进草丛。

entries.source: They migrate according to the seasons, so some people call Sawsbuck the harbingers of spring.
entries.translation: 它们会随季节迁徙，因此有些人称萌芽鹿为春天的使者。

entries.source: They migrate according to the seasons. People can tell the season by looking at Sawsbuck’s horns.
entries.translation: 它们会随季节迁徙。人们可以通过观察萌芽鹿的角来判断季节。

entries.source: The plants growing on its horns change according to the season. The leaders of the herd possess magnificent horns.
entries.translation: 它角上生长的植物会随季节变化。族群的首领拥有华美的角。

entries.source: One alone can emit only a trickle of electricity, so a group of them gathers to unleash a powerful electric shock.
entries.translation: 单独一只只能释放微弱的电流，因此它们会聚集成群，放出强力的电击。

entries.source: While one alone doesn’t have much power, a chain of many Tynamo can be as powerful as lightning.
entries.translation: 虽然单独一只力量不强，但许多麻麻小鱼连成一串后，便能发挥出雷电般的威力。

entries.source: These Pokémon move in schools. They have an electricity-generating organ, so they discharge electricity if in danger.
entries.translation: 这些宝可梦会成群游动。它们拥有发电器官，因此遇到危险时会放电。

entries.source: These Pokémon have a big appetite. When they spot their prey, they attack it and paralyze it with electricity.
entries.translation: 这些宝可梦食欲旺盛。发现猎物后，它们会发动攻击，并用电将其麻痹。

entries.source: It wraps itself around its prey and paralyzes it with electricity from the round spots on its sides. Then it chomps.
entries.translation: 它会缠住猎物，用身体两侧圆形斑点释放的电将其麻痹。然后，它会大口咬下。

entries.source: They coil around foes and shock them with electricity-generating organs that seem simply to be circular patterns.
entries.translation: 它们会缠住敌人，并用看似只是圆形花纹的发电器官释放电击。

entries.source: They crawl out of the ocean using their arms. They will attack prey on shore and immediately drag it into the ocean.
entries.translation: 它们会用手臂从海里爬上来。它们会袭击岸上的猎物，并立刻将其拖进海中。

entries.source: With their sucker mouths, they suck in prey. Then they use their fangs to shock the prey with electricity.
entries.translation: 它们会用吸盘般的嘴吸住猎物。然后用尖牙释放电击。

entries.source: It latches on to prey with its sucker mouth, sinking in its fangs and shocking the prey with powerful electricity.
entries.translation: 它会用吸盘般的嘴牢牢吸住猎物，再将尖牙刺入其身体，并用强力的电将其电击。

entries.source: This storm-stirring Pokémon is said to cause the seasons to turn by whipping up the air. I suspect its humanlike form to be a false one.
entries.translation: 据说这种能掀起风暴的宝可梦会搅动空气，促使季节更替。我怀疑它那人形的姿态并非真身。

entries.source: Tornadus expels massive energy from its tail, causing severe storms. Its power is great enough to blow houses away.
entries.translation: 龙卷云会从尾部释放出巨大的能量，引发猛烈的风暴。它的力量强大到足以吹走房屋。

entries.source: The lower half of its body is wrapped in a cloud of energy. It zooms through the sky at 200 mph.
entries.translation: 它的下半身包裹在能量形成的云中。它以每小时200英里的速度在空中疾驰。

entries.source: In every direction it flies, creating winds so powerful, they blow everything away.
entries.translation: 它无论飞向何方，都会掀起足以吹走一切的强风。

entries.source: They say this wielder of electricity has waged war with its nemesis, Tornadus, since time immemorial. The lightning bolts it hurls pierce the very earth and enrich the soil.
entries.translation: 据说，这位驾驭雷电者自远古以来便与宿敌龙卷云征战不休。它掷出的雷电能贯穿大地，使土壤变得肥沃。

entries.source: As it flies around, it shoots lightning all over the place and causes forest fires. It is therefore disliked.
entries.translation: 它四处飞行时会到处释放雷电，引发森林火灾。因此很不受欢迎。

entries.source: The spikes on its tail discharge immense bolts of lightning. It flies around the Unova region firing off lightning bolts.
entries.translation: 它尾巴上的尖刺能释放出威力惊人的雷电。它会在合众地区四处飞行，不断放出雷电。

entries.source: Countless charred remains mar the landscape of places through which Thundurus has passed.
entries.translation: 雷电云经过之处，无数焦黑的残骸使当地景象满目疮痍。

entries.source: When the incarnations of wind and of lightning clash, Landorus arrives to quell the conflict. After the tempests and thunderbolts abate, the land is sure to be blessed with bountiful harvests.
entries.translation: 当风与雷的化身发生冲突时，土地云便会现身平息争端。待暴风与雷电停歇后，大地必将迎来丰收。

entries.source: From the forces of lightning and wind, it creates energy to give nutrients to the soil and make the land abundant.
entries.translation: 它利用雷电和风的力量制造能量，为土壤补充养分，使大地变得丰饶。

entries.source: Lands visited by Landorus grant such bountiful crops that it has been hailed as “The Guardian of the Fields.”
entries.translation: 土地云到访过的土地都会五谷丰登，因此它被誉为“农田的守护神”。

entries.source: The energy that comes pouring from its tail increases the nutrition in the soil, making crops grow to great size.
entries.translation: 从它尾巴中喷涌而出的能量会增加土壤的养分，使农作物茁壮成长。

entries.source: Its melodies are sung with a special vocalization method that can control the feelings of those who hear it.
entries.translation: 它用特殊的发声方式唱出旋律，能够控制听者的情感。

entries.source: The melodies sung by Meloetta have the power to make Pokémon that hear them happy or sad.
entries.translation: 美洛耶塔唱出的旋律拥有让听到的宝可梦感到快乐或悲伤的力量。

entries.source: Many famous songs have been inspired by the melodies that Meloetta plays.
entries.translation: 许多名曲都从美洛耶塔演奏的旋律中获得了灵感。

entries.source: This Pokémon existed 300 million years ago. Team Plasma altered it and attached a cannon to its back.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦在３亿年前就已存在。等离子队改造了它，并在它背上安装了大炮。

entries.source: This ancient bug Pokémon was altered by Team Plasma. They upgraded the cannon on its back.
entries.translation: 这种远古的虫宝可梦遭到了等离子队的改造。它背上的大炮也被升级了。

entries.source: Over 300 million years ago, it was feared as the strongest of hunters. It has been modified by Team Plasma.
entries.translation: ３亿多年前，它曾作为最强的猎手令人畏惧。后来遭到了等离子队的改造。

entries.source: Such a thick shell of wood covers its head and back that even a direct hit from a truck wouldn’t faze it.
entries.translation: 它的头部和背部覆盖着极其厚实的木质外壳，即使被卡车正面撞上也不会动摇。

entries.source: The quills on its head are usually soft. When it flexes them, the points become so hard and sharp that they can pierce rock.
entries.translation: 它头上的刺平时很柔软。一旦用力绷紧，尖端就会变得无比坚硬锐利，甚至能刺穿岩石。

entries.source: They strengthen their lower bodies by running into one another. They are very kind and won’t start fights.
entries.translation: 它们通过互相冲撞来锻炼下半身。性格非常温和，不会主动挑起争斗。

entries.source: It relies on its sturdy shell to deflect predators’ attacks. It counterattacks with its sharp quills.
entries.translation: 它凭借坚固的外壳弹开捕食者的攻击，再用锐利的尖刺反击。

entries.source: When it takes a defensive posture with its fists guarding its face, it could withstand a bomb blast.
entries.translation: 当它用双拳护住脸部摆出防御姿势时，甚至能承受炸弹爆炸的冲击。

entries.source: Its Tackle is forceful enough to flip a 50-ton tank. It shields its allies from danger with its own body.
entries.translation: 它使出的撞击威力强大，足以掀翻重达５０吨的坦克。它会用自己的身体保护伙伴免受危险。

entries.source: As it walks, it munches on a twig in place of a snack. It intimidates opponents by puffing hot air out of its ears.
entries.translation: 它走路时会把树枝当作零食嚼个不停。它会从耳朵里喷出热气来威吓对手。

entries.source: Eating a twig fills it with energy, and its roomy ears give vent to air hotter than 390 degrees Fahrenheit.
entries.translation: 吃下树枝后，它便会充满能量，宽大的耳朵能排出温度超过华氏３９０度的热气。

entries.source: When the twig is plucked from its tail, friction sets the twig alight. The flame is used to send signals to its allies.
entries.translation: 从尾巴上拔出树枝时，摩擦会使树枝燃烧起来。它会用火焰向伙伴发送信号。

entries.source: It has a twig stuck in its tail. With friction from its tail fur, it sets the twig on fire and launches into battle.
entries.translation: 它的尾巴上插着一根树枝。它用尾巴上的毛摩擦树枝将其点燃，然后投入战斗。

entries.source: Using psychic power, it generates a fiery vortex of 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit, incinerating foes swept into this whirl of flame.
entries.translation: 它会用超能力制造出高达华氏5400度的火焰旋涡，将卷入其中的敌人烧成灰烬。

entries.source: It gazes into the flame at the tip of its branch to achieve a focused state, which allows it to see into the future.
entries.translation: 它凝视着树枝尖端的火焰，让精神进入高度集中的状态，从而看见未来。

entries.source: It protects its skin by covering its body in delicate bubbles. Beneath its happy-go-lucky air, it keeps a watchful eye on its surroundings.
entries.translation: 它用细腻的泡泡包裹全身，以保护皮肤。在无忧无虑的外表下，它始终警惕地观察着四周。

entries.source: It secretes flexible bubbles from its chest and back. The bubbles reduce the damage it would otherwise take when attacked.
entries.translation: 它会从胸口和背部分泌富有弹性的泡泡。受到攻击时，这些泡泡能减轻它所受的伤害。

entries.source: Its swiftness is unparalleled. It can scale a tower of more than 2,000 feet in a minute’s time.
entries.translation: 它的敏捷无与伦比。只需1分钟就能爬上超过2000英尺高的塔。

entries.source: It can throw bubble-covered pebbles with precise control, hitting empty cans up to a hundred feet away.
entries.translation: 它能精准地投掷裹着泡泡的小石子，击中最远100英尺外的空罐子。

entries.source: It appears and vanishes with a ninja’s grace. It toys with its enemies using swift movements, while slicing them with throwing stars of sharpest water.
entries.translation: 它如忍者般神出鬼没。它以迅捷的动作戏弄敌人，同时用最锋利的水之手里剑将其斩切。

entries.source: It creates throwing stars out of compressed water. When it spins them and throws them at high speed, these stars can split metal in two.
entries.translation: 它会用压缩水流制成手里剑。将其旋转并高速掷出时，甚至能把金属劈成两半。

entries.source: The powder that covers its body regulates its temperature, so it can live in any region or climate.
entries.translation: 覆盖全身的粉末能调节体温，因此无论什么地区或气候，它都能生存。

entries.source: When under attack from bird Pokémon, it spews a poisonous black powder that causes paralysis on contact.
entries.translation: 受到鸟宝可梦攻击时，它会喷出有毒的黑色粉末，接触到粉末就会麻痹。

entries.source: The beaks of bird Pokémon can’t begin to scratch its stalwart body. To defend itself, it spews powder.
entries.translation: 鸟宝可梦的喙根本无法刮伤它坚实的身体。为了保护自己，它会喷出粉末。

entries.source: It lives hidden within thicket shadows. When predators attack, it quickly bristles the fur covering its body in an effort to threaten them.
entries.translation: 它藏身于灌木丛的阴影中生活。遭到捕食者攻击时，它会迅速竖起覆盖全身的毛，试图威吓对方。

entries.source: The patterns on this Pokémon’s wings depend on the climate and topography of its habitat. It scatters colorful scales.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦翅膀上的花纹取决于栖息地的气候和地形。它会撒出五彩缤纷的鳞粉。

entries.source: Vivillon with many different patterns are found all over the world. These patterns are affected by the climate of their habitat.
entries.translation: 世界各地都能发现拥有不同花纹的彩粉蝶。这些花纹会受到栖息地气候的影响。

entries.source: If it has sunshine and water, it doesn’t need to eat, because it can generate energy from the leaves on its back.
entries.translation: 只要有阳光和水，它就不需要进食，因为它能从背上的叶子中产生能量。

entries.source: Thought to be one of the first Pokémon to live in harmony with humans, it has a placid disposition.
entries.translation: 它被认为是最早与人类和谐共处的宝可梦之一，性情温和沉静。

entries.source: They inhabit mountainous regions. The leader of the herd is decided by a battle of clashing horns.
entries.translation: 它们栖息在山岳地带。族群的首领由相互顶撞犄角的战斗决定。

entries.source: It can tell how its Trainer is feeling by subtle shifts in the grip on its horns. This empathic sense lets them run as if one being.
entries.translation: 它能从握住犄角的力道发生的细微变化中察觉训练家的心情。这种感知情绪的能力让双方能合为一体般奔跑。

entries.source: When the horns on its head shine in seven colors, it is said to be sharing everlasting life.
entries.translation: 据说，当它头上的角闪耀七色光芒时，便是在分享永恒的生命。

entries.source: Legends say it can share eternal life. It slept for a thousand years in the form of a tree before its revival.
entries.translation: 传说它能分享永恒的生命。它曾化作树木沉睡了１０００年，之后才苏醒。

entries.source: When its life comes to an end, it absorbs the life energy of every living thing and turns into a cocoon once more.
entries.translation: 当生命走到尽头时，它会吸收所有生物的生命能量，再次变成茧。

entries.source: When this legendary Pokémon’s wings and tail feathers spread wide and glow red, it absorbs the life force of living creatures.
entries.translation: 当这只传说的宝可梦展开双翼与尾羽并发出红光时，就会吸收生物的生命能量。

entries.source: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.
entries.translation: 它能压缩双手之间空气中的碳，瞬间制造出大量钻石。

entries.source: A sudden transformation of Carbink, its pink, glimmering body is said to be the loveliest sight in the whole world.
entries.translation: 它是小碎钻突然变异而成的，据说其闪耀着光芒的粉红色身体是全世界最美丽的景象。

entries.source: It is said to be able to seize anything it desires with its six rings and six huge arms. With its power sealed, it is transformed into a much smaller form.
entries.translation: 据说，它能用６个圆环和６条巨大的手臂夺取任何想要的东西。力量被封印后，它会变成小得多的形态。

entries.source: In its true form, it possess a huge amount of power. Legends of its avarice tell how it once carried off an entire castle to gain the treasure hidden within.
entries.translation: 它在真实形态下拥有极其强大的力量。关于它贪婪本性的传说称，它曾为了取得藏在城堡中的宝物，将整座城堡搬走。

entries.source: It gathers things it likes and passes them through its loop to teleport them to a secret place.
entries.translation: 它会收集喜欢的东西，让它们穿过圆环，传送到秘密地点。

entries.source: This troublemaker sends anything and everything to faraway places using its loop, which can warp space.
entries.translation: 这个捣蛋鬼会利用能够扭曲空间的圆环，把任何东西都送到遥远的地方。

entries.source: It expels its internal steam from the arms on its back. It has enough power to blow away a mountain.
entries.translation: 它会从背部的手臂喷出体内的蒸汽。其威力足以吹飞一座山。

entries.source: It lets out billows of steam and disappears into the dense fog. It’s said to live in mountains where humans do not tread.
entries.translation: 它喷出滚滚蒸汽，消失在浓雾之中。据说它生活在人类从未涉足的山中。

entries.source: The black orbs shine with an uncanny light when the Pokémon is erecting invisible barriers. The fur shed from its beard retains heat well and is a highly useful material for winter clothing.
entries.translation: 当诡角鹿竖起无形的屏障时，黑色的珠子会闪耀出不可思议的光芒。它胡须脱落的毛保温性极佳，是制作冬装非常实用的材料。

entries.source: A violent creature that fells towering trees with its crude axes and shields itself with hard stone. If one should chance upon this Pokémon in the wilds, one's only recourse is to flee.
entries.translation: 性情凶暴，会用粗陋的斧头砍倒参天大树，并以坚硬的岩石保护自己。若在荒野中偶然遇到这种宝可梦，唯有逃跑一途。

entries.source: I believe it was Hisui's swampy terrain that gave Ursaluna its burly physique and newfound capacity to manipulate peat at will.
entries.translation: 我认为，正是洗翠的沼泽地形赋予了月月熊魁梧的体格，以及随心操纵泥炭的新能力。

entries.source: Clads itself in the souls of comrades that perished before fulfilling their goals of journeying upstream. No other species throughout all Hisui's rivers is Basculegion's equal.
entries.translation: 它将未能实现溯流而上之愿便已丧命的同伴灵魂披在身上。纵观洗翠的所有河川，没有任何其他物种能与幽尾玄鱼匹敌。

entries.source: Because of Sneasler's virulent poison and daunting physical prowess, no other species could hope to best it on the frozen highlands. Preferring solitude, this species does not form packs.
entries.translation: 大狃拉拥有剧毒和令人畏惧的体能，在冰封的高地上，没有其他物种能够战胜它。它偏好独处，不会结成群体。

entries.source: Its lancelike spikes and savage temperament have earned it the nickname ”sea fiend.” It slurps up poison to nourish itself.
entries.translation: 长枪般的尖刺和凶暴的性情为它赢得了“海中恶鬼”的别称。它会吸食毒素来滋养自己。

entries.source: When it flies to this land from across the sea, the bitter winter comes to an end. According to legend, this Pokémon's love gives rise to the budding of fresh life across Hisui.
entries.translation: 当它越过大海飞抵这片土地时，严冬便会结束。传说这种宝可梦的爱会让崭新的生命在洗翠各地萌芽。

entries.source: The sweet scent its body gives off mesmerizes those around it. The scent grows stronger when this Pokémon is in the sun.
entries.translation: 它身体散发的甜美香气会令周围的生物着迷。这种宝可梦晒太阳时，香气会变得更浓。

entries.source: Its fluffy fur is similar in composition to plants. This Pokémon frequently washes its face to keep it from drying out.
entries.translation: 它蓬松的体毛在成分上与植物相似。这种宝可梦经常洗脸，以免脸部干燥。

entries.source: The hardness of Floragato’s fur depends on the Pokémon’s mood. When Floragato is prepared to battle, its fur becomes pointed and needle sharp.
entries.translation: 蒂蕾喵体毛的硬度会随心情而变化。当蒂蕾喵准备战斗时，体毛会竖起并变得如针般锐利。

entries.source: Floragato deftly wields the vine hidden beneath its long fur, slamming the hard flower bud against its opponents.
entries.translation: 蒂蕾喵能灵巧地挥舞藏在长毛下的藤蔓，用坚硬的花苞猛击对手。

entries.source: With skillful misdirection, it rigs foes with pollen-packed flower bombs. Meowscarada sets off the bombs before its foes realize what’s going on.
entries.translation: 它会运用高明的障眼法，在敌人身上安放装满花粉的花炸弹。魔幻假面喵会在敌人尚未弄清状况前引爆炸弹。

entries.source: This Pokémon uses the reflective fur lining its cape to camouflage the stem of its flower, creating the illusion that the flower is floating.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦会利用斗篷内侧能反光的体毛隐藏花茎，让花看起来仿佛漂浮在空中。

entries.source: Its flame sac is small, so energy is always leaking out. This energy is released from the dent atop Fuecoco’s head and flickers to and fro.
entries.translation: 它的火焰囊很小，因此能量总会泄漏出来。这些能量会从呆火鳄头顶的凹陷处释放，并来回摇曳。

entries.source: It lies on warm rocks and uses the heat absorbed by its square-shaped scales to create fire energy.
entries.translation: 它会躺在温暖的岩石上，利用方形鳞片吸收的热量制造火焰能量。

entries.source: The valve in Crocalor’s flame sac is closely connected to its vocal cords. This Pokémon utters a guttural cry as it spews flames every which way.
entries.translation: 炙烫鳄火焰囊的阀门与声带紧密相连。它会一边发出低沉的叫声，一边向四面八方喷吐火焰。

entries.source: The combination of Crocalor’s fire energy and overflowing vitality has caused an egg-shaped fireball to appear on the Pokémon’s head.
entries.translation: 炙烫鳄的火之能量与旺盛的生命力相结合，使它的头上出现了蛋形的火球。

entries.source: Skeledirge’s gentle singing soothes the souls of all that hear it. It burns its enemies to a crisp with flames of over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit.
entries.translation: 骨纹巨声鳄温柔的歌声能安抚所有听众的灵魂。它会用超过华氏5400度的火焰将敌人烧成焦炭。

entries.source: The fiery bird changes shape when Skeledirge sings. Rumor has it that the bird was born when the fireball on Skeledirge’s head gained a soul.
entries.translation: 骨纹巨声鳄歌唱时，火焰鸟会随之改变形态。据说，这只鸟诞生于骨纹巨声鳄头上的火球获得灵魂之时。

entries.source: Its strong legs let it easily swim around in even fast-flowing rivers. It likes to keep things tidy and is prone to overthinking things.
entries.translation: 它凭借强健的双腿，即使在水流湍急的河川中也能轻松游动。它爱好整洁，却也容易想得太多。

entries.source: This Pokémon migrated to Paldea from distant lands long ago. The gel secreted by its feathers repels water and grime.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦很久以前从遥远的地方迁徙到了帕底亚。它羽毛分泌的凝胶能够隔绝水分和污垢。

entries.source: The hardworking Quaxwell observes people and Pokémon from various regions and incorporates their movements into its own dance routines.
entries.translation: 勤奋的涌跃鸭会观察各个地区的人和宝可梦，并将他们的动作融入自己的舞步之中。

entries.source: These Pokémon constantly run through shallow waters to train their legs, then compete with each other to see which of them kicks most gracefully.
entries.translation: 这些宝可梦会不断奔跑于浅水中锻炼双腿，然后互相较量谁踢得最优雅。

entries.source: Dancing in ways that evoke far-away places, this Pokémon mesmerizes all that see it. Flourishes of its decorative water feathers slice into its foes.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦跳起令人联想到遥远异乡的舞蹈，让所有见到它的人为之着迷。它挥舞装饰般的水之羽毛，将敌人切开。

entries.source: A single kick from a Quaquaval can send a truck rolling. This Pokémon uses its powerful legs to perform striking dances from far-off lands.
entries.translation: 狂欢浪舞鸭只需一脚就能把卡车踢得翻滚出去。这种宝可梦会用强健的双腿表演遥远异乡极具震撼力的舞蹈。

entries.source: This Pokémon spurns all but the finest of foods. Its body gives off an herblike scent that bug Pokémon detest.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦除了最上等的食物以外一概不吃。它的身体会散发出虫宝可梦厌恶的草本气味。

entries.source: It searches for food all day. It possesses a keen sense of smell but doesn’t use it for anything other than foraging.
entries.translation: 它整天都在寻找食物。它的嗅觉十分敏锐，但只会将其用于觅食。

entries.source: It entrances female Pokémon with the sweet, alluring scent that wafts from all over its body.
entries.translation: 它全身飘散着甜美诱人的香气，能令雌性宝可梦为之着迷。

entries.source: Oinkologne is proud of its fine, glossy skin. It emits a concentrated scent from the tip of its tail.
entries.translation: 飘香豚以自己细腻而有光泽的皮肤为傲。它会从尾巴尖端释放浓郁的香气。

entries.source: The thread it secretes from its rear is as strong as wire. The secret behind the thread’s strength is the topic of ongoing research.
entries.translation: 它从臀部分泌的丝线坚如钢丝。丝线如此坚韧的秘密仍是研究中的课题。

entries.source: The ball of threads wrapped around its body is elastic enough to deflect the scythes of Scyther, this Pokémon’s natural enemy.
entries.translation: 缠绕在它身体周围的线球弹性十足，甚至能弹开其天敌飞天螳螂的镰刀。

entries.source: Spidops covers its territory in tough, sticky threads to set up traps for intruders.
entries.translation: 操陷蛛会在自己的地盘上布满坚韧而黏稠的丝线，为入侵者设下陷阱。

entries.source: It clings to branches and ceilings using its threads and moves without a sound. It takes out its prey before the prey even notices it.
entries.translation: 它会用丝线攀附在树枝和天花板上，悄无声息地移动。猎物甚至还没察觉，就会被它解决掉。

entries.source: It’s highly skilled at a fighting style in which it uses its jumping capabilities to dodge incoming attacks while also dealing damage to opponents.
entries.translation: 它十分擅长一种利用跳跃能力躲避来袭攻击，同时对对手造成伤害的战斗方式。

entries.source: It has its third set of legs folded up. When it’s in a tough spot, this Pokémon jumps over 30 feet using the strength of its legs.
entries.translation: 它平时会折叠起第三对脚。陷入困境时，这种宝可梦会凭借脚力跃出超过9米远。

entries.source: It uses its normally folded third set of legs when in Showdown Mode. This places a huge burden on its body, so it can’t stay in this mode for long.
entries.translation: 进入决战模式后，它会使用平时折叠起来的第三对脚。这会给身体造成巨大负担，因此无法长时间维持这种模式。

entries.source: When it decides to fight all out, it stands on its previously folded legs to enter Showdown Mode. It neutralizes its enemies in short order.
entries.translation: 决定全力战斗时，它会用原本折叠起来的脚站立，进入决战模式。它会在短时间内制服敌人。

entries.source: The pads of its paws are electricity-discharging organs. Pawmi fires electricity from its forepaws while standing unsteadily on its hind legs.
entries.translation: 它脚掌上的肉球是放电器官。布拨会摇摇晃晃地用后脚站立，同时从前脚释放电流。

entries.source: It has underdeveloped electric sacs on its cheeks. These sacs can produce electricity only if Pawmi rubs them furiously with the pads on its forepaws.
entries.translation: 它脸颊上的电囊尚未发育成熟。只有布拨用前脚的肉球拼命摩擦电囊时，电囊才能产生电力。

entries.source: Pawmo uses a unique fighting technique in which it uses its forepaws to strike foes and zap them with electricity from its paw pads simultaneously.
entries.translation: 布土拨会使用独特的战斗技巧，一边用前脚击打敌人，一边从肉球释放电流电击对方。

entries.source: When its group is attacked, Pawmo is the first to leap into battle, defeating enemies with a fighting technique that utilizes electric shocks.
entries.translation: 族群遭到袭击时，布土拨会第一个跃入战场，用结合电击的战斗技巧打倒敌人。

entries.source: Pawmot’s fluffy fur acts as a battery. It can store the same amount of electricity as an electric car.
entries.translation: 巴布土拨蓬松的体毛有着电池般的作用。它能储存与一辆电动汽车相当的电量。

entries.source: This Pokémon normally is slow to react, but once it enters battle, it will strike down its enemies with lightning-fast movements.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦平时反应迟钝，但一进入战斗，就会以迅雷般的动作击倒敌人。

entries.source: The pair sticks together no matter what. They split any food they find exactly in half and then eat it together.
entries.translation: 无论发生什么，这一对都会形影不离。它们会把找到的任何食物均分成两半，然后一起吃掉。

entries.source: Exhibiting great teamwork, they use their incisors to cut pieces out of any material that might be useful for a nest, then make off with them.
entries.translation: 它们展现出卓越的团队合作，用门牙从任何可能适合筑巢的材料上切下碎片，再将其带走。

entries.source: The larger pair protects the little ones during battles. When facing strong opponents, the whole group will join the fight.
entries.translation: 战斗时，体型较大的那一对会保护幼小的成员。面对强大的对手时，全家都会加入战斗。

entries.source: The two little ones just appeared one day. The group might be a family of related Pokémon, but nobody knows for sure.
entries.translation: 两只小家伙有一天突然出现了。它们或许是由有亲缘关系的宝可梦组成的一家，但没有人能确定。

entries.source: The yeast in Fidough’s breath is useful for cooking, so this Pokémon has been protected by people since long ago.
entries.translation: 狗仔包吐息中的酵母对烹饪很有用，因此这种宝可梦从很久以前就一直受到人们的保护。

entries.source: This Pokémon is smooth and moist to the touch. Yeast in Fidough’s breath induces fermentation in the Pokémon’s vicinity.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦摸起来光滑湿润。狗仔包吐息中的酵母会促使周围的物质发酵。

entries.source: The surface of this Pokémon’s skin hardens when exposed to intense heat, and its body has an appetizing aroma.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦的皮肤表面遇到高温就会变硬，身体还会散发出诱人的香气。

entries.source: The pleasant aroma that emanates from this Pokémon’s body helps wheat grow, so Dachsbun has been treasured by farming villages.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦身体散发的怡人香气有助于小麦生长，因此麻花犬一直受到农耕村落的珍视。

entries.source: This Pokémon converts nutrients into oil, which it stores in the fruit on its head. It can easily go a whole week without eating or drinking.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦会将营养转化为油，储存在头上的果实里。即使整整一周不吃不喝也能轻松度过。

entries.source: It protects itself from enemies by emitting oil from the fruit on its head. This oil is bitter and astringent enough to make someone flinch.
entries.translation: 它会从头上的果实中释放油，以保护自己免受敌人侵害。这种油苦涩得足以让人畏缩。

entries.source: It basks in the sun to its heart’s content until the fruits on its head ripen. After that, Dolliv departs from human settlements and goes on a journey.
entries.translation: 它会尽情沐浴阳光，直到头上的果实成熟。之后，奥利纽便会离开人类聚居地，踏上旅程。

entries.source: Dolliv shares its tasty, fresh-scented oil with others. This species has coexisted with humans since times long gone.
entries.translation: 奥利纽会与他人分享美味且带有清新香气的油。这个种族自古以来便与人类共存。

entries.source: This Pokémon drives back enemies by launching its rich, aromatic oil at them with enough force to smash a boulder.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦会向敌人喷射浓郁芳香的油，其威力足以击碎巨石，从而将敌人击退。

entries.source: This calm Pokémon is very compassionate. It will share its delicious, nutrient-rich oil with weakened Pokémon.
entries.translation: 这种性情沉稳的宝可梦非常富有同情心。它会把美味且营养丰富的油分给虚弱的宝可梦。

entries.source: Green-feathered flocks hold the most sway. When they’re out searching for food in the mornings and evenings, it gets very noisy.
entries.translation: 绿羽毛的群体最有势力。每到早晚外出觅食时，周围就会变得十分嘈杂。

entries.source: These Pokémon prefer to live in cities. They form flocks based on the color of their feathers, and they fight over territory.
entries.translation: 这些宝可梦喜欢生活在城市里。它们会按羽毛的颜色结成群体，并为争夺地盘而战。
