entries.source: The ground scrapes its body as it travels, causing it to leave salt behind. Salt is constantly being created and replenished inside Nacli’s body.
entries.translation: 它在移动时，地面会刮擦身体，使盐粒沿途洒落。盐石宝的体内会不断生成并补充盐分。

entries.source: It was born in a layer of rock salt deep under the earth. This species was particularly treasured in the old days, as they would share precious salt.
entries.translation: 它诞生于地底深处的岩盐层中。在过去，这个种族尤其受人珍视，因为它们会与人分享珍贵的盐。

entries.source: It compresses rock salt inside its body and shoots out hardened salt pellets with enough force to perforate an iron sheet.
entries.translation: 它会压缩体内的岩盐，再将硬化的盐粒发射出去，其威力足以贯穿铁板。

entries.source: This Pokémon dry cures its prey by spraying salt over them. The curing process steals away the water in the prey’s body.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦会向猎物撒盐，将其腌制风干。腌制过程会夺走猎物体内的水分。

entries.source: Many Pokémon gather around Garganacl, hoping to lick at its mineral-rich salt.
entries.translation: 许多宝可梦会聚集在盐石巨灵周围，希望舔食它富含矿物质的盐。

entries.source: Garganacl will rub its fingertips together and sprinkle injured Pokémon with salt. Even severe wounds will promptly heal afterward.
entries.translation: 盐石巨灵会搓动指尖，将盐撒在受伤的宝可梦身上。之后，即使是重伤也会迅速痊愈。

entries.source: Its firepower increases when it fights, reaching over 1,800 degrees Fahrenheit. It likes berries that are rich in fat.
entries.translation: 战斗时，它的火力会增强，温度可达华氏1800度以上。它喜欢富含脂肪的树果。

entries.source: Burnt charcoal came to life and became a Pokémon. Possessing a fiery fighting spirit, Charcadet will battle even tough opponents.
entries.translation: 烧焦的木炭获得生命，变成了宝可梦。炭小侍斗志如火，即使面对强敌也会奋勇战斗。

entries.source: This Pokémon clads itself in armor that has been fortified by psychic and fire energy, and it shoots blazing fireballs.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦身披由超能力与火焰能量强化的铠甲，并会发射熊熊燃烧的火球。

entries.source: Armarouge evolved through the use of a set of armor that belonged to a distinguished warrior. This Pokémon is incredibly loyal.
entries.translation: 红莲铠骑使用一套曾属于杰出战士的铠甲后进化而来。这种宝可梦无比忠诚。

entries.source: An old set of armor steeped in grudges caused this Pokémon’s evolution. Ceruledge cuts its enemies to pieces without mercy.
entries.translation: 一套浸透怨念的古老铠甲促使这种宝可梦进化。苍炎刃鬼会毫不留情地将敌人斩成碎片。

entries.source: The fiery blades on its arms burn fiercely with the lingering resentment of a sword wielder who fell before accomplishing their goal.
entries.translation: 它双臂上的火焰之刃熊熊燃烧，其中寄宿着一名壮志未酬便倒下的剑士所遗留的怨念。

entries.source: It floats using the electricity stored in its body. When thunderclouds are around, Tadbulb will float higher off the ground.
entries.translation: 它利用储存在体内的电力飘浮。当附近出现雷云时，光蚪仔会飘得离地面更高。

entries.source: Tadbulb shakes its tail to generate electricity. If it senses danger, it will make its head blink on and off to alert its allies.
entries.translation: 光蚪仔会摇动尾巴来发电。如果察觉到危险，它便会让头部不停闪烁，向伙伴发出警报。

entries.source: What appear to be eyeballs are actually organs for discharging the electricity generated by Bellibolt’s belly-button dynamo.
entries.translation: 看似眼球的部位，其实是用于释放电肚蛙腹部的肚脐发电器所产生电力的器官。

entries.source: When this Pokémon expands and contracts its wobbly body, the belly-button dynamo in its stomach produces a huge amount of electricity.
entries.translation: 当这种宝可梦让柔软晃动的身体膨胀收缩时，腹部的肚脐发电器便会产生大量电力。

entries.source: These Pokémon make their nests on coastal cliffs. The nests have a strange, crackling texture, and they’re a popular delicacy.
entries.translation: 这些宝可梦会在海岸峭壁上筑巢。它们的巢有种奇特的酥脆口感，是很受欢迎的美味。

entries.source: When its wings catch the wind, the bones within produce electricity. This Pokémon dives into the ocean, catching prey by electrocuting them.
entries.translation: 当翅膀迎风时，翅膀内的骨骼便会产生电力。这种宝可梦会俯冲入海，用电击捕捉猎物。

entries.source: It uses its throat sac to store electricity generated by its wings. There’s hardly any oil in its feathers, so it is a poor swimmer.
entries.translation: 它会用喉囊储存翅膀产生的电力。它的羽毛几乎不含油脂，因此不擅长游泳。

entries.source: Kilowattrel inflates its throat sac to amplify its electricity. By riding the wind, this Pokémon can fly over 430 miles in a day.
entries.translation: 大电海燕会鼓起喉囊，增强自身的电力。借助风势，这种宝可梦一天能飞行超过430英里。

entries.source: Its well-developed jaw and fangs are strong enough to crunch through boulders, and its thick fat makes for an excellent defense.
entries.translation: 它发达的下颚和尖牙十分强劲，足以咬碎巨石，厚实的脂肪则提供了出色的防御。

entries.source: It always scowls in an attempt to make opponents take it seriously, but even crying children will burst into laughter when they see Maschiff’s face.
entries.translation: 它总是皱着眉头，想让对手认真看待自己，但就连哭闹的孩子看到偶叫獒的脸也会破涕为笑。

entries.source: Mabosstiff loves playing with children. Though usually gentle, it takes on an intimidating look when protecting its family.
entries.translation: 獒教父喜欢和孩子们玩耍。虽然平时性情温和，但保护家人时会露出骇人的神情。

entries.source: This Pokémon can store energy in its large dewlap. Mabosstiff unleashes this energy all at once to blow away enemies.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦能将能量储存在硕大的喉袋里。獒教父会一口气释放这些能量，将敌人吹飞。

entries.source: To keep enemies away from its territory, it paints markings around its nest using a poisonous liquid that has an acrid odor.
entries.translation: 为了让敌人远离自己的领地，它会用散发刺鼻气味的毒液在巢穴周围画上标记。

entries.source: Though usually a mellow Pokémon, it will sink its sharp, poison-soaked front teeth into any that anger it, causing paralysis in the object of its ire.
entries.translation: 它平时性情温和，但只要被激怒，就会将浸满毒液的锋利门牙刺入对方体内，使其麻痹。

entries.source: Each Grafaiai paints its own individual pattern, and it will paint that same pattern over and over again throughout its life.
entries.translation: 每只涂标客都会画出自己独有的图案，并终其一生反复绘制同样的图案。

entries.source: The color of the poisonous saliva depends on what the Pokémon eats. Grafaiai covers its fingers in its saliva and draws patterns on trees in forests.
entries.translation: 毒唾液的颜色取决于这种宝可梦吃了什么。涂标客会让手指沾满唾液，在森林里的树木上绘制图案。

entries.source: Not even Bramblin knows where it is headed as it tumbles across the wilderness, blown by the wind. It loathes getting wet.
entries.translation: 纳噬草被风吹着滚过荒野，就连它自己也不知道要去往何处。它非常讨厌被弄湿。

entries.source: A soul unable to move on to the afterlife was blown around by the wind until it got tangled up with dried grass and became a Pokémon.
entries.translation: 一个无法前往来世的灵魂被风吹得到处飘荡，直到与枯草缠在一起，变成了宝可梦。

entries.source: Brambleghast wanders around arid regions. On rare occasions, mass outbreaks of these Pokémon will bury an entire town.
entries.translation: 怖纳噬草在干旱地区四处游荡。极少数情况下，这种宝可梦会大量出现，掩埋整座城镇。

entries.source: It will open the branches of its head to envelop its prey. Once it absorbs all the life energy it needs, it expels the prey and discards it.
entries.translation: 它会张开头部的枝条，将猎物包裹起来。吸收足够的生命能量后，它便会吐出并丢弃猎物。

entries.source: Though it looks like Tentacool, Toedscool is a completely different species. Its legs may be thin, but it can run at a speed of 30 mph.
entries.translation: 原野水母虽然长得像玛瑙水母，却是完全不同的物种。它的腿看似纤细，却能以每小时30英里的速度奔跑。

entries.source: Toedscool lives in muggy forests. The flaps that fall from its body are chewy and very delicious.
entries.translation: 原野水母生活在闷热潮湿的森林里。从它身上脱落的薄片很有嚼劲，而且非常美味。

entries.source: It coils its 10 tentacles around prey and sucks out their nutrients, causing the prey pain. The folds along the rim of its head are a popular delicacy.
entries.translation: 它会用10条触手缠住猎物，吸取其营养，让猎物痛苦不堪。头部边缘的褶皱是很受欢迎的美味佳肴。

entries.source: These Pokémon gather into groups and form colonies deep within forests. They absolutely hate it when strangers approach.
entries.translation: 这些宝可梦会聚集成群，在森林深处形成群落。它们极其厌恶陌生者靠近。

entries.source: This Pokémon lives on sheer cliffs. It sidesteps opponents’ attacks, then lunges for their weak spots with its claws.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦生活在陡峭的悬崖上。它会侧身躲开对手的攻击，再用钳子猛扑向对手的弱点。

entries.source: Klawf hangs upside-down from cliffs, waiting for prey. But Klawf can’t remain in this position for long because its blood rushes to its head.
entries.translation: 毛崖蟹会倒挂在悬崖上等待猎物。但由于血液会涌向头部，毛崖蟹无法长时间保持这个姿势。

entries.source: Traditional Paldean dishes can be extremely spicy because they include the shed front teeth of Capsakid among their ingredients.
entries.translation: 帕底亚的传统料理之所以会辣得惊人，是因为食材中包含热辣娃脱落的门牙。

entries.source: The more sunlight this Pokémon bathes in, the more spicy chemicals are produced by its body, and thus the spicier its moves become.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦晒到的阳光越多，体内产生的辛辣成分就越多，招式也会因此变得越辣。

entries.source: The green head has turned vicious due to the spicy chemicals stimulating its brain. Once it goes on a rampage, there is no stopping it.
entries.translation: 绿色的头因辛辣成分刺激大脑而变得凶暴。一旦开始大闹，就再也无法阻止。

entries.source: The red head converts spicy chemicals into fire energy and blasts the surrounding area with a super spicy stream of flame.
entries.translation: 红色的头会将辛辣成分转化为火焰能量，用极其辛辣的火焰喷流席卷四周。

entries.source: It rolls its mud ball around while the energy it needs for evolution matures. Eventually the time comes for it to evolve.
entries.translation: 它一边滚动泥球，一边让进化所需的能量逐渐成熟。最终，进化的时刻便会到来。

entries.source: This Pokémon creates a mud ball by mixing sand and dirt with psychic energy. It treasures its mud ball more than its own life.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦会将沙土与精神力量混合，制成泥球。它把泥球看得比自己的生命还重要。

entries.source: An infant sleeps inside the ball. Rabsca rolls the ball soothingly with its legs to ensure the infant sleeps comfortably.
entries.translation: 球里沉睡着一只幼体。虫甲圣会用脚轻柔地滚动球，让幼体安稳入睡。

entries.source: The body that supports the ball barely moves. Therefore, it is thought that the true body of this Pokémon is actually inside the ball.
entries.translation: 支撑着球的身体几乎一动不动。因此，人们认为这种宝可梦真正的身体其实就在球里。

entries.source: It spends its time running around wastelands. If anyone steals its beloved berries, it will chase them down and exact its revenge.
entries.translation: 它总是在荒野中四处奔跑。如果有人偷走它心爱的树果，它就会追上对方报仇。

entries.source: Flittle’s toes levitate about half an inch above the ground because of the psychic power emitted from the frills on the Pokémon’s belly.
entries.translation: 飘飘雏腹部的褶边会释放精神力量，使它的脚趾悬浮在离地约半英寸的空中。

entries.source: It emits psychic power from the gaps between its multicolored frills and sprints at speeds greater than 120 mph.
entries.translation: 它会从五彩褶边之间的缝隙释放精神力量，以超过每小时120英里的速度疾驰。

entries.source: It immobilizes opponents by bathing them in psychic power from its large eyes. Despite its appearance, it has a vicious temperament.
entries.translation: 它会用大眼睛释放精神力量笼罩对手，使其无法动弹。别看它外表如此，性情却十分凶暴。

entries.source: This Pokémon pounds iron scraps together to make a hammer. It will remake the hammer again and again until it’s satisfied with the result.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦会把铁屑捶打在一起，做成锤子。它会一遍又一遍地重做锤子，直到对成果满意为止。

entries.source: It swings its handmade hammer around to protect itself, but the hammer is often stolen by Pokémon that eat metal.
entries.translation: 它会挥舞亲手制作的锤子来保护自己，但锤子常被以金属为食的宝可梦抢走。

entries.source: These Pokémon make their homes in piles of scrap metal. They test the strength of each other’s hammers by smashing them together.
entries.translation: 这些宝可梦会在废金属堆里安家。它们会让彼此的锤子相互碰撞，以测试锤子的强度。

entries.source: This Pokémon will attack groups of Pawniard and Bisharp, gathering metal from them in order to create a large and sturdy hammer.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦会袭击成群的驹刀小兵和劈斩司令，从它们身上收集金属，以制作巨大而坚固的锤子。

entries.source: The hammer tops 220 pounds, yet it gets swung around easily by Tinkaton as it steals whatever it pleases and carries its plunder back home.
entries.translation: 锤子的重量超过220磅，但巨锻匠仍能轻松挥舞它，随心所欲地抢走各种东西，再把战利品带回家。

entries.source: This intelligent Pokémon has a very daring disposition. It knocks rocks into the sky with its hammer, aiming for flying Corviknight.
entries.translation: 这种聪明的宝可梦性情十分大胆。它会用锤子把岩石击向天空，瞄准飞行中的钢铠鸦。

entries.source: Though it looks like Diglett, Wiglett is an entirely different species. The resemblance seems to be a coincidental result of environmental adaptation.
entries.translation: 虽然看起来像地鼠，但海地鼠其实是完全不同的物种。两者之所以相似，似乎只是适应环境后产生的巧合。

entries.source: This Pokémon can pick up the scent of a Veluza just over 65 feet away and will hide itself in the sand.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦能嗅到略远于65英尺处的轻身鳕，并会把自己藏进沙里。

entries.source: A variety of fish Pokémon, Wugtrio was once considered to be a regional form of Dugtrio.
entries.translation: 三海地鼠是鱼类宝可梦，过去曾被认为是三地鼠的地区形态。

entries.source: It has a vicious temperament, contrary to what its appearance may suggest. It wraps its long bodies around prey, then drags the prey into its den.
entries.translation: 与外表给人的印象相反，它性情凶暴。它会用细长的身体缠住猎物，再把猎物拖进巢穴。

entries.source: Bombirdier uses the apron on its chest to bundle up food, which it carries back to its nest. It enjoys dropping things that make loud noises.
entries.translation: 下石鸟会用胸前的围裙包起食物，再将其带回巢穴。它喜欢丢下会发出巨响的东西。

entries.source: It gathers things up in an apron made from shed feathers added to the Pokémon’s chest feathers, then drops those things from high places for fun.
entries.translation: 它会把脱落的羽毛添到胸前的羽毛上，做成围裙来收集东西，然后从高处丢下这些东西取乐。

entries.source: Its water ring is made from seawater mixed with a sticky fluid that Finizen secretes from its blowhole.
entries.translation: 它的水环是由海水和波普海豚从呼吸孔分泌的黏稠液体混合而成的。

entries.source: It likes playing with others of its kind using the water ring on its tail. It uses ultrasonic waves to sense the emotions of other living creatures.
entries.translation: 它喜欢用尾巴上的水环和同类玩耍。它会用超声波感知其他生物的情绪。

entries.source: Its physical capabilities are no different than a Finizen’s, but when its allies are in danger, it transforms and powers itself up.
entries.translation: 它的身体能力与波普海豚并无不同，但当伙伴陷入危险时，它就会变身并增强力量。

entries.source: This Pokémon changes its appearance if it hears its allies calling for help. Palafin will never show anybody its moment of transformation.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦听到伙伴求救的呼唤后，外貌就会发生变化。海豚侠绝不会让任何人看到自己变身的瞬间。

entries.source: The steel section is Varoom’s actual body. This Pokémon clings to rocks and converts the minerals within into energy to fuel its activities.
entries.translation: 钢铁部分才是噗隆隆真正的身体。这种宝可梦会附着在岩石上，将其中的矿物质转化为维持活动所需的能量。

entries.source: It is said that this Pokémon was born when an unknown poison Pokémon entered and inspirited an engine left at a scrap-processing factory.
entries.translation: 据说，某只不知名的毒属性宝可梦进入废料处理厂遗弃的引擎并附于其上后，这种宝可梦便诞生了。

entries.source: Revavroom viciously threatens others with the sound of its exhaust. It sticks its tongue out from its cylindrical mouth and sprays toxic fluids.
entries.translation: 普隆隆姆会用排气声凶狠地威吓对手。它会从圆筒状的嘴里伸出舌头，喷洒有毒的液体。

entries.source: It creates a gas out of poison and minerals from rocks. It then detonates the gas in its cylinders—now numbering eight—to generate energy.
entries.translation: 它会用毒素和岩石中的矿物质制造气体。然后在如今已多达八个的汽缸中引爆气体，以产生能量。

entries.source: It can sprint at over 70 mph while carrying a human. The rider’s body heat warms Cyclizar’s back and lifts the Pokémon’s spirit.
entries.translation: 它载着人类时也能以超过每小时70英里的速度疾驰。骑乘者的体温会温暖摩托蜥的背部，让这种宝可梦精神振奋。

entries.source: Apparently Cyclizar has been allowing people to ride on its back since ancient times. Depictions of this have been found in 10,000-year-old murals.
entries.translation: 摩托蜥似乎自古以来就会让人骑在背上。在距今1万年的壁画中，发现了描绘这一情景的图案。

entries.source: This Pokémon lives in arid deserts. It maintains its metal body by consuming iron from the soil.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦生活在干旱的沙漠中。它会摄取土壤里的铁，以维持自己的金属身体。

entries.source: When attacked, this Pokémon will wield the tendrils on its body like fists and pelt the opponent with a storm of punches.
entries.translation: 遭到攻击时，这种宝可梦会将身上的触手当作拳头挥舞，以狂风暴雨般的拳击猛打对手。

entries.source: Glimmet’s toxic mineral crystals look just like flower petals. This Pokémon scatters poisonous powder like pollen to protect itself.
entries.translation: 晶光芽的有毒矿物结晶看起来就像花瓣。这种宝可梦会像散播花粉一样撒出毒粉来保护自己。

entries.source: It absorbs nutrients from cave walls. The petals it wears are made of crystallized poison.
entries.translation: 它会从洞窟的墙壁中吸收养分。它身上的花瓣是由结晶化的毒素构成的。

entries.source: Glimmora’s petals are made of crystallized poison energy. It has recently become evident that these petals resemble Tera Jewels.
entries.translation: 晶光花的花瓣是由结晶化的毒之能量构成的。最近发现，这些花瓣与太晶珠十分相似。

entries.source: When this Pokémon detects danger, it will open up its crystalline petals and fire beams from its conical body.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦察觉到危险时，会张开结晶花瓣，从圆锥状的身体发射光束。

entries.source: This friendly Pokémon doesn’t like being alone. Pay it even the slightest bit of attention, and it will follow you forever.
entries.translation: 这种亲切的宝可梦不喜欢独处。只要稍微搭理它一下，它就会永远跟着你。

entries.source: It is said that a dog Pokémon that died in the wild without ever interacting with a human was reborn as this Pokémon.
entries.translation: 据说，某只从未与人类接触便死于野外的犬类宝可梦，转生后变成了这种宝可梦。

entries.source: A lovingly mourned Pokémon was reborn as Houndstone. It doesn’t like anyone touching the protuberance atop its head.
entries.translation: 一只深受疼爱并被人哀悼的宝可梦转生为了墓扬犬。它不喜欢别人触碰头顶的突起。

entries.source: Houndstone spends most of its time sleeping in graveyards. Among all the dog Pokémon, this one is most loyal to its master.
entries.translation: 墓扬犬大部分时间都在墓地里睡觉。在所有犬类宝可梦中，它对主人最为忠诚。

entries.source: Thanks to a behavior of theirs known as “synchronizing,” an entire flock of these Pokémon can attack simultaneously in perfect harmony.
entries.translation: 得益于被称为“同步”的行为，一整群纏红鹤能够完美协调，同时发动攻击。

entries.source: This Pokémon apparently ties the base of its neck into a knot so that energy stored in its belly does not escape from its beak.
entries.translation: 纏红鹤似乎会把脖子根部打成结，以免储存在腹部的能量从嘴里逸出。

entries.source: It lives in frigid regions in pods of five or so individuals. It loves the minerals found in snow and ice.
entries.translation: 走鲸生活在严寒地区，会组成五只左右的群体。它很喜欢雪和冰中含有的矿物质。

entries.source: This species left the ocean and began living on land a very long time ago. It seems to be closely related to Wailmer.
entries.translation: 走鲸这一物种在很久以前离开海洋，开始在陆地上生活。它似乎与吼吼鲸有着密切的亲缘关系。

entries.source: Ice energy builds up in the horn on its upper jaw, causing the horn to reach cryogenic temperatures that freeze its surroundings.
entries.translation: 冰之能量会积聚在浩大鲸上颚的角中，使角达到足以冻结周围环境的极低温度。

entries.source: This Pokémon wanders around snowy, icy areas. It protects its body with powerful muscles and a thick layer of fat under its skin.
entries.translation: 浩大鲸会在冰天雪地中四处游荡。它以强健的肌肉和皮下厚厚的脂肪保护身体。

entries.source: Veluza has excellent regenerative capabilities. It sheds spare flesh from its body to boost its agility, then charges at its prey.
entries.translation: 轻身鳕拥有出色的再生能力。它会甩掉身上多余的肉来提升敏捷度，然后冲向猎物。

entries.source: When Veluza discards unnecessary flesh, its mind becomes honed and its psychic power increases. The spare flesh has a mild but delicious flavor.
entries.translation: 轻身鳕舍弃不必要的肉后，精神会变得更加敏锐，超能力也会增强。多余的肉味道清淡，却十分美味。

entries.source: It treats Tatsugiri like its boss and follows it loyally. Though powerful, Dondozo is apparently not very smart.
entries.translation: 吃吼霸把米立龙当作老大，忠实地听从它的指挥。吃吼霸虽然力量强大，但似乎不太聪明。

entries.source: This Pokémon is a glutton, but it’s bad at getting food. It teams up with a Tatsugiri to catch prey.
entries.translation: 吃吼霸十分贪吃，却不擅长获取食物。它会与米立龙联手捕捉猎物。

entries.source: Tatsugiri is an extremely cunning Pokémon. It feigns weakness to lure in prey, then orders its partner to attack.
entries.translation: 米立龙是极其狡猾的宝可梦。它会装作虚弱来引诱猎物靠近，再命令搭档发动攻击。

entries.source: This is a small dragon Pokémon. It lives inside the mouth of Dondozo to protect itself from enemies on the outside.
entries.translation: 这是小型的龙宝可梦。它生活在吃吼霸的嘴里，以保护自己免受外界敌人的侵害。

entries.source: It imbues its fists with the power of the rage that it kept hidden in its heart. Opponents struck by these imbued fists will be shattered to their core.
entries.translation: 弃世猴会将隐藏在内心的愤怒之力注入拳头。被这双拳头击中的对手，会从内到外彻底粉碎。

entries.source: When its anger rose beyond a critical point, this Pokémon gained power that is unfettered by the limits of its physical body.
entries.translation: 当愤怒突破临界点后，弃世猴获得了不受肉体极限束缚的力量。

entries.source: It lives at the bottom of ponds and swamps. It will carry Wooper on its back and ferry them across water from one shore to the other.
entries.translation: 土王生活在池塘和沼泽底部。它会让乌波坐在背上，把它们从水域的一岸送到另一岸。

entries.source: When attacked, this Pokémon will retaliate by sticking thick spines out from its body. It’s a risky move that puts everything on the line.
entries.translation: 受到攻击时，土王会从体内伸出粗大的刺进行反击。这是赌上一切的危险招式。

entries.source: The hardened head from the tail protects the head of the main body as Farigiraf whips its long neck around to headbutt enemies.
entries.translation: 奇麒麟甩动长颈，用头撞击敌人时，尾巴上硬化的头会保护本体的头部。

entries.source: Now that the brain waves from the head and tail are synced up, the psychic power of this Pokémon is 10 times stronger than Girafarig’s.
entries.translation: 头部和尾部的脑电波如今已同步，使这种宝可梦的精神力量达到了麒麟奇的10倍。

entries.source: It drives enemies out of its nest by sucking in enough air to fill its long, narrow lungs, then releasing the air in an intense blast.
entries.translation: 它会吸入足以充满细长肺部的空气，再猛烈地喷出，以此将敌人赶出巢穴。

entries.source: This Pokémon uses its hard tail to make its nest by boring holes into bedrock deep underground. The nest can reach lengths of over six miles.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦会用坚硬的尾巴在地下深处的基岩中钻孔筑巢。巢穴的长度可超过6英里。

entries.source: Though it commands a massive army in battle, it’s not skilled at devising complex strategies. It just uses brute strength to keep pushing.
entries.translation: 虽然它在战斗中统领着庞大的军队，却不擅长制定复杂的战略。只会凭借蛮力不断推进。

entries.source: Only a Bisharp that stands above all others in its vast army can evolve into Kingambit.
entries.translation: 只有在庞大军队中凌驾于所有同类之上的劈斩司令，才能进化成仆刀将军。

entries.source: This creature resembles a mysterious Pokémon that, according to a paranormal magazine, has lived since ancient times.
entries.translation: 这种生物与某种神秘宝可梦十分相似。据一本灵异杂志记载，那种宝可梦自远古时代起便一直存活至今。

entries.source: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. The name Great Tusk was taken from a creature listed in a certain book.
entries.translation: 近年来曾有人目击这种宝可梦。雄伟牙这个名字取自某本书中记载的一种生物。

entries.source: It resembles a mysterious Pokémon described in a paranormal magazine as a Jigglypuff from one billion years ago.
entries.translation: 它与灵异杂志中描述的神秘宝可梦十分相似，据称那是来自10亿年前的胖丁。

entries.source: There has been only one reported sighting of this Pokémon. It resembles a mysterious creature depicted in an old expedition journal.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦仅有过一次目击报告。它与一本古老探险日志中描绘的神秘生物十分相似。

entries.source: It bears a slight resemblance to a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a cross between a dinosaur and a mushroom.
entries.translation: 它与某本可疑杂志中描述的一种宝可梦略有相似，据称那是恐龙与蘑菇的结合体。

entries.source: It is possible that the creature listed as Brute Bonnet in a certain book could actually be this Pokémon.
entries.translation: 某本书中记载为猛恶菇的生物，或许其实就是这种宝可梦。

entries.source: It has similar features to a ghostly pterosaur that was covered in a paranormal magazine, but the two have little else in common.
entries.translation: 它的特征与某本灵异杂志报道的幽灵翼龙相似，但除此之外，两者几乎没有共同之处。

entries.source: This Pokémon has characteristics similar to those of Flutter Mane, a creature mentioned in a certain book.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦的特征与某本书中提到的生物振翼发相似。

entries.source: This Pokémon somewhat resembles an ancient form of Volcarona that was introduced in a dubious magazine.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦与某本可疑杂志中介绍的火神蛾远古形态有些相似。

entries.source: This mysterious Pokémon has some similarities to a creature that an old book introduced as Slither Wing.
entries.translation: 这种神秘的宝可梦与某本古书中以爬地翅之名介绍的生物有些相似。

entries.source: No records exist of this Pokémon being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with a creature shown in an expedition journal.
entries.translation: 没有任何捕获到这种宝可梦的记录。虽然资料不足，但它的特征与探险日志中记载的某种生物相符。

entries.source: It slightly resembles a Magneton that lived for 10,000 years and was featured in an article in a paranormal magazine.
entries.translation: 它与灵异杂志某篇文章中介绍的、存活了１万年的三合一磁怪略有相似。

entries.source: Sightings of this Pokémon have occurred in recent years. It resembles a mysterious object described in an old expedition journal.
entries.translation: 近年来曾有人目击到这种宝可梦。它与古老探险日志中记载的神秘物体十分相似。

entries.source: This Pokémon closely resembles a scientific weapon that a paranormal magazine claimed was sent to this planet by aliens.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦与灵异杂志声称由外星人送到这颗星球的科学武器极为相似。

entries.source: It resembles a mysterious object mentioned in an old book. There are only two reported sightings of this Pokémon.
entries.translation: 它与古书中提到的神秘物体十分相似。据报告，这种宝可梦仅被目击过两次。

entries.source: Its shape is similar to a robot featured in a paranormal magazine article. The robot was said to have been created by an ancient civilization.
entries.translation: 它的外形与灵异杂志某篇文章中介绍的机器人相似。据说那个机器人是由古代文明创造的。

entries.source: This Pokémon shares many similarities with Iron Hands, an object mentioned in a certain expedition journal.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦与某本探险日志中提到的物体铁臂膀有许多相似之处。

entries.source: It is very similar to a cyborg covered exclusively by a paranormal magazine. The cyborg was said to be the modified form of a certain athlete.
entries.translation: 它与某本灵异杂志独家报道的半机械人十分相似。据说那个半机械人是由某位运动员改造而成的。

entries.source: It’s possible that Iron Jugulis, an object described in an old book, may actually be this Pokémon.
entries.translation: 古书中记载的物体铁脖颈，或许其实就是这种宝可梦。

entries.source: It resembles a certain Pokémon introduced in a paranormal magazine, described as the offspring of a Hydreigon that fell in love with a robot.
entries.translation: 它与某本灵异杂志中介绍的一种宝可梦相似，据称是爱上机器人的三首恶龙所生的后代。

entries.source: No records exist of this species being caught. Data is lacking, but the Pokémon’s traits match up with an object described in an old book.
entries.translation: 没有任何捕获到这一物种的记录。虽然资料不足，但这种宝可梦的特征与古书中记载的某个物体相符。

entries.source: This Pokémon resembles an unknown object described in a paranormal magazine as a UFO sent to observe humanity.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦与灵异杂志中记载的未知物体十分相似，据称那是被派来观察人类的ＵＦＯ。

entries.source: Some of its notable features match those of an object named within a certain expedition journal as Iron Thorns.
entries.translation: 它的一些显著特征与某本探险日志中名为铁荆棘的物体相符。

entries.source: It has some similarities to a Pokémon introduced in a dubious magazine as a Tyranitar from one billion years into the future.
entries.translation: 它与某本可疑杂志中介绍的一种宝可梦有些相似，据称那是来自１０亿年后未来的班基拉斯。

entries.source: This Pokémon lives in forests and craggy areas. Using the power of its dorsal fin, it cools the inside of its nest like a refrigerator.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦栖息在森林和岩石嶙峋的地区。它会利用背鳍的力量，像冰箱一样冷却巢穴内部。

entries.source: Frigibax absorbs heat through its dorsal fin and converts the heat into ice energy. The higher the temperature, the more energy Frigibax stores.
entries.translation: 凉脊龙会通过背鳍吸收热量，并将其转化为冰能量。温度越高，凉脊龙储存的能量就越多。

entries.source: It attacks with the blade of its frozen dorsal fin by doing a front flip in the air. Arctibax’s strong back and legs allow it to pull off this technique.
entries.translation: 它会在空中向前翻转，用冻结的背鳍之刃发动攻击。冻脊龙强健的背部和双腿使它能够施展这一招式。

entries.source: Arctibax freezes the air around it, protecting its face with an ice mask and turning its dorsal fin into a blade of ice.
entries.translation: 冻脊龙会冻结周围的空气，用冰面罩保护脸部，并将背鳍化作冰刃。

entries.source: It launches itself into battle by flipping upside down and spewing frigid air from its mouth. It finishes opponents off with its dorsal blade.
entries.translation: 它会翻转身体、头朝下从口中喷出寒气，借势冲入战斗。它会用背鳍之刃给对手致命一击。

entries.source: This Pokémon blasts cryogenic air out from its mouth. This air can instantly freeze even liquid-hot lava.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦会从口中喷出极寒的空气。就连滚烫的液态熔岩也会被这股寒气瞬间冻结。

entries.source: It lives inside an old treasure chest. Sometimes it gets left in shop corners since no one realizes it’s actually a Pokémon.
entries.translation: 它生活在古老的宝箱中。有时会被遗忘在商店的角落里，因为没人察觉它其实是宝可梦。

entries.source: This Pokémon was born inside a treasure chest about 1,500 years ago. It sucks the life-force out of scoundrels who try to steal the treasure.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦大约在１５００年前诞生于宝箱之中。它会吸取企图偷走宝物的恶徒的生命力。

entries.source: It has a sturdy body made up of stacked coins. Gholdengo overwhelms its enemies by firing coin after coin at them in quick succession.
entries.translation: 它拥有由层层堆叠的硬币构成的坚固身体。赛富豪会接连快速发射硬币，以猛烈攻势压倒敌人。

entries.source: Its body seems to be made up of 1,000 coins. This Pokémon gets along well with others and is quick to make friends with anybody.
entries.translation: 它的身体似乎由１０００枚硬币构成。这种宝可梦很合群，无论和谁都能很快成为朋友。

entries.source: It drains the life-force from vegetation, causing nearby forests to instantly wither and fields to turn barren.
entries.translation: 它会吸取草木的生命力，使附近的森林瞬间枯萎，田野变得荒芜。

entries.source: The grudge of a person punished for writing the king’s evil deeds upon wooden tablets has clad itself in dead leaves to become a Pokémon.
entries.translation: 有人因在木简上记下国王的恶行而受罚，其怨念裹上枯叶，化为了宝可梦。

entries.source: The hatred of those who perished by the sword long ago has clad itself in snow and become a Pokémon.
entries.translation: 很久以前葬身剑下之人的憎恨裹上积雪，化为了宝可梦。

entries.source: This Pokémon can control 100 tons of fallen snow. It plays around innocently by leaping in and out of avalanches it has caused.
entries.translation: 这种宝可梦能操控１００吨的积雪。它会天真无邪地在自己引发的雪崩中跳进跳出，尽情玩耍。

entries.source: It slowly brings its exceedingly heavy head down upon the ground, splitting the earth open with huge fissures that run over 160 feet deep.
entries.translation: 它会将异常沉重的头部缓缓砸向地面，在大地上劈开深逾１６０英尺的巨大裂缝。

entries.source: The fear poured into an ancient ritual vessel has clad itself in rocks and dirt to become a Pokémon.
entries.translation: 注入古代祭祀器皿中的恐惧裹上岩石与泥土，化为了宝可梦。

entries.source: The envy accumulated within curved beads that sparked multiple conflicts has clad itself in fire and become a Pokémon.
entries.translation: 引发过多次争端的弯曲玉石中积聚的嫉妒裹上火焰，化为了宝可梦。

entries.source: It controls flames burning at over 5,400 degrees Fahrenheit. It casually swims through the sea of lava it creates by melting rock and sand.
entries.translation: 它能操控温度超过华氏５４００度的火焰。它熔化岩石与沙土形成熔岩之海，并悠然游于其中。

entries.source: According to an article in a dubious magazine, this Pokémon has some connection to a phenomenon that occurs in a certain region.
entries.translation: 据一本可疑杂志的文章所述，这只宝可梦与发生在某个地区的一种现象存在某种关联。

entries.source: It is possible that this is the creature listed as Roaring Moon in an expedition journal that still holds many mysteries.
entries.translation: 它可能就是某本仍有许多谜团的探险记中记载的轰鸣月。

entries.source: It’s possible that this is the object listed as Iron Valiant in a certain expedition journal.
entries.translation: 它可能就是某本探险记中记载的铁武者。

entries.source: It has some similarities to a mad scientist’s invention covered in a paranormal magazine.
entries.translation: 它与某本灵异杂志报道的一位疯狂科学家的发明有些相似之处。

entries.source: This Pokémon resembles Cyclizar, but it is far burlier and more ferocious. Nothing is known about its ecology or other features.
entries.translation: 这只宝可梦与摩托蜥相似，但体格远比它魁梧，性情也更加凶暴。人们对它的生态及其他特征一无所知。

entries.source: This seems to be the Winged King mentioned in an old expedition journal. It was said to have split the land with its bare fists.
entries.translation: 它似乎就是一本古老探险记中提到的翼大王。据说它曾徒手劈裂大地。

entries.source: This seems to be the Iron Serpent mentioned in an old book. The Iron Serpent is said to have turned the land to ash with its lightning.
entries.translation: 它似乎就是一本古书中提到的铁大蛇。据说铁大蛇曾用雷电将大地化为灰烬。

entries.source: Much remains unknown about this creature. It resembles Cyclizar, but it is far more ruthless and powerful.
entries.translation: 关于这种生物，仍有许多未解之谜。它与摩托蜥相似，但远比它冷酷而强大。

entries.source: It resembles an illustration published in a paranormal magazine, said to be a depiction of a super-ancient Suicune.
entries.translation: 它与某本灵异杂志刊登的一幅插图相似，据说那幅图描绘的是超古代的水君。

entries.source: This ferocious creature is shrouded in mystery. It's named after an aquatic monster mentioned in an old expedition journal.
entries.translation: 这种凶暴的生物笼罩在谜团之中。它的名字取自一本古老探险记中提到的水栖怪物。

entries.source: According to the few eyewitness accounts that exist, it used its shining blades to julienne large trees and boulders.
entries.translation: 据仅有的几份目击报告所述，它曾用闪耀的利刃将大树和巨岩切成细条。

entries.source: Many of its physical characteristics match those of a Virizion from the future that was covered in a paranormal magazine.
entries.translation: 它的许多身体特征，都与某本灵异杂志报道的来自未来的毕力吉翁相吻合。

entries.source: The head sticking out belongs to the fore-wyrm, while the tail belongs to the core-wyrm. The two share one apple and help each other out.
entries.translation: 探出头的是前虫，而尾巴属于后虫。两者共享一个苹果，并相互帮助。

entries.source: Dipplin is two creatures in one Pokémon. Its evolution was triggered by a special apple grown only in one place.
entries.translation: 裹蜜虫是由两种生物组成的一只宝可梦。只有某个地方才能栽培出的特殊苹果促使它进化。

entries.source: Poltchageist looks like a regional form of Sinistea, but it was recently discovered that the two Pokémon are entirely unrelated.
entries.translation: 斯魔茶看起来像是来悲茶的地区形态，但最近发现这两种宝可梦其实毫无关联。

entries.source: Supposedly, the regrets of a tea ceremony master who died before perfecting his craft lingered in some matcha and became a Pokémon.
entries.translation: 据说，一位茶道大师未能精进技艺便与世长辞，其遗憾附着在抹茶上，变成了宝可梦。

entries.source: It prefers cool, dark places, such as the back of a shelf or the space beneath a home's floorboards. It wanders in search of prey after sunset.
entries.translation: 它喜欢待在阴凉昏暗的地方，例如架子深处或房屋地板下的空间。日落后，它会四处游荡寻找猎物。

entries.source: It pretends to be tea, trying to fool people into drinking it so it can drain their life-force. Its ruse is generally unsuccessful.
entries.translation: 它会伪装成茶，试图骗人喝下，好吸取对方的生命力。它的诡计通常不会成功。

entries.source: Okidogi is a ruffian with a short temper. It can pulverize anything by swinging around the chain on its neck.
entries.translation: 够赞狗是个性情急躁的恶棍。它挥舞颈部的锁链，能将任何东西击得粉碎。

entries.source: After all its muscles were stimulated by the toxic chain around its neck, Okidogi transformed and gained a powerful physique.
entries.translation: 颈部的毒素锁链刺激了全身肌肉后，够赞狗发生了变化，获得了强健的体魄。

entries.source: Munkidori keeps itself somewhere safe while it toys with its foes, using psychokinesis to induce intense dizziness.
entries.translation: 愿增猿藏身于安全之处，用念力让对手产生强烈的眩晕感，将其玩弄于股掌之间。

entries.source: The chain is made from toxins that enhance capabilities. It stimulated Munkidori's brain and caused the Pokémon's psychic powers to bloom.
entries.translation: 锁链由能够增强能力的毒素构成。它刺激了愿增猿的大脑，使这只宝可梦的超能力得以觉醒。

entries.source: Fezandipiti beats its glossy wings to scatter pheromones that captivate people and Pokémon.
entries.translation: 吉雉鸡拍动亮丽的翅膀，散播能迷住人和宝可梦的费洛蒙。

entries.source: Fezandipiti owes its beautiful looks and lovely voice to the toxic stimulants emanating from the chain wrapped around its body.
entries.translation: 吉雉鸡美丽的外貌和悦耳的嗓音，都源自缠绕其身体的锁链所释放的毒性刺激物。

entries.source: This mischief-loving Pokémon is full of curiosity. It battles by drawing out the type-based energy contained within its masks.
entries.translation: 这只爱恶作剧的宝可梦充满好奇心。它会引出面具中蕴藏的属性能量进行战斗。

entries.source: This Pokémon's type changes based on which mask it's wearing. It confounds its enemies with nimble movements and kicks.
entries.translation: 这只宝可梦的属性会随佩戴的面具而改变。它以敏捷的动作和踢击迷惑敌人。

entries.source: It digs holes on mountains, searching for food. It’s so durable that being caught in a cave-in won’t faze it.
entries.translation: 它会在山上挖洞寻找食物。它坚固无比，即使被卷入洞穴坍塌也毫不在意。

entries.source: It gathers static electricity from its surroundings. The beams it launches when down on all fours are tremendously powerful.
entries.translation: 它会收集周围的静电。四肢着地时发射的光束威力极其强大。

entries.source: These capricious syrpents have banded together. On the rare occasion that their moods align, their true power is unleashed.
entries.translation: 这些反复无常的蛇首聚集在了一起。只有在极少数心意相通的时候，它们才会释放出真正的力量。

entries.source: Seven syrpents live inside an apple made of syrup. The syrpent in the center is the commander.
entries.translation: 七个蛇首生活在一颗糖浆制成的苹果里。位于中央的蛇首是指挥者。

entries.source: It resembles an eerie Pokémon once shown in a paranormal magazine. That Pokémon was said to be an Entei regenerated from a fossil.
entries.translation: 它很像曾在灵异杂志上出现过的一只诡异宝可梦。据说那只宝可梦是由化石复原而成的炎帝。

entries.source: There are scant few reports of this creature being sighted. One short video shows it rampaging and spouting pillars of flame.
entries.translation: 这种生物的目击报告少之又少。一段短视频拍到了它横冲直撞并喷出道道火柱的模样。

entries.source: It bears resemblance to a Pokémon that became a hot topic for a short while after a paranormal magazine touted it as Raikou's ancestor.
entries.translation: 它与一种宝可梦十分相似。某本灵异杂志曾宣称那种宝可梦是雷公的祖先，使其一度成为热门话题。

entries.source: It's said to incinerate everything around it with lightning launched from its fur. Very little is known about this creature.
entries.translation: 据说它会用从毛发中释放的雷电将周围的一切焚烧殆尽。人们对这种生物所知甚少。

entries.source: It was named after a mysterious object recorded in an old book. Its body seems to be metallic.
entries.translation: 它以一本古书中记载的神秘物体命名。它的身体似乎由金属构成。

entries.source: It resembles a Pokémon described in a dubious magazine as a Terrakion that had been modified by an evil organization.
entries.translation: 它与某本可疑杂志中描述的宝可梦十分相似，据称那是被邪恶组织改造过的代拉基翁。

entries.source: There was supposedly an incident in which it launched shining blades to cut everything around it to pieces. Little else is known about it.
entries.translation: 据说曾发生过它发射闪耀利刃，将周围的一切切成碎片的事件。除此之外，人们对它知之甚少。

entries.source: It resembles a mysterious object introduced in a paranormal magazine as a cutting-edge weapon shaped like a Cobalion.
entries.translation: 它与某本灵异杂志介绍的神秘物体十分相似，据称那是一种外形酷似勾帕路翁的尖端武器。

entries.source: It’s thought that this Pokémon lived in ancient Paldea until it got caught in seismic shifts and went extinct.
entries.translation: 人们认为这种宝可梦曾生活在古代的帕底亚，后来因受地壳变动波及而灭绝。

entries.source: Terapagos protects itself using its power to transform energy into hard crystals. This Pokémon is the source of the Terastal phenomenon.
entries.translation: 太乐巴戈斯会运用将能量转化为坚硬结晶的力量保护自己。这种宝可梦是太晶化现象的源头。

entries.source: Its peach-shaped shell serves as storage for a potent poison. It makes poisonous mochi and serves them to people and Pokémon.
entries.translation: 它桃子形状的外壳可用于储存剧毒。它会制作有毒的年糕，并将其分给人和宝可梦。

entries.source: It feeds others toxic mochi that draw out desires and capabilities. Those who eat the mochi fall under Pecharunt’s control, chained to its will.
entries.translation: 它会让其他生物吃下能激发欲望与能力的有毒年糕。吃下年糕的生物会受到桃歹郎控制，任其摆布。
